senses.definition: to leave somebody, especially somebody you are responsible for, with no intention of returning

examples.x: The baby had been abandoned by its mother.
People often simply abandon their pets when they go abroad.
‘We have been abandoned to our fate,’ said one resident.
The study showed a deep fear among the elderly of being abandoned to the care of strangers.

senses.definition_vi: rời bỏ ai đó, đặc biệt là người mà bạn có trách nhiệm, mà không có ý định quay lại

senses.definition: to leave a thing or place, especially because it is impossible or dangerous to stay

examples.x: Snow forced many drivers to abandon their vehicles.
He gave the order to abandon ship (= to leave the ship because it was sinking).
They had to abandon their lands to the invading forces.

senses.definition_vi: rời bỏ một vật hoặc một địa điểm, đặc biệt là vì không thể hoặc nguy hiểm khi ở lại

senses.definition: to stop doing something, especially before it is finished; to stop having something

examples.x: They abandoned the match because of rain.
The plans for reform were quietly abandoned.
She abandoned hope of any reconciliation.
We had to abandon any further attempt at negotiation.

senses.definition_vi: ngừng làm điều gì đó, đặc biệt là trước khi hoàn thành; ngừng sở hữu thứ gì đó

senses.definition: to stop supporting or helping somebody; to stop believing in something

examples.x: The country abandoned its political leaders after the war.
Critics accused him of abandoning his principles.
This principle has now been effectively abandoned.

senses.definition_vi: ngừng hỗ trợ hoặc giúp đỡ ai đó; ngừng tin vào điều gì đó

senses.definition: to feel an emotion so strongly that you can feel nothing else

examples.x: He abandoned himself to despair.

senses.definition_vi: cảm thấy một cảm xúc mạnh mẽ đến mức không thể cảm thấy bất cứ điều gì khác

senses.definition: the fact that somebody/something is able to do something

examples.x: People with the disease may lose their ability to communicate.
This program has the ability to adapt to its user.
Students must demonstrate the ability to understand simple texts.
She has an uncanny ability to predict what consumers will want.
A gentle form of exercise will increase your ability to relax.

senses.definition_vi: việc ai đó/điều gì đó có khả năng làm được điều gì đó

senses.definition: a level of skill or intelligence

examples.x: Their athletic ability is stunning.
cognitive/intellectual/mental ability
A woman of her ability will easily find a job.
Are you used to teaching students of mixed abilities?
It's important to discover the natural abilities of each child.
I try to do my job to the best of my ability (= as well as I can).

senses.definition_vi: mức độ kỹ năng hoặc trí thông minh

senses.definition: having the skill, intelligence, opportunity, etc. needed to do something

examples.x: You must be able to speak French for this job.
A viral illness left her barely able to walk.
We're still able to get visas to come and go from Thailand.
I didn't feel able to disagree with him.
Will you be able to come?
Are you really willing and able to do what is necessary?
They don't even seem able to see what's good about their ideas.
These families are less able to afford a balanced, healthy diet.

senses.definition_vi: có kỹ năng, trí thông minh, cơ hội, v.v. cần thiết để làm điều gì đó

senses.definition: intelligent; good at something

examples.x: She's the ablest student in the class.

senses.definition_vi: thông minh; giỏi về một cái gì đó

senses.definition: the fact of somebody being away from a place where they are usually expected to be; the occasion or period of time when somebody is away

examples.x: The decision was made in my absence (= while I was not there).
We did not receive any news during his long absence.
absence from work
repeated absences from school

senses.definition_vi: việc ai đó vắng mặt khỏi một nơi mà họ thường được mong đợi sẽ có mặt; dịp hoặc khoảng thời gian khi ai đó vắng mặt

senses.definition: the fact of somebody/something not existing or not being available; a lack of something

examples.x: I was surprised by the absence of any women on the board of directors.
The case was dismissed in the absence of any definite proof.

senses.definition_vi: việc ai đó/điều gì đó không tồn tại hoặc không có sẵn; sự thiếu hụt của một cái gì đó

senses.definition: used to say that when you are away from somebody that you love, you love them even more
senses.definition_vi: dùng để nói rằng khi bạn xa ai đó mà bạn yêu thương, bạn càng yêu họ nhiều hơn

senses.definition: not present in a situation or place, when it is obvious that you should be there

examples.x: The meeting went well but Nigel was conspicuous by his absence.

senses.definition_vi: không có mặt trong một tình huống hoặc địa điểm, khi rõ ràng là bạn nên có mặt

senses.definition: not in a place because of illness, etc.

examples.x: She was absent from work for two weeks.
Local people were conspicuously absent from the meeting.

senses.definition_vi: không có mặt ở một nơi vì ốm, v.v.

senses.definition: not present in something

examples.x: Love was totally absent from his childhood.
She now played with a passion that had been strangely absent from her previous performance.

senses.definition_vi: không có mặt trong một cái gì đó

senses.definition: showing that you are not really looking at or thinking about what is happening around you

examples.x: an absent expression

senses.definition_vi: cho thấy bạn không thực sự nhìn hoặc suy nghĩ về những gì đang xảy ra xung quanh bạn

senses.definition: total and complete

examples.x: I've joined a class for absolute beginners.
absolute confidence/trust/silence/truth
‘You're wrong,’ she said with absolute certainty.
Clean water is an absolute necessity.
Around them the darkness was absolute, the silence oppressive.

senses.definition_vi: hoàn toàn và trọn vẹn

senses.definition: used, especially in spoken English, to give emphasis to what you are saying

examples.x: We must keep costs to an absolute minimum.
This room is an absolute disgrace.
They're talking absolute nonsense.
He must earn an absolute fortune.

senses.definition_vi: được sử dụng, đặc biệt trong tiếng nói, để nhấn mạnh những gì bạn đang nói

senses.definition: definite and without any doubt

examples.x: There was no absolute proof.
He taught us that the laws of physics were absolute.
The story offers no clear message, no absolute truth.

senses.definition_vi: rõ ràng và không có bất kỳ nghi ngờ nào

senses.definition: (of a legal decision) final

examples.x: The divorce became absolute last week.

senses.definition_vi: (về một quyết định pháp lý) cuối cùng

senses.definition: not limited in any way

examples.x: absolute power/authority
an absolute ruler/monarchy (= one with no limit to their power)

senses.definition_vi: không bị giới hạn dưới bất kỳ hình thức nào

senses.definition: existing or measured independently and not in relation to something else

examples.x: Although prices are falling in absolute terms, energy is still expensive.
Beauty cannot be measured by any absolute standard.

senses.definition_vi: tồn tại hoặc được đo lường một cách độc lập và không liên quan đến thứ khác

senses.definition: used to emphasize that something is completely true

examples.x: You're absolutely right.
He made it absolutely clear.
I'm not absolutely certain I posted it.
Are you absolutely sure?
Training is absolutely essential in this business.
Don't delay for longer than absolutely necessary.
The place was absolutely packed.
It was absolutely pouring with rain.

senses.definition_vi: được sử dụng để nhấn mạnh rằng điều gì đó hoàn toàn đúng

senses.definition: used to emphasize something negative

examples.x: That man does absolutely no work!
There's absolutely nothing more the doctors can do.

senses.definition_vi: được sử dụng để nhấn mạnh một điều gì đó tiêu cực

senses.definition: used with adjectives or verbs that express strong feelings or extreme qualities to mean ‘extremely’

examples.x: absolutely delighted/thrilled
We were absolutely devastated at the news.
I absolutely love strawberries.
She absolutely adores you.
absolutely fantastic/amazing
He's an absolutely brilliant cook.

senses.definition_vi: được sử dụng với các tính từ hoặc động từ diễn tả cảm xúc mạnh mẽ hoặc phẩm chất cực đoan để có nghĩa là 'cực kỳ'

senses.definition: used to emphasize that you agree with somebody, or to give somebody permission to do something

examples.x: ‘They could have told us, couldn't they?’ ‘Absolutely!’
‘Can we leave a little early?’ ‘Absolutely!’

senses.definition_vi: được sử dụng để nhấn mạnh rằng bạn đồng ý với ai đó, hoặc để cho phép ai đó làm điều gì đó

senses.definition: used to emphasize that you strongly disagree with somebody, or to refuse permission

examples.x: ‘Was it any good?’ ‘No, absolutely not.’
‘Can I stay up late?’ ‘Absolutely not!’

senses.definition_vi: được sử dụng để nhấn mạnh rằng bạn hoàn toàn không đồng ý với ai đó, hoặc để từ chối cho phép

senses.definition: not considered in relation to other things

examples.x: White-collar crime increased both absolutely and in comparison with other categories.

senses.definition_vi: không được xem xét liên quan đến những thứ khác

senses.definition: extremely silly; not logical and sensible

examples.x: That uniform makes the guards look absurd.
Of course it's not true, what an absurd idea.

senses.definition_vi: cực kỳ ngớ ngẩn; không logic và hợp lý

senses.definition: things that are or that seem to be absurd

examples.x: He has a good sense of the absurd.

senses.definition_vi: những điều là hoặc có vẻ là vô lý

senses.definition: to take willingly something that is offered; to say ‘yes’ to an offer, invitation, etc.

examples.x: He asked me to marry him and I accepted.
Please accept our sincere apologies.
It was pouring with rain so I accepted his offer of a lift.
I am unfortunately unable to accept your kind invitation.
The board of directors accepted our proposal.
She's decided not to accept the job.
Please accept this small token of my appreciation.
He is charged with accepting bribes from a firm of suppliers.
She said she'd accept $15 for it.

senses.definition_vi: sẵn lòng nhận lấy thứ gì đó được đề nghị; nói 'có' với một lời đề nghị, lời mời, v.v.

senses.definition: to agree to or approve of something

examples.x: They accepted the court's decision.
The judge refused to accept his evidence.
He accepted all the changes we proposed.
Are you willing to accept the challenge?
She won't accept advice from anyone.
My article has been accepted for publication.

senses.definition_vi: đồng ý hoặc phê duyệt một cái gì đó

senses.definition: to take payment in a particular form

examples.x: This machine only accepts coins.
Credit cards are widely accepted.

senses.definition_vi: chấp nhận thanh toán dưới một hình thức cụ thể

senses.definition: to admit that you are responsible or to blame for something

examples.x: He accepts full responsibility for what happened.
You have to accept the consequences of your actions.

senses.definition_vi: thừa nhận rằng bạn chịu trách nhiệm hoặc có lỗi về điều gì đó

senses.definition: to continue in a difficult situation without complaining, because you realize that you cannot change it

examples.x: You just have to accept the fact that we're never going to be rich.
to be willing/prepared to accept something
Nothing will change as long as the workers continue to accept these appalling conditions.
They accept the risks as part of the job.
He just refused to accept that his father was no longer there.

senses.definition_vi: tiếp tục trong một tình huống khó khăn mà không phàn nàn, vì bạn nhận ra rằng bạn không thể thay đổi nó

senses.definition: to make somebody feel welcome and part of a group

examples.x: It may take years to be completely accepted by the local community.
She had never been accepted into what was essentially a man's world.
He never really accepted her as his own child.

senses.definition_vi: làm cho ai đó cảm thấy được chào đón và là một phần của nhóm

senses.definition: to believe that something is true

examples.x: I don't accept his version of events.
Can we accept his account as the true version?
I accept that this will not be popular.
I am not prepared to accept that this decision is final.
It is generally accepted that people are motivated by success.

examples.cf: something is accepted to be, have, etc. something
examples.x: Their workforce is widely accepted to have the best conditions in Europe.

senses.definition_vi: tin rằng điều gì đó là đúng

senses.definition: to allow somebody to join an organization, attend an institution, use a service, etc.

examples.x: The college he applied to has accepted him.
She was disappointed not to be accepted into the club.
The landlord was willing to accept us as tenants.
She was accepted to study music.

senses.definition_vi: cho phép ai đó tham gia một tổ chức, theo học một cơ sở, sử dụng một dịch vụ, v.v.

senses.definition: agreed or approved of by most people in a society

examples.x: Children must learn socially acceptable behaviour.
It is perfectly acceptable for you as an employee to say no.

senses.definition_vi: được hầu hết mọi người trong xã hội đồng ý hoặc chấp thuận

senses.definition: that somebody agrees is of a good enough standard or allowed

examples.x: For this course a pass in English at grade B is acceptable.
Air pollution in the city had reached four times the acceptable levels.
We want a political solution that is acceptable to all parties.
It is possible to find a solution that is acceptable to both sides.

senses.definition_vi: mà ai đó đồng ý là có đủ tiêu chuẩn tốt hoặc được phép

senses.definition: not very good but good enough

examples.x: The food was acceptable, but no more.
Inspectors found that teaching standards were acceptable, but could be improved.

senses.definition_vi: không quá tốt nhưng đủ tốt

senses.definition: the act of accepting a gift, an invitation, an offer, etc.

examples.x: Please confirm your acceptance of this offer in writing.
He made a short acceptance speech/speech of acceptance.
Invitations have been sent out and 80 acceptances have already been received.
So far we have had one refusal and three acceptances.

senses.definition_vi: hành động chấp nhận một món quà, một lời mời, một lời đề nghị, v.v.

senses.definition: the act of agreeing with something and approving of it

examples.x: The new laws have gained widespread acceptance.

senses.definition_vi: hành động đồng ý với điều gì đó và tán thành nó

senses.definition: the process of allowing somebody to join something or be a member of a group

examples.x: Your acceptance into the insurance plan is guaranteed.
Social acceptance is important for most young people.
The group is now seeking formal acceptance.

senses.definition_vi: quá trình cho phép ai đó tham gia vào một cái gì đó hoặc trở thành thành viên của một nhóm

senses.definition: the quality of being willing to accept an unpleasant or difficult situation

examples.x: acceptance of death/suffering

senses.definition_vi: phẩm chất sẵn sàng chấp nhận một tình huống khó chịu hoặc khó khăn

senses.definition: by chance; in a way that was not planned

examples.x: As I turned around, I accidentally hit him in the face.
The damage couldn't have been caused accidentally.

senses.definition_vi: bằng sự ngẫu nhiên; theo một cách không được lên kế hoạch

senses.definition: to succeed in doing or completing something

examples.x: The first part of the plan has been safely accomplished.
I don't feel I've accomplished very much today.
That's it. Mission accomplished (= we have done what we aimed to do).

senses.definition_vi: thành công trong việc làm hoặc hoàn thành một cái gì đó

senses.definition: an impressive thing that is done or achieved after a lot of work

examples.x: It was one of the President's greatest accomplishments.
The series of paintings is quite an accomplishment.

senses.definition_vi: một điều ấn tượng được thực hiện hoặc đạt được sau nhiều công việc

senses.definition: a skill or special ability

examples.x: Drawing and singing were among her many accomplishments.
He was described as ‘a poet of rare accomplishment’.

senses.definition_vi: một kỹ năng hoặc khả năng đặc biệt

senses.definition: the successful completing of something

examples.x: Money will be crucial to the accomplishment of our objectives.
There is a real sense of accomplishment when everything goes right.

senses.definition_vi: việc hoàn thành thành công một cái gì đó

senses.definition: according to a rule or the way that somebody says that something should be done

examples.x: in accordance with legal requirements
We acted in accordance with my parents’ wishes.

senses.definition_vi: theo một quy tắc hoặc cách mà ai đó nói rằng một cái gì đó nên được thực hiện

senses.definition: to succeed in reaching a particular goal, status or standard, especially by making an effort for a long time

examples.x: He had finally achieved success.
They have both achieved great results.
She has worked hard to achieve her goal.
to achieve an objective/aim
They could not achieve their target of less than 3% inflation.
The firm has achieved the status of undisputed market leader.
Course objectives were achieved through a range of activities.

senses.definition_vi: thành công trong việc đạt được một mục tiêu, địa vị hoặc tiêu chuẩn cụ thể, đặc biệt là bằng cách nỗ lực trong một thời gian dài

senses.definition: to succeed in doing something or causing something to happen

examples.x: I haven't achieved very much today.
All you've achieved is to upset my parents.

senses.definition_vi: thành công trong việc làm điều gì đó hoặc khiến điều gì đó xảy ra

senses.definition: to be successful

examples.x: Their difficult home life makes it harder for them to achieve at school.
These students need to achieve academically in order to enter the labour market.

senses.definition_vi: thành công

senses.definition: a thing that somebody has done successfully, especially using their own effort and skill

examples.x: the greatest scientific achievement of the decade
sporting/artistic/academic achievements
It was a remarkable achievement for such a young player.
an outstanding achievement
This work is the crowning achievement (= the greatest achievement) of her career.
They were proud of their children's achievements.

senses.definition_vi: một điều mà ai đó đã làm thành công, đặc biệt là bằng nỗ lực và kỹ năng của riêng họ

senses.definition: the act or process of achieving something

examples.x: the need to raise standards of academic/educational achievement
He won a lifetime achievement award for cinematography.
Even a small success gives you a sense of achievement (= a feeling of pride).

senses.definition_vi: hành động hoặc quá trình đạt được một cái gì đó

senses.definition: a reward that you can earn in some video games by completing a challenge or level

examples.x: If you complete the game in less than twelve hours, you are awarded an achievement at the end.

senses.definition_vi: một phần thưởng mà bạn có thể kiếm được trong một số trò chơi điện tử bằng cách hoàn thành một thử thách hoặc cấp độ

senses.definition: to accept that something is true

examples.x: She refuses to acknowledge the need for reform.
I have to acknowledge the fact that I am partly responsible.
It's a generally acknowledged fact.
Most people acknowledge the existence of evil.
to openly/publicly/readily acknowledge something
He does not acknowledge that he has done anything wrong.

examples.cf: acknowledge something to be, have, etc. something
examples.x: It is generally acknowledged to be true.

senses.definition_vi: chấp nhận rằng một điều gì đó là đúng

senses.definition: to accept that somebody/something has a particular authority or status

examples.x: The country acknowledged his claim to the throne.
The peace settlement effectively acknowledged the country's independence.
He is widely acknowledged as the best player in the world.

examples.cf: be acknowledged to be, have, etc. something
examples.x: He is widely acknowledged to be the best player in the world.

senses.definition_vi: chấp nhận rằng ai đó/điều gì đó có một thẩm quyền hoặc địa vị nhất định

senses.definition: to tell somebody that you have received something that they sent to you

examples.x: All applications will be acknowledged.
Please acknowledge receipt of this letter.

senses.definition_vi: cho ai đó biết rằng bạn đã nhận được thứ gì đó mà họ đã gửi cho bạn

senses.definition: to show that you have noticed somebody/something by smiling, waving, etc.

examples.x: I was standing right next to her, but she didn't even acknowledge me.
He waved, acknowledging the applause.

senses.definition_vi: cho thấy bạn đã nhận thấy ai đó/điều gì đó bằng cách mỉm cười, vẫy tay, v.v.

senses.definition: to publicly express thanks for help you have been given

examples.x: I gratefully acknowledge financial support from several local businesses.
He is always ready to acknowledge his debt to his teachers.

senses.definition_vi: bày tỏ công khai sự cảm ơn vì sự giúp đỡ bạn đã nhận được

senses.definition: to gain something by your own efforts, ability or behaviour

examples.x: She has acquired a good knowledge of English.
How long will it take to acquire the necessary skills?
I would love to apply these newly acquired skills to a job that I enjoy.
He has acquired a reputation for dishonesty.
I have recently acquired a taste for olives.

senses.definition_vi: giành được một cái gì đó bằng nỗ lực, khả năng hoặc hành vi của riêng bạn

senses.definition: to obtain something by buying or being given it

examples.x: Not all of the land acquired for the road has been paid for yet.
The country has pledged not to acquire nuclear weapons.
Property acquired through crime will be confiscated.
The company has just acquired new premises.
How did the gallery come to acquire so many Picassos?
I've suddenly acquired a stepbrother.

senses.definition_vi: nhận được một cái gì đó bằng cách mua hoặc được tặng

senses.definition: a thing that you do not like much at first but gradually learn to like

examples.x: Abstract art is an acquired taste.

senses.definition_vi: một thứ mà bạn không thích lắm lúc đầu nhưng dần dần học cách thích

senses.definition: a particular thing that somebody does

examples.x: You have committed a serious criminal act.
an act of kindness
This was one of the most appalling acts of terror of recent times.
acts of terrorism/violence/aggression
They performed acts of great heroism.
The murder was the act of a psychopath.

senses.definition_vi: một điều cụ thể mà ai đó làm

senses.definition: a law that has been passed by a parliament

examples.x: an Act of Congress/Parliament
the Care Act 2014
to pass/repeal/amend an Act
A Committee on Safety of Medicines was set up under the Act.

senses.definition_vi: một luật đã được quốc hội thông qua

senses.definition: a way of behaving that is not sincere but is intended to have a particular effect on others

examples.x: Don't take her seriously—it's all an act.
You could tell he was just putting on an act.

senses.definition_vi: một cách cư xử không chân thật mà có ý định tạo ra một tác động nhất định đến người khác

senses.definition: one of the main divisions of a play, an opera, etc.

examples.x: a play in five acts
The hero dies in Act 5, Scene 3.
The king is killed in the opening act.

senses.definition_vi: một trong những phần chính của một vở kịch, một vở opera, v.v.

senses.definition: a performance, especially one of several short pieces of entertainment in a show

examples.x: a circus/comedy/magic act
her one-woman poetry act

senses.definition_vi: một buổi biểu diễn, đặc biệt là một trong nhiều tiết mục giải trí ngắn trong một chương trình

senses.definition: a performer or group of musicians

examples.x: They were one of rock's most impressive live acts.

senses.definition_vi: một nghệ sĩ biểu diễn hoặc một nhóm nhạc sĩ

senses.definition: an event caused by natural forces beyond human control, such as a storm, a flood or an earthquake
senses.definition_vi: một sự kiện gây ra bởi các lực lượng tự nhiên nằm ngoài tầm kiểm soát của con người, chẳng hạn như bão, lũ lụt hoặc động đất

senses.definition: to be/become involved in an activity that somebody else has started, especially to get something for yourself

examples.x: Other manufacturers are getting in on the act, creating their own versions of the popular toy.

senses.definition_vi: trở thành/trở nên tham gia vào một hoạt động mà người khác đã bắt đầu, đặc biệt là để tự mình đạt được điều gì đó

senses.definition: to start behaving in a moral or responsible way

examples.x: He's cleaned up his act since his university days.

senses.definition_vi: bắt đầu hành động một cách đạo đức hoặc có trách nhiệm

senses.definition: to go away or be impossible to find when people need or want you

examples.x: The cat had done a disappearing act.

senses.definition_vi: đi đi hoặc không thể tìm thấy khi mọi người cần hoặc muốn bạn

senses.definition: to organize yourself and your activities in a more effective way in order to achieve something

examples.x: She needs to get her act together if she's going to pass.

senses.definition_vi: tổ chức bản thân và các hoạt động của bạn một cách hiệu quả hơn để đạt được một cái gì đó

senses.definition: a person or event that is so good or successful at something that it will be difficult for anyone/anything else coming after them to be as good or successful

examples.x: She has been an excellent principal and will be a hard act to follow.
Their contribution will prove a tough act to follow.

senses.definition_vi: một người hoặc sự kiện xuất sắc hoặc thành công đến mức sẽ rất khó để bất kỳ ai/bất kỳ điều gì tiếp theo có thể tốt hoặc thành công như vậy

senses.definition: while you are doing something

examples.x: He was caught in the act of stealing a car.
It is often difficult to tell when someone is using drugs unless they are caught in the act.

senses.definition_vi: trong khi bạn đang làm điều gì đó

senses.definition: to tell somebody with force that they must not do something
senses.definition_vi: nói với ai đó một cách mạnh mẽ rằng họ không được làm điều gì đó

senses.definition: the process of doing something in order to make something happen or to deal with a situation

examples.x: The time has come for action if these beautiful animals are to survive.
to threaten/demand/call for action
Firefighters took action immediately to stop the blaze spreading.
Divers were close at hand, ready to go into action if the stunt went wrong.
What is the best course of action in the circumstances?
She began to explain her plan of action to the group.
The men face disciplinary action.

senses.definition_vi: quá trình làm điều gì đó để làm cho điều gì đó xảy ra hoặc để giải quyết một tình huống

senses.definition: a thing that somebody does

examples.x: Each of us must take responsibility for our own actions.
They sought to justify their actions.

senses.definition_vi: một việc mà ai đó làm.

senses.definition: things that workers do, especially stopping work, to protest to their employers about something

examples.x: Workers voted in favour of strike action.
They called off their action at 7.40 a.m. after the meeting was arranged.
Unions said the action could be suspended early on Friday if talks between the two sides resumed.
The government began taking a hard line against labour actions.

senses.definition_vi: những việc mà người lao động làm, đặc biệt là ngừng làm việc, để phản đối người sử dụng lao động về điều gì đó.

senses.definition: a legal process to stop a person or company from doing something, or to make them pay for a mistake, etc.

examples.x: A libel action is being brought against the magazine that published the article.
He is considering taking legal action against the hospital.

senses.definition_vi: một quy trình pháp lý để ngăn chặn một người hoặc công ty làm điều gì đó, hoặc để buộc họ bồi thường cho một sai lầm, v.v.

senses.definition: fighting in a battle or war

examples.x: The possibility of taking military action has not been ruled out.
I never saw action during the war.
soldiers killed in action

senses.definition_vi: chiến đấu trong một trận chiến hoặc chiến tranh.

senses.definition: the events in a story, play, etc.

examples.x: The action takes place in France.

senses.definition_vi: các sự kiện trong một câu chuyện, vở kịch, v.v.

senses.definition: exciting events

examples.x: I like films with plenty of action.
New York is where the action is.
If you want to know where all the action is around here, just ask Jo.

senses.definition_vi: các sự kiện thú vị.

senses.definition: the effect that something such as a chemical has on something

examples.x: Vitamin D can be made in the body by the action of sunlight on the skin.
The action of the rushing water cleans the gully.

senses.definition_vi: hiệu quả mà một thứ gì đó như hóa chất tác động lên một thứ khác.

senses.definition: the way a part of the body moves or functions

examples.x: a study of the action of the liver

senses.definition_vi: cách một bộ phận cơ thể di chuyển hoặc hoạt động.

senses.definition: the mechanical parts of a piano, gun, clock, etc. or the way the parts move
senses.definition_vi: các bộ phận cơ khí của một cây đàn piano, súng, đồng hồ, v.v. hoặc cách các bộ phận di chuyển.

senses.definition: what a person actually does means more than what they say they will do
senses.definition_vi: điều một người thực sự làm quan trọng hơn những gì họ nói sẽ làm.

senses.definition: if somebody/something is in action, they are doing the activity or work that is typical for them

examples.x: Just press the button to see your favourite character in action.
I've yet to see all the players in action.
I have not yet seen the machines in action.

senses.definition_vi: nếu ai đó/cái gì đó đang hoạt động, họ đang thực hiện hoạt động hoặc công việc điển hình của họ.

senses.definition: if you put an idea or a plan into action, you start making it happen or work

examples.x: The new plan for traffic control is being put into action on an experimental basis.
We need to put these ideas into action.

senses.definition_vi: nếu bạn biến một ý tưởng hoặc kế hoạch thành hành động, bạn bắt đầu làm cho nó xảy ra hoặc hoạt động.

senses.definition: not able to work or be used because of injury or damage

examples.x: Jon will be out of action for weeks with a broken leg.
The photocopier is out of action today.
She is out of action following an ankle injury.

senses.definition_vi: không thể hoạt động hoặc sử dụng được do bị thương hoặc hư hỏng.

senses.definition: a share or role in an interesting or exciting activity, especially one that makes money

examples.x: Foreign firms will all want a piece of the action if the new airport goes ahead.

senses.definition_vi: một phần hoặc vai trò trong một hoạt động thú vị hoặc hấp dẫn, đặc biệt là hoạt động tạo ra tiền.

senses.definition: to suddenly start working or doing something

examples.x: ‘Let's go!’ he said, springing into action.
The town springs to life (= becomes busy) during the carnival.

senses.definition_vi: bắt đầu hoạt động hoặc làm điều gì đó đột ngột.

senses.definition: to start doing something quickly and with a lot of energy

examples.x: The ambulance crew swung into action to resuscitate the patient.
The rescue operation swung into action immediately.
The emergency services swung into action as soon as the disaster was reported.

senses.definition_vi: bắt đầu làm điều gì đó một cách nhanh chóng và với nhiều năng lượng.

senses.definition: to act in order to avoid danger or an unpleasant situation

examples.x: The pilot had to take evasive action to avoid a mid-air collision.

senses.definition_vi: hành động để tránh nguy hiểm hoặc một tình huống khó chịu.

senses.definition: always busy doing things, especially physical activities

examples.x: Staying physically active in later years can also keep you feeling younger.
Before our modern age, people had a more physical and active lifestyle.

senses.definition_vi: luôn bận rộn làm việc, đặc biệt là các hoạt động thể chất.

senses.definition: involved in something; making a determined effort and not leaving something to happen by itself

examples.x: They were both politically active.
his active involvement/participation in the arts
She takes an active part in school life.
He still has an active role in running the company.
an active participant/member
He is an active member of several professional organizations.
At 50, I'm an active participant in my community.
She remained active in politics until her death.
The parents were active in campaigning against cuts to the education budget.
They took active steps to prevent the spread of the disease.

senses.definition_vi: tham gia vào một việc gì đó; nỗ lực quyết tâm và không để mọi thứ tự diễn ra.

senses.definition: doing something regularly; functioning

examples.x: Numbers of sexually active teenagers have continued to rise.
These animals are active only at night.
The virus is still active in the blood.
an active volcano (= likely to erupt)

senses.definition_vi: đang làm điều gì đó thường xuyên; đang hoạt động.

senses.definition: lively and full of ideas

examples.x: That child has a very active imagination.
It's important to remain mentally active after retirement.

senses.definition_vi: sinh động và đầy ý tưởng.

senses.definition: working; in use or able to be used

examples.x: The old watermill was active until 1960.
Ensure the website URL is an active link.

senses.definition_vi: đang hoạt động; đang được sử dụng hoặc có thể sử dụng được.

senses.definition: having or causing a chemical effect

examples.x: What is the active ingredient in aspirin?
drugs that are active against cancers

senses.definition_vi: có hoặc gây ra tác dụng hóa học.

senses.definition: connected with a verb whose subject is the person or thing that performs the action

examples.x: In ‘He was driving the car’, the verb is active.

senses.definition_vi: liên quan đến một động từ có chủ ngữ là người hoặc vật thực hiện hành động.

senses.definition: a thing that you do for interest or pleasure

examples.x: leisure/outdoor/recreational activities
The club provides a wide variety of activities including tennis, swimming and squash.

senses.definition_vi: một việc bạn làm vì sở thích hoặc niềm vui.

senses.definition: a thing that somebody does in order to achieve a particular aim

examples.x: criminal/terrorist/illegal activities
The book contains plenty of ideas for classroom activities.
He has decided to focus his time and resources on his business activities.
We met to review progress and to coordinate our activities.

senses.definition_vi: một việc ai đó làm để đạt được một mục tiêu cụ thể.

senses.definition: a situation in which something is happening or a lot of things are being done

examples.x: Economic activity has taken a downturn this year.
The streets were noisy and full of activity.
Muscles contract and relax during physical activity.
There was no criminal activity involved.
The machines can monitor brain activity.

senses.definition_vi: một tình huống mà điều gì đó đang xảy ra hoặc nhiều việc đang được thực hiện.

senses.definition: used to emphasize something that is real or exists in fact

examples.x: James looks younger than his wife but in actual fact (= really) he is five years older.
The actual cost was higher than we expected.
The actual number of unemployed is more than 15 million.
What were his actual words?
A variety of factors could cause our actual results to differ from the expected results.
The story of the film is based on actual events and people.

senses.definition_vi: được sử dụng để nhấn mạnh một cái gì đó là thật hoặc tồn tại trên thực tế.

senses.definition: used to emphasize the most important part of something

examples.x: The rehearsal was fabulous, the actual performance even better.
The wedding preparations take weeks but the actual ceremony takes less than an hour.

senses.definition_vi: được sử dụng để nhấn mạnh phần quan trọng nhất của một cái gì đó.

senses.definition: to put something together with something else so as to increase the size, number, amount, etc.

examples.x: Next add the flour.
The juice contains no added sugar.
As an added bonus, the book includes many black-and-white photographs.
Melt the butter, then add the onion.
The plan has the added (= extra) advantage of bringing employment to rural areas.
Shall I add your name to the list?
They are looking at ways to add further value to their products.
There are a number of ways to add emphasis to words on a web page.
A new wing was added to the building.
Chlorine is added to the water to kill bacteria.

senses.definition_vi: để đặt một thứ gì đó cùng với một thứ khác để tăng kích thước, số lượng, v.v.

senses.definition: to put numbers or amounts together to get a total

examples.x: He knew how to add and subtract.
Add 9 to the total.
If you add all these amounts together you get a huge figure.

senses.definition_vi: để cộng các số hoặc số lượng lại với nhau để có được tổng số.

senses.definition: to say something more; to make a further remark

examples.x: ‘And don't be late,’ she added.
I have nothing to add to my earlier statement.
Do you have anything to add?
He added that they would return a week later.
‘The hotel is child-friendly,’ she said, adding that special rates apply to children.

senses.definition_vi: để nói thêm điều gì đó; để đưa ra một nhận xét tiếp theo.

senses.definition: to give a particular quality to an event, a situation, etc.

examples.x: The suite will add a touch of class to your bedroom.
The Easter Festival added a new dimension to Salzburg's musical life.

senses.definition_vi: để mang lại một phẩm chất nhất định cho một sự kiện, một tình huống, v.v.

senses.definition: used to introduce another fact that helps to emphasize a point you have already made

examples.x: Add to this the excellent service and you can see why it's the most popular hotel on the island.

senses.definition_vi: được sử dụng để giới thiệu một sự thật khác giúp nhấn mạnh một điểm bạn đã đưa ra.

senses.definition: to make a bad relationship with somebody worse by offending them even more

examples.x: Then, to add insult to injury, they told me I couldn't get on the flight.
It adds insult to injury that banks are allowed to increase their charges without our knowledge or consent.
Only 300 people came to the match and, to add insult to injury, the floodlights went out during the second half.

senses.definition_vi: để làm cho một mối quan hệ tồi tệ với ai đó trở nên tồi tệ hơn bằng cách xúc phạm họ nhiều hơn.

senses.definition: a thing that is added to something else

examples.x: All of these technologies are fairly recent additions.
the latest addition to our range of cars
This is a welcome addition to the literature of western art history.

senses.definition_vi: một thứ được thêm vào thứ khác.

senses.definition: the act of adding something to something else

examples.x: Add salt, tasting with every addition.
Pasta's basic ingredients are flour and water, sometimes with the addition of eggs or oil.

senses.definition_vi: hành động cộng một thứ gì đó vào thứ khác.

senses.definition: a new part that is added to a building

examples.x: architects who specialize in home additions
The addition should match the architecture of the house.

senses.definition_vi: một phần mới được thêm vào một tòa nhà.

senses.definition: the process of adding two or more numbers together to find their total

examples.x: children learning addition and subtraction

senses.definition_vi: quá trình cộng hai hoặc nhiều số lại với nhau để tìm ra tổng của chúng.

senses.definition: used when you want to mention another person or thing after something else

examples.x: In addition to these arrangements, extra ambulances will be on duty until midnight.
There is, in addition, one further point to make.

senses.definition_vi: được sử dụng khi bạn muốn đề cập đến một người hoặc vật khác sau một thứ khác.

senses.definition: more than was first mentioned or is usual

examples.x: additional resources/funds/security/funding/costs
The government provided an additional £25 million to expand the service.
He provided additional information about this incident.

senses.definition_vi: nhiều hơn những gì được đề cập ban đầu hoặc thông thường

senses.definition: in a way that is more than was first mentioned or is usual

examples.x: Additionally, the bus service will run on Sundays, every two hours.

senses.definition_vi: theo cách nhiều hơn những gì được đề cập ban đầu hoặc thông thường

senses.definition: details of where somebody lives or works and where letters, etc. can be sent

examples.x: What's your name and address?
I'll give you my address and phone number.
Is that your home address?
Please note my change of address.
There was no return address on the envelope.
Each entry must include a valid mailing address.
a postal address
Police found him at an address (= a house or flat) in West London.
people with no fixed address (= with no permanent home)

senses.definition_vi: chi tiết về nơi ai đó sống hoặc làm việc và nơi thư từ, v.v. có thể được gửi đến

senses.definition: a series of words and symbols that tells you where you can find something using a computer or phone, for example on the internet

examples.x: What's your email address?
The project has a new web address.

senses.definition_vi: một chuỗi các từ và ký hiệu cho bạn biết nơi bạn có thể tìm thấy thứ gì đó bằng máy tính hoặc điện thoại, ví dụ trên internet

senses.definition: a formal speech that is made in front of an audience

examples.x: tonight’s televised presidential address

senses.definition_vi: một bài phát biểu trang trọng được thực hiện trước khán giả

senses.definition: the correct title, etc. to use when you talk to somebody
senses.definition_vi: chức danh chính xác, v.v. để sử dụng khi bạn nói chuyện với ai đó

senses.definition: enough in quantity, or good enough in quality, for a particular purpose or need

examples.x: They'll need an adequate supply of hot water.
The room was small but adequate.
There is a lack of adequate provision for students who use wheelchairs.
He didn't give an adequate answer to the question.
The space available is not adequate for our needs.
training that is adequate to meet the future needs of industry

senses.definition_vi: đủ về số lượng, hoặc đủ tốt về chất lượng, cho một mục đích hoặc nhu cầu cụ thể

senses.definition: in a way that is enough in quantity, or good enough in quality, for a particular purpose or need

examples.x: Are you adequately insured?

senses.definition_vi: theo cách đủ về số lượng, hoặc đủ tốt về chất lượng, cho một mục đích hoặc nhu cầu cụ thể

senses.definition: to stick to something

examples.x: Once in the bloodstream, the bacteria adhere to the surface of the red cells.
Clean the surface first, or the paint will not adhere.
There was oil adhering to the bird’s feathers.
The tiles may not adhere properly if you do not use the correct glue.

senses.definition_vi: dính vào một cái gì đó

senses.definition: next to something

examples.x: The planes landed on adjacent runways.
numbers that are adjacent in the sequence
Our farm land was adjacent to the river.
The vineyards of Verzy lie adjacent to those of Verzenay.
There is a row of houses immediately adjacent to the factory.

senses.definition_vi: bên cạnh một cái gì đó

senses.definition: to change something slightly to make it more suitable for a new set of conditions or to make it work better

examples.x: Watch out for sharp bends and adjust your speed accordingly.
This button is for adjusting the volume.
The brakes need to be adjusted.
Adjust your language to the age of your audience.

senses.definition_vi: thay đổi một chút để làm cho nó phù hợp hơn với một bộ điều kiện mới hoặc để nó hoạt động tốt hơn

senses.definition: to get used to a new situation by changing the way you behave and/or think

examples.x: They'll be fine—they just need time to adjust.
After a while his eyes adjusted to the dark.
It took her a while to adjust to living alone.
It can be difficult to adjust to being a parent.
You'll quickly adjust yourself to student life.
My eyes were still trying to adjust themselves to the strong sunlight.

senses.definition_vi: làm quen với một tình huống mới bằng cách thay đổi cách bạn cư xử và/hoặc suy nghĩ

senses.definition: to move something slightly so that it looks neater or feels more comfortable

examples.x: He smoothed his hair and adjusted his tie.

senses.definition_vi: di chuyển một chút để nó trông gọn gàng hơn hoặc cảm thấy thoải mái hơn

senses.definition: used to acknowledge and apologize for something that causes problems or difficulties and ask people to accept and adapt to the situation

examples.x: The store will be closed this afternoon due to staffing shortages. Kindly adjust.

senses.definition_vi: được sử dụng để thừa nhận và xin lỗi về một điều gì đó gây ra vấn đề hoặc khó khăn và yêu cầu mọi người chấp nhận và thích nghi với tình huống

senses.definition: a small change made to something in order to correct or improve it

examples.x: I've made a few adjustments to the design.
Some adjustment of the lens may be necessary.

senses.definition_vi: một thay đổi nhỏ được thực hiện đối với một cái gì đó để sửa chữa hoặc cải thiện nó

senses.definition: a change in the way a person behaves or thinks

examples.x: She went through a period of emotional adjustment after her marriage broke up.
The process of adjustment to life in another country can be very difficult.
There was a long period of adjustment under the new boss.

senses.definition_vi: một sự thay đổi trong cách một người cư xử hoặc suy nghĩ

senses.definition: to respect somebody for what they have done or to respect their qualities

examples.x: I really admire your enthusiasm.
Her work was much admired by critics.
You have to admire the way he handled the situation.
Actually, I greatly admire and respect him.
The school is widely admired for its excellent teaching.
I don't agree with her, but I admire her for sticking to her principles.

senses.definition_vi: tôn trọng ai đó vì những gì họ đã làm hoặc tôn trọng phẩm chất của họ

senses.definition: to look at something and think that it is attractive and/or impressive

examples.x: He stood back to admire his handiwork.
I've just been admiring your new car.
Let’s just sit and admire the view.

senses.definition_vi: nhìn một cái gì đó và nghĩ rằng nó hấp dẫn và/hoặc ấn tượng

senses.definition: to agree, often unwillingly, that something is true

examples.x: It was a stupid thing to do, I admit.
‘I'm very nervous,’ she admitted reluctantly.
Don't be afraid to admit to your mistakes.
She admits to being strict with her children.
He admitted all his mistakes.
She stubbornly refuses to admit the truth.
Why don't you just admit defeat (= recognize that you cannot do something) and let someone else try?
I hate to admit it, but I think he is right.
Admit it! You were terrified!
I'm almost ashamed to admit it, but I watch this show.
They freely admit (that) they still have a lot to learn.
You must admit that it all sounds very strange.
She readily admits mistakes were made.
I couldn't admit to my parents that I was finding the course difficult.
It was generally admitted that the government had acted too quickly.
The appointment is now generally admitted to have been a mistake.

senses.definition_vi: đồng ý, thường là miễn cưỡng, rằng một điều gì đó là đúng

senses.definition: to say that you have done something wrong or illegal

examples.x: He refused to admit to the other charges.
She admitted to having stolen the car.
She admitted theft.
He refused to admit his guilt.
The hospital has admitted liability for the accident.
She admitted having driven the car without insurance.

senses.definition_vi: nói rằng bạn đã làm điều gì đó sai trái hoặc bất hợp pháp

senses.definition: to allow somebody/something to enter a place

examples.x: Each ticket admits one adult.
You will not be admitted to the theatre after the performance has started.
The narrow windows admit little light into the room.

senses.definition_vi: cho phép ai đó/cái gì đó vào một địa điểm

senses.definition: to allow somebody to become a member of a club, a school or an organization

examples.x: The society admits all US citizens over 21.
Women were only admitted into the club last year.

‘That's true’, she agreed.
I totally agree with you!
You can't expect them to agree on everything.
He agreed with them about the need for change.
Many experts agree wholeheartedly with this statement.
I tend to agree with her political views.
All parties agree (that) urgent action is required.
We agreed (that) the proposal was a good one.
‘It's terrible.’ ‘I couldn't agree more!’ (= I completely agree)

senses.definition_vi: có cùng ý kiến với ai đó; nói rằng bạn có cùng ý kiến

senses.definition: to approve of something because you think it is morally right

examples.x: I don't agree with hitting children as a punishment.
I'm not sure I agree with the government's policy on this.

senses.definition_vi: tán thành điều gì đó vì bạn nghĩ rằng điều đó đúng về mặt đạo đức

senses.definition: to say ‘yes’; to say that you will do what somebody wants or that you will allow something to happen

examples.x: I asked for a pay rise and she agreed.
The government has finally agreed in principle (= agreed in general but not in detail) to the terms of the deal.
Do you think he'll agree to their proposal?
She agreed (that) I could go early.
He reluctantly agreed to pay for the damage.
She agreed to let me go early.

senses.definition_vi: nói ‘vâng’; nói rằng bạn sẽ làm những gì ai đó muốn hoặc bạn sẽ cho phép điều gì đó xảy ra

senses.definition: to decide with somebody else to do something or to have something

examples.x: Can we agree on a date?
The new plan was agreed upon between the two sides.
They met at the agreed time.
Can we agree a price?
We agreed to meet on Thursday.
We couldn't agree what to do.
They left at ten, as agreed.

senses.definition_vi: quyết định cùng với người khác để làm điều gì đó hoặc để có điều gì đó

senses.definition: to officially accept a plan, request, etc.

examples.x: The company agreed a deal worth $100 million.
Next year's budget has been agreed.
We arranged to meet a few days later and agree terms.

senses.definition_vi: chính thức chấp nhận một kế hoạch, yêu cầu, v.v.

senses.definition: to be the same as something

examples.x: The figures do not agree.
Your account of the accident does not agree with hers.

senses.definition_vi: giống với một cái gì đó

senses.definition: to match a word or phrase in number, gender or person

examples.x: In ‘Tom likes jazz’, the singular verb ‘likes’ agrees with the subject ‘Tom’.

senses.definition_vi: khớp với một từ hoặc cụm từ về số lượng, giống hoặc ngôi

senses.definition: if two people agree to differ/disagree, they accept that they have different opinions about something, but they decide not to discuss it any longer

examples.x: We must just agree to differ on this.
In the end we agreed to disagree.
I think you're wrong. Let's just agree to differ.

senses.definition_vi: nếu hai người đồng ý khác biệt/bất đồng, họ chấp nhận rằng họ có ý kiến khác nhau về điều gì đó, nhưng họ quyết định không thảo luận về nó nữa

senses.definition: an arrangement, a promise or a contract made with somebody

examples.x: an international peace agreement
The agreement (= the document recording the agreement) was signed during a meeting at the UN.
They have entered into a free trade agreement with Australia.
An agreement was finally reached between management and employees.
They had an agreement never to talk about work at home.
They had made a verbal agreement to sell.
The software is provided under a license agreement and may not be copied without permission.
The specific terms of the agreement have not been disclosed.
The documents are covered by a confidentiality agreement.

senses.definition_vi: một sự sắp xếp, một lời hứa hoặc một hợp đồng được thực hiện với ai đó

senses.definition: the state of sharing the same opinion or feeling

examples.x: The two sides failed to reach agreement.
There was broad agreement on what was needed.
There is agreement among teachers that changes need to be made.
Is everybody in agreement now?
Are we in agreement about the price?

examples.cf: in agreement with somebody on/about something
examples.x: My partner is in complete agreement with me on this issue.
I am in agreement with you that she should be given more responsibilities.

senses.definition_vi: trạng thái có cùng ý kiến hoặc cảm xúc

senses.definition: the fact of somebody approving of something and allowing it to happen

examples.x: You'll have to get your parents' agreement if you want to go on the trip.
Most pension schemes allow employees to keep working with the agreement of their employer.
No images may be reproduced without the artist's agreement.

senses.definition_vi: việc ai đó tán thành điều gì đó và cho phép nó xảy ra

senses.definition: the state of having the same number, gender or person

examples.x: In the sentence ‘They live in the country’, the plural form of the verb ‘live’ is in agreement with the plural subject ‘they’.

senses.definition_vi: trạng thái có cùng số lượng, giống hoặc ngôi

senses.definition: used to express surprise, pleasure or sympathy, or when you disagree with somebody

examples.x: Ah, there you are!
Ah, this coffee is good.
Ah well, better luck next time.
Ah, but that may not be true.

senses.definition_vi: được sử dụng để diễn tả sự ngạc nhiên, vui mừng hoặc thông cảm, hoặc khi bạn không đồng ý với ai đó

senses.definition: the purpose of doing something; what somebody is trying to achieve

examples.x: the stated aims of the study
Our main aim is to provide affordable childcare.
His sole aim in life is to enjoy himself.
Teamwork is required in order to achieve these aims.
to pursue/further/fulfil your aims
She set out the company's aims and objectives in her speech.

examples.cf: with the aim of doing something
examples.x: The organization was formed with the aim of helping local people.

senses.definition_vi: mục đích của việc làm điều gì đó; những gì ai đó đang cố gắng đạt được

senses.definition: the action or skill of pointing a weapon at somebody/something

examples.x: Her aim was good and she hit the target with her first shot.
The gunman took aim (= pointed his weapon) and fired.
His aim was poor and he missed the target.
It was a perfect aim and there was no way he would miss.

senses.definition_vi: hành động hoặc kỹ năng nhắm vũ khí vào ai đó/cái gì đó

senses.definition: to direct your criticism at somebody/something
senses.definition_vi: hướng sự chỉ trích của bạn vào ai đó/cái gì đó

senses.definition: a loud noise or a signal that warns people of danger or of a problem

examples.x: She decided to sound the alarm (= warn people that the situation was dangerous).
I hammered on all the doors to raise the alarm.
By the time the alarm was raised the intruders had escaped.

senses.definition_vi: một tiếng động lớn hoặc một tín hiệu cảnh báo mọi người về nguy hiểm hoặc vấn đề

senses.definition: a device that warns people of a particular danger, or that a particular person is in danger

examples.x: a burglar/fire/smoke alarm
The cat set off the alarm (= made it start ringing).
A car alarm went off in the middle of the night (= started ringing).
Carry a personal alarm with you.
Install an alarm system and learn how to use it.

senses.definition_vi: một thiết bị cảnh báo mọi người về một nguy hiểm cụ thể, hoặc rằng một người cụ thể đang gặp nguy hiểm

senses.definition: a ringing sound or a tune played by a clock or your phone after you have set it to play at a particular time to wake you up

examples.x: The alarm went off at 7 o'clock.
I set my alarm for 6.30.

senses.definition_vi: một âm thanh hoặc giai điệu phát ra từ đồng hồ hoặc điện thoại của bạn sau khi bạn đặt nó phát vào một thời điểm cụ thể để đánh thức bạn dậy

senses.definition: fear and worry that somebody feels when something dangerous or unpleasant might happen

examples.x: ‘What have you done?’ Ellie cried in alarm.
I felt a growing sense of alarm when he did not return that night.
The doctor said there was no cause for alarm.

senses.definition_vi: sự sợ hãi và lo lắng mà ai đó cảm thấy khi điều gì đó nguy hiểm hoặc khó chịu có thể xảy ra

senses.definition: if you say that alarm bells are ringing, you mean that people are starting to feel worried and to suspect that something is wrong

examples.x: The government’s proposal has set alarm bells ringing for people on low incomes.

senses.definition_vi: nếu bạn nói rằng chuông báo động đang reo, bạn có nghĩa là mọi người đang bắt đầu cảm thấy lo lắng và nghi ngờ có điều gì đó không ổn

senses.definition: able to think quickly; quick to notice things

examples.x: Suddenly he found himself awake and fully alert.
Two alert scientists spotted the mistake.
Try to stay alert while driving at night.
an alert mind
mentally alert

senses.definition_vi: có thể suy nghĩ nhanh chóng; nhanh chóng nhận thấy mọi thứ

senses.definition: aware of something, especially a problem or danger

examples.x: We must be alert to the possibility of danger.
She was alert to the slightest sound.

senses.definition_vi: nhận thức được điều gì đó, đặc biệt là một vấn đề hoặc nguy hiểm

senses.definition: to arrange something in the correct position, or to be in the correct position, in relation to something else, especially in a straight line

examples.x: Make sure the shelf is aligned with the top of the cupboard.
The top and bottom line of each column on the page should align.

senses.definition_vi: sắp xếp một cái gì đó ở vị trí đúng, hoặc ở đúng vị trí, liên quan đến một cái gì đó khác, đặc biệt là theo một đường thẳng

senses.definition: to change something slightly so that it is in the correct relationship to something else

examples.x: Domestic prices have been aligned with those in world markets.

senses.definition_vi: thay đổi một chút để nó ở đúng mối quan hệ với một cái gì đó khác

senses.definition: arrangement in a straight line

examples.x: the alignment of the sun, moon and earth at a particular time
A bone in my spine was out of alignment.
The door needs to be in alignment with the frame before you start work on it.

senses.definition_vi: sự sắp xếp theo một đường thẳng

senses.definition: a situation in which something is in the correct relationship with something else

examples.x: Alignment between our commercial and creative goals is crucial.
We will implement policies in alignment with our fiscal goals.
Property prices are too high and need to be brought back into alignment.

senses.definition_vi: một tình huống mà một cái gì đó ở đúng mối quan hệ với một cái gì đó khác

senses.definition: political, business or other support given to one country or group by another

examples.x: our alignment with a leading data management company

senses.definition_vi: sự ủng hộ về chính trị, kinh doanh hoặc các loại khác mà một quốc gia hoặc nhóm dành cho một quốc gia hoặc nhóm khác

senses.definition: living; not dead

examples.x: Are your grandparents still alive?
Doctors managed to keep the baby alive.
She had to steal food just to stay alive.
He was buried alive in the earthquake.
The police are desperate to catch this man dead or alive.
We don't know whether he's alive or dead.

senses.definition_vi: sống; không chết

senses.definition: full of emotion, excitement, activity, etc.

examples.x: Ed was alive with happiness.
Her eyes were alive with interest.

senses.definition_vi: đầy cảm xúc, sự phấn khích, hoạt động, v.v.

senses.definition: continuing to exist

examples.x: to keep a tradition alive
Money from charities is keeping the theatre alive.
The issue remains alive in the public consciousness.

senses.definition_vi: tiếp tục tồn tại

senses.definition: full of living or moving things

examples.x: The pool was alive with goldfish.

senses.definition_vi: đầy những thứ sống hoặc đang chuyển động

senses.definition: aware of something; knowing something exists and is important

examples.x: to be alive to the dangers/facts/possibilities
The government should be alive to the problems faced by industry.

senses.definition_vi: nhận thức về điều gì đó; biết rằng điều gì đó tồn tại và quan trọng

senses.definition: very active, healthy or popular

examples.x: My mother is still alive and kicking.

senses.definition_vi: rất năng động, khỏe mạnh hoặc phổ biến

senses.definition: still living and not injured or harmed

examples.x: The missing student was found alive and well in Newcastle.

senses.definition_vi: vẫn còn sống và không bị thương hoặc tổn hại

senses.definition: still popular or successful

examples.x: Singapore's literary scene is alive and well.
Contrary to popular belief, the tourism industry is alive and well in this part of the world.

senses.definition_vi: vẫn còn phổ biến hoặc thành công

senses.definition: to make something interesting

examples.x: The pictures bring the book alive.
The teacher brought history alive with fascinating stories.

senses.definition_vi: làm cho điều gì đó trở nên thú vị

senses.definition: to become interesting and exciting

examples.x: The game came alive in the second half.
New political issues suddenly came alive after the election.

senses.definition_vi: trở nên thú vị và hấp dẫn

senses.definition: to become busy and full of activity

examples.x: The city starts to come alive after dark.
The fishing villages come alive in spring.

senses.definition_vi: trở nên bận rộn và đầy hoạt động

senses.definition: to show interest in something and become excited about it

examples.x: She came alive as she talked about her job.

senses.definition_vi: thể hiện sự quan tâm đến điều gì đó và trở nên hào hứng về nó

senses.definition: to criticize or punish somebody severely because you are extremely angry with them

examples.x: He’ll eat you alive if he ever finds out.

senses.definition_vi: chỉ trích hoặc trừng phạt ai đó nặng nề vì bạn cực kỳ tức giận với họ

senses.definition: to defeat somebody completely in an argument, a competition, etc.

examples.x: The defence lawyers are going to eat you alive tomorrow.

senses.definition_vi: đánh bại ai đó hoàn toàn trong một cuộc tranh luận, một cuộc thi, v.v.

senses.definition: to bite somebody many times

examples.x: I was being eaten alive by mosquitoes.

senses.definition_vi: cắn ai đó nhiều lần

senses.definition: to let somebody/something do something; to let something happen or be done

examples.x: His parents won't allow him to stay out late.
He allowed his mind to wander.
The law allowed companies to dismiss workers without any reason.
He is not allowed to stay out late.
Students are only allowed to use the equipment under supervision.
This research must be allowed to continue.
He refused to allow himself to be kept quiet.
She won't allow herself to be dictated to.
Eating is not allowed in the classrooms.
He received the maximum sentence allowed by law.
We do not allow eating in the classrooms.

senses.definition_vi: cho phép ai đó/điều gì đó làm điều gì đó; cho phép điều gì đó xảy ra hoặc được thực hiện

senses.definition: to let somebody have something

examples.x: You're allowed an hour to complete the test.
I'm not allowed visitors.
I allow myself a treat now and then.
She allowed herself a thin smile of triumph.

senses.definition_vi: cho phép ai đó có thứ gì đó

senses.definition: to let somebody/something go into, through, out of, etc. a place

examples.x: No dogs allowed (= you cannot bring them in).
The prisoners are allowed out of their cells for two hours a day.
They weren't allowed into the country.
He was knocking at the door waiting to be allowed in.
You won't be allowed up (= out of bed) for several days.
The crowd parted to allow her through.

senses.definition_vi: cho phép ai đó/điều gì đó đi vào, đi qua, đi ra khỏi một địa điểm

senses.definition: to make something possible

examples.x: A ramp allows easy access for wheelchairs.
The system allows people the opportunity to browse a wide selection of books.
The new technology allows users to choose exactly what they watch and when.

senses.definition_vi: làm cho điều gì đó có thể

senses.definition: to make sure that you have enough of something for a particular purpose

examples.x: How much time would you allow for the trip?
You need to allow three metres of fabric for the dress.

senses.definition_vi: đảm bảo rằng bạn có đủ thứ gì đó cho một mục đích cụ thể

senses.definition: to accept or admit something; to agree that something is true or correct

examples.x: The judge allowed my claim.
(= in a court of law) ‘Objection!’ ‘I'll allow it.’
He refuses to allow that such a situation could arise.
She was very helpful when my mother was ill—I'll allow you that.

senses.definition_vi: chấp nhận hoặc thừa nhận điều gì đó; đồng ý rằng điều gì đó là đúng hoặc chính xác

senses.definition: used to offer help politely

examples.x: ‘Allow me,’ he said, taking the tray from her.

senses.definition_vi: được sử dụng để đề nghị giúp đỡ một cách lịch sự

senses.definition: to give somebody complete freedom of action; to allow a feeling to be expressed freely

examples.x: The designer was given free rein.
The script allows full rein to her larger-than-life acting style.
When I paint I just give my imagination free rein.

senses.definition_vi: cho phép ai đó hoàn toàn tự do hành động; cho phép một cảm xúc được thể hiện một cách tự do

senses.definition: to become different; to make somebody/something different

examples.x: Prices have not altered significantly this year.
He had altered so much I scarcely recognized him.
His actions that day altered my perception of him.
The landscape has been radically altered by changes in the climate.
They have the power to fundamentally alter the course of history.
She didn't alter her behaviour in any way.
Nothing can alter the fact that we are to blame.
The recipe has been altered to suit American tastes.
Fame hasn't really altered her.

senses.definition_vi: trở nên khác biệt; làm cho ai đó/điều gì đó khác biệt

senses.definition: to make changes to a piece of clothing so that it will fit you better

examples.x: We can have the dress altered to fit you.

senses.definition_vi: thay đổi một món quần áo để nó vừa vặn hơn với bạn

senses.definition: that can be used instead of something else

examples.x: The road was closed so we had to find an alternative route.
Can you offer an alternative explanation?
an alternative method of working
Do you have an alternative solution?

senses.definition_vi: có thể được sử dụng thay cho thứ khác

senses.definition: different from the usual or traditional way in which something is done

examples.x: alternative therapy/treatments
an alternative lifestyle
Medicine made of mould must once have seemed very alternative.

senses.definition_vi: khác với cách thông thường hoặc truyền thống mà một việc gì đó được thực hiện

senses.definition: a chemical element. Aluminium is a light, silver-grey metal used for making pans, etc.

examples.x: aluminium saucepans/window frames
aluminium foil (= for example, for wrapping food in)

senses.definition_vi: một nguyên tố hóa học. Nhôm là một kim loại nhẹ, màu xám bạc được sử dụng để làm nồi, v.v.

senses.definition: very surprised

examples.x: an amazed look
an amazed silence
We were all amazed at the number of people who came.
I was amazed at her knowledge of French literature.
We just moved house and are amazed at the amount of junk we have.
We are constantly amazed by the quality and range of the books.
We were amazed by his generosity.
I was banging so loudly I’m amazed (that) they didn’t hear me.
She was amazed how little he had changed.
I was amazed at how well we did.

examples.cf: amazed to see, find, learn, discover
examples.x: We were amazed to find that no one was hurt.

senses.definition_vi: rất ngạc nhiên

senses.definition: very surprising, especially in a way that you like or admire

examples.x: an amazing feat/story/experience
That's amazing, isn't it?
The amazing thing is, he really believes he'll get away with it.
It was truly amazing to see how much work goes into a Broadway musical.

examples.cf: it is amazing how, what, etc…
examples.x: It's amazing how quickly people adapt.
I find it amazing that people can be so irresponsible.
It’s amazing the difference a few polite words make.

senses.definition_vi: rất đáng ngạc nhiên, đặc biệt là theo cách bạn thích hoặc ngưỡng mộ

senses.definition: very impressive; excellent

examples.x: He makes the most amazing cakes.
I saw the most amazing film yesterday!
That looks pretty amazing, doesn't it?

senses.definition_vi: rất ấn tượng; xuất sắc

senses.definition: something that you want to do or achieve very much

examples.x: She had fulfilled her lifelong ambition.
His burning ambition was to study medicine.
political/artistic/career ambitions
At last he had realized his life's ambition.
He had only one ambition in life.
the country's nuclear ambitions (= plans to develop nuclear weapons)
She never achieved her ambition of becoming a famous writer.

senses.definition_vi: điều gì đó mà bạn muốn làm hoặc đạt được rất nhiều

senses.definition: the desire or strength of mind to be successful, rich, powerful, etc.

examples.x: She was driven by personal ambition.
She was intelligent but suffered from a lack of ambition.

senses.definition_vi: mong muốn hoặc sức mạnh ý chí để thành công, giàu có, quyền lực, v.v.

senses.definition: determined to be successful, rich, powerful, etc.

examples.x: a fiercely ambitious young manager
They were very ambitious for their children (= they wanted them to be successful).

senses.definition_vi: quyết tâm thành công, giàu có, quyền lực, v.v.

senses.definition: needing a lot of effort, money or time to succeed

examples.x: the government’s ambitious plans for social reform
Jogging every morning? That’s very ambitious, isn’t it?
Several interns will be working on three ambitious new projects.

senses.definition_vi: cần nhiều nỗ lực, tiền bạc hoặc thời gian để thành công

senses.definition: a quantity of something

examples.x: I was amazed at the amount he could eat.
Mix the colours in equal amounts.
an amount of money/information/work/time
A certain amount of time has already been spent on the project.
The server is designed to store huge amounts of data.
Try to reduce the amount of energy and water you use at home.
Faculty should increase the amount and quality of feedback they provide.

senses.definition_vi: một số lượng của một cái gì đó

senses.definition: a sum of money

examples.x: Everyone has paid the same amount.
You will receive a bill for the full amount.
The insurance company will refund any amount due to you.
Small amounts will be paid in cash.
You must pay back the full amount that you owe.

senses.definition_vi: một khoản tiền

senses.definition: a large quantity of something

examples.x: There's been any amount of research into the subject.

senses.definition_vi: một số lượng lớn của một cái gì đó

senses.definition: used for saying that something will have no effect

examples.x: No amount of encouragement would make him jump into the pool.

senses.definition_vi: được sử dụng để nói rằng điều gì đó sẽ không có tác dụng

senses.definition: funny and giving pleasure

examples.x: an amusing story/game/incident
She writes very amusing letters.
I didn't find the joke at all amusing.
She told us about an amusing incident that happened on her way home.

senses.definition_vi: buồn cười và mang lại niềm vui

senses.definition: a person whose job involves examining facts or materials in order to give an opinion on them

examples.x: a political/financial analyst
a food/market analyst
He's a senior research analyst at Deutsche Bank.
analysts expect/predict…
City analysts forecast huge profits this year.
According to music industry analysts, music downloads are set to decline by as much as 30 per cent this year.

senses.definition_vi: một người có công việc liên quan đến việc xem xét các sự kiện hoặc tài liệu để đưa ra ý kiến về chúng

senses.definition: a person who treats patients using psychoanalysis
senses.definition_vi: một người điều trị bệnh nhân bằng phân tâm học

senses.definition: the strong feeling that you have when something has happened that you think is bad and unfair

examples.x: She had to find a way to express her pent-up anger.
The plan provoked anger among local residents.
the growing anger and frustration of young unemployed people
Jan slammed her fist on the desk in anger.
He was filled with anger at the way he had been treated.
There is much anger over plans to close the hospital.
Local people are seething with anger about the decision.
There is widespread anger at the government following yesterday's announcement.
I feel no anger towards him, only pity.
The people are taking to the streets to vent their anger against the prime minister.
a course in anger management (= controlling your feelings of anger)

senses.definition_vi: cảm giác mạnh mẽ mà bạn có khi có điều gì đó xảy ra mà bạn cho là tồi tệ và không công bằng

senses.definition: the space between two lines or surfaces that join, measured in degrees

examples.x: a 45° angle
the rocket’s angle of descent

senses.definition_vi: khoảng không gian giữa hai đường hoặc hai bề mặt gặp nhau, được đo bằng độ

senses.definition: a corner on the outside or inside of something

examples.x: It's a modern building, all brick and glass and sharp angles.

senses.definition_vi: một góc ở bên ngoài hoặc bên trong của một vật

senses.definition: the direction that something is leaning or pointing in when it does not go straight up and down or straight across from side to side

examples.x: The Tower of Pisa leans at an angle.
The plane was coming in at a steep angle.
His hair was sticking up at all angles.
His shoulder was bent at an odd angle so it must be broken.
Venus and the Earth orbit the Sun at a slight angle to each other.

senses.definition_vi: hướng mà một vật đang nghiêng hoặc chỉ vào khi nó không đi thẳng lên hoặc thẳng xuống, hoặc thẳng ngang

senses.definition: a position from which you look at something

examples.x: The photo was taken from an unusual angle.
The painting changes slightly when seen from different angles.
The variety of camera angles gives her photographs interest.

senses.definition_vi: một vị trí mà từ đó bạn nhìn vào một cái gì đó

senses.definition: a particular way of presenting or thinking about a situation, problem, etc.

examples.x: We need a new angle for our next advertising campaign.
You can look at the issue from many different angles.
You start seeing some solutions when you view something from all angles.
The article concentrates on the human angle (= the part that concerns people's emotions) of the story.

senses.definition_vi: một cách cụ thể để trình bày hoặc suy nghĩ về một tình huống, vấn đề, v.v.

senses.definition: in a way that shows you have strong feelings about something that you dislike very much or about an unfair situation

examples.x: Some senators reacted angrily to the president's remarks.
He swore angrily.
She angrily rejected any suggestion of a cover-up.
‘This isn't fair!’ she shouted angrily.
The president angrily denounced the coup as illegal.

senses.definition_vi: theo cách thể hiện rằng bạn có cảm xúc mạnh mẽ về điều gì đó mà bạn rất không thích hoặc về một tình huống không công bằng

senses.definition: having strong feelings about something that you dislike very much or about an unfair situation

examples.x: Her behaviour really made me angry.
I started to get really angry and upset.
The players were attacked by an angry mob.
The comments provoked an angry response from union leaders.
Thousands of angry demonstrators filled the square.
Please don't be angry with me. It wasn't my fault.
I was very angry with myself for making such a stupid mistake.
She felt angry with herself.
I was so angry at the way I had been treated.
The passengers grew angry about the delay.
He felt angry at the injustice of the situation.
The people are very angry over the decision.

senses.definition_vi: có cảm xúc mạnh mẽ về điều gì đó mà bạn rất không thích hoặc về một tình huống không công bằng

senses.definition: red and painful, usually because of an infection
senses.definition_vi: đỏ và đau, thường là do nhiễm trùng

senses.definition: dark and stormy

examples.x: the angry sea with its terrible waves

senses.definition_vi: tối và bão tố

senses.definition: to tell people something officially, especially about a decision, plans, etc.

examples.x: He officially announced his intention to resign at today's press conference.
They haven't formally announced their engagement yet.
A ring at the doorbell announced Jack's arrival.
We are pleased to announce that all five candidates were successful.
It was announced that new speed restrictions would be introduced.
The company announced its decision to the public in March.
The government yesterday announced to the media plans to create a million new jobs.
She was announced as the winner at last night's ceremony.

senses.definition_vi: cho mọi người biết điều gì đó một cách chính thức, đặc biệt là về một quyết định, kế hoạch, v.v.

senses.definition: to give information about something in a public place, especially through a loudspeaker

examples.x: Has our flight been announced yet?
The winners will be announced in reverse order.
‘Now boarding flight 897, destination Seattle,’ the loudspeaker announced.
They announced that the flight would be delayed.

senses.definition_vi: cung cấp thông tin về điều gì đó ở nơi công cộng, đặc biệt là qua loa phóng thanh

senses.definition: to say something in a loud and/or serious way

examples.x: ‘I've given up eating meat,’ she announced.
She announced that she'd given up eating meat.

senses.definition_vi: nói điều gì đó một cách lớn tiếng và/hoặc nghiêm túc

senses.definition: to tell somebody your name or somebody else’s name when you or they arrive at a place

examples.x: Would you announce the guests as they arrive? (= call out their names, for example at a formal party)

senses.definition_vi: cho ai đó biết tên của bạn hoặc tên của người khác khi bạn hoặc họ đến một địa điểm

senses.definition: to introduce, or to give information about, a programme on the radio or television
senses.definition_vi: giới thiệu, hoặc cung cấp thông tin về, một chương trình trên radio hoặc truyền hình

senses.definition: a spoken or written statement that informs people about something

examples.x: to make an announcement
a formal/an official/a public announcement
We welcome the recent announcement by the Government.
Announcements of births, marriages and deaths appear in some newspapers.
Today's announcement of a peace agreement came after weeks of discussion.
An announcement about her future is expected soon.
We saw an announcement in the national newspaper.

senses.definition_vi: một phát ngôn hoặc văn bản thông báo cho mọi người về điều gì đó

senses.definition: the act of publicly informing people about something

examples.x: Announcement of the verdict was accompanied by shouts and cheers.
He was speaking after the announcement of record results for the company.

senses.definition_vi: hành động thông báo công khai cho mọi người về điều gì đó

senses.definition: to make somebody slightly angry

examples.x: His constant joking was beginning to annoy her.
I’m sure she does it just to annoy me.
I only stay out late to annoy my parents.
It really annoys me when people forget to say thank you.

examples.cf: it annoys somebody to do something
