examples.x: It annoys me to see him getting ahead of me.

senses.definition_vi: làm cho ai đó hơi tức giận

senses.definition: to make somebody uncomfortable or unable to relax

examples.x: He swatted a fly that was annoying him.
The wasps were beginning to annoy me.

senses.definition_vi: làm cho ai đó cảm thấy khó chịu hoặc không thể thư giãn

senses.definition: slightly angry

examples.x: He was beginning to get very annoyed with me about my carelessness.
I was a little annoyed about the whole thing.
I was a bit annoyed with him.
I was annoyed with myself for giving in so easily.
I bet she was annoyed at having to write it out again.
I was annoyed that they hadn't turned up.
He was annoyed to find himself going red.

senses.definition_vi: hơi tức giận

senses.definition: making somebody feel slightly angry

examples.x: This interruption is very annoying.
Her most annoying habit was eating with her mouth open.
It's incredibly annoying, but that's life.

senses.definition_vi: làm cho ai đó cảm thấy hơi tức giận

senses.definition: happening or done once every year

examples.x: an annual meeting/event/report/conference
The 12th annual Music Festival runs from Friday 25th to Monday 28th October.
Funding will be awarded on an annual basis.
She is organizing this year's annual staff party.

senses.definition_vi: xảy ra hoặc được thực hiện một lần mỗi năm

senses.definition: relating to a period of one year

examples.x: an annual income/revenue/budget/fee/salary/turnover
an average annual growth rate of 8%
Our total annual costs have declined.
I have already taken all my annual leave for this year.
annual rainfall

senses.definition_vi: liên quan đến một khoảng thời gian một năm

senses.definition: once a year

examples.x: The exhibition is held annually.

senses.definition_vi: một lần mỗi năm

senses.definition: something that you say, write or do to react to a question or situation

examples.x: I rang the bell, but there was no answer.
Can't you give me a definitive answer?
The short answer is no.
The simple answer is that we don't know.
a question and answer session
I can't easily give an answer to your question.
Have you had an answer to your letter?
She had no answer to the accusations.
As if in answer to our prayers, she offered to lend us £10 000.
You're not going to get an answer from me!
The report does not provide answers as to why the tragedy occurred.

senses.definition_vi: điều bạn nói, viết hoặc làm để phản ứng với một câu hỏi hoặc tình huống

senses.definition: something that you write or say in reply to a question in a test, an exam, an exercise, etc.; the correct reply to a question in a test, etc.

examples.x: the correct/right answer
Write your answers on the sheet provided.
Do you know the answer (= the right one) to question 12?
The answers are at the back of the book.

senses.definition_vi: điều bạn viết hoặc nói để trả lời một câu hỏi trong bài kiểm tra, kỳ thi, bài tập, v.v.; câu trả lời đúng cho một câu hỏi trong bài kiểm tra, v.v.

senses.definition: a solution to a problem

examples.x: There is no easy answer.
The answer is simple.
This could be the answer to all our problems.
There are more questions than answers on the issue of our ageing population.
This may not be the answer for everyone.
She has spent her life looking for answers.
The obvious answer would be to cancel the party.
The answer lies in a combination of factors.

senses.definition_vi: một giải pháp cho một vấn đề

senses.definition: a person or thing from one place that may be thought to be as good as a famous person or thing from another place

examples.x: The new theme park will be Britain's answer to Disneyland.

senses.definition_vi: một người hoặc vật từ một nơi có thể được coi là ngang bằng với một người hoặc vật nổi tiếng từ một nơi khác

senses.definition: to be confident that you know something, especially when you actually do not

examples.x: He thinks he knows all the answers.

senses.definition_vi: tự tin rằng bạn biết điều gì đó, đặc biệt là khi thực tế là không

senses.definition: to refuse to accept that somebody does not want something, will not do something, etc.

examples.x: You're coming and I won't take no for an answer!

senses.definition_vi: từ chối chấp nhận rằng ai đó không muốn điều gì đó, sẽ không làm điều gì đó, v.v.

senses.definition: to expect something

examples.x: We don't anticipate any major problems.
Our anticipated arrival time is 8.30.
The eagerly anticipated movie will be released next month.
They anticipate moving to bigger premises by the end of the year.
I don't anticipate it being a problem.
We anticipate that sales will rise next year.
It is anticipated that inflation will stabilize at 3 per cent.

senses.definition_vi: mong đợi điều gì đó

senses.definition: to see what might happen in the future and take action to prepare for it

examples.x: We need someone who can anticipate and respond to changes in the fashion industry.
Try and anticipate what the interviewers will ask.

senses.definition_vi: nhìn thấy những gì có thể xảy ra trong tương lai và hành động để chuẩn bị cho nó

senses.definition: to think with pleasure and excitement about something that is going to happen

examples.x: We eagerly anticipated the day we would leave school.
The more I anticipated arriving somewhere, the more disappointed I was.

senses.definition_vi: nghĩ với niềm vui và sự phấn khích về điều gì đó sắp xảy ra

senses.definition: to do something before it can be done by somebody else

examples.x: When Scott reached the South Pole he found that Amundsen had anticipated him.

senses.definition_vi: làm điều gì đó trước khi nó có thể được thực hiện bởi người khác

senses.definition: to say that you are sorry for doing something wrong or causing a problem

examples.x: Why should I apologize?
Go and apologize to her.
He wanted to publicly apologize to his victims.
I want to apologize publicly on his behalf to those who have suffered.
He apologized profusely to his family and staff.
I sincerely apologize for the enormous delay in delivery.
We apologize for the late departure of this flight.
I think Mr Peters should withdraw and apologize for his remark.
I apologize unreservedly for any offending remarks I made.
We apologize to our customers for the inconvenience caused.

senses.definition_vi: nói rằng bạn xin lỗi vì đã làm điều gì đó sai hoặc gây ra vấn đề

senses.definition: a word or statement saying sorry for something that has been done wrong or that causes a problem

examples.x: to offer/make/demand/accept an apology
You owe him an apology for what you said.
We should like to offer our apologies for the delay to your flight today.
We received a letter of apology.

senses.definition_vi: một từ hoặc tuyên bố nói lời xin lỗi vì điều gì đó đã làm sai hoặc gây ra vấn đề

senses.definition: information that you cannot go to a meeting or must leave early

examples.x: The meeting started with apologies (= the names of people who said they could not go to the meeting).
She made her apologies and left early.

senses.definition_vi: thông tin rằng bạn không thể tham dự cuộc họp hoặc phải rời đi sớm

senses.definition: if you say that you make no apology/apologies for something, you mean that you do not feel that you have said or done anything wrong
senses.definition_vi: nếu bạn nói rằng bạn không xin lỗi/không hối tiếc về điều gì đó, bạn có nghĩa là bạn không cảm thấy mình đã nói hoặc làm điều gì sai

senses.definition: easy to see or understand

examples.x: Their devotion was apparent.
Then, for no apparent reason, the train suddenly stopped.
It was apparent from her face that she was really upset.
It soon became apparent to everyone that he couldn't sing.
It's readily apparent that she has a gift for this kind of writing.
No damage was apparent from a brain scan.
The consequences of our actions are not immediately apparent to us.

senses.definition_vi: dễ nhìn thấy hoặc dễ hiểu

senses.definition: that seems to be real or true but may not be

examples.x: My parents were concerned at my apparent lack of enthusiasm for school.
Their affluence is more apparent than real (= they are not as rich as they seem to be).
There is an apparent contradiction between these two approaches.

senses.definition_vi: có vẻ là thật hoặc đúng nhưng có thể không phải vậy

senses.definition: to start to be seen

examples.x: Three days later a rash appeared.
Symptoms usually start appearing within two to three days.
A cat suddenly appeared out of nowhere.
Smoke appeared on the horizon.
A bus appeared around the corner.
Posters for the gig appeared all over town.
New shoots are just appearing at the base of the plant.

senses.definition_vi: bắt đầu được nhìn thấy

senses.definition: to begin to exist or be known or used for the first time

examples.x: Scientists are unsure when the virus first appeared.
His work began to appear on the scene in the 1960s.
When did mammals appear on the earth?
This problem first appeared in the inner cities.

senses.definition_vi: bắt đầu tồn tại hoặc được biết đến hoặc sử dụng lần đầu tiên

senses.definition: to give the impression of being or doing something

examples.x: She didn't appear at all surprised at the news.
Everything appeared normal at first.
It now appears likely that the school will be closed down.
It appears unlikely that interest rates will fall further.
He appears a perfectly normal person.
The couple appeared to have nothing in common.
The video appears to show a car driving through the wall of a house.
She appeared to be in her late thirties.
They appeared not to know what was happening.
There appears to have been a mistake.
It appears that there has been a mistake.
It would appear that this was a major problem.
The sunset made it appear as if the sea was made of gold.

senses.definition_vi: cho ấn tượng về việc là hoặc làm điều gì đó

senses.definition: to be published or broadcast

examples.x: His new book will be appearing in the spring.
It was too late to prevent the story from appearing in the national media.
These allegations appear in a forthcoming documentary.

senses.definition_vi: được xuất bản hoặc phát sóng

senses.definition: to take part in a film, play, television programme, etc.

examples.x: He has appeared in over 60 movies.
She regularly appears on TV.
She is currently appearing as Juliet at the Liverpool Playhouse.

senses.definition_vi: tham gia vào một bộ phim, vở kịch, chương trình truyền hình, v.v.

senses.definition: to arrive at a place

examples.x: By ten o'clock Lee still hadn't appeared.
A man appeared at the door and asked to see her.

senses.definition_vi: đến một địa điểm

senses.definition: to be written or mentioned somewhere

examples.x: Your name will appear at the front of the book.

senses.definition_vi: được viết hoặc đề cập ở đâu đó

senses.definition: to be present in court in order to give evidence or answer a charge

examples.x: A man will appear in court today charged with the murder.
She is expected to appear at Dumfries Sheriff Court on Monday.
She appeared on six charges of theft.
They will appear before magistrates tomorrow.
He has been asked to appear as a witness for the defence.
They had all appeared before the court several times.

senses.definition_vi: có mặt tại tòa để làm chứng hoặc trả lời cáo buộc

senses.definition: to act as somebody’s lawyer in court

examples.x: James Gilbert is the lawyer appearing for the defendant.

senses.definition_vi: hành động như luật sư của ai đó tại tòa

senses.definition: the way that somebody/something looks on the outside; what somebody/something seems to be

examples.x: the physical/outward/external appearance of something
She had never been greatly concerned about her appearance.
The dog was similar in general appearance to a spaniel.
He gave every appearance of (= seemed very much to be) enjoying himself.
Judging by appearances can be misleading.
To all appearances (= as far as people could tell), it had been a competely ordinary day.

senses.definition_vi: cách ai đó/cái gì đó trông bên ngoài; cái gì đó có vẻ là

senses.definition: the fact of somebody/something arriving, especially when it is not expected

examples.x: The sudden appearance of a security guard caused them to drop the money and run.
I don't want to go to the party, but I suppose I'd better put in an appearance (= go there for a short time).

senses.definition_vi: việc ai đó/cái gì đó đến, đặc biệt là khi không mong đợi

senses.definition: the moment at which something begins to exist or starts to be seen or used

examples.x: the early appearance of daffodils in spring
the appearance of organic vegetables in the supermarkets

senses.definition_vi: thời điểm mà một cái gì đó bắt đầu tồn tại hoặc bắt đầu được nhìn thấy hoặc sử dụng

senses.definition: an act of appearing in public, especially as a performer, politician, etc., or in court

examples.x: The Dutch player will make his first appearance for Liverpool this Saturday.
The show featured a guest appearance from Amy Schumer.
The singer's first public appearance was at the age of eight.
She made a cameo appearance in the film.
the defendant’s appearance in court
a court appearance
his appearance before the committee/inquiry

senses.short_meaning_vi: sự xuất hiện trước công chúng
senses.definition_vi: hành động xuất hiện trước công chúng, đặc biệt là với tư cách là người biểu diễn, chính trị gia, v.v., hoặc tại tòa

senses.definition: an act of being published or broadcast

examples.x: the appearance of claims about the minister’s private life in the press

senses.definition_vi: hành động được xuất bản hoặc phát sóng

senses.definition: to hide the truth about a bad situation and pretend that everything is going well

examples.x: When she lost all her money she was determined to keep up appearances.

senses.definition_vi: che giấu sự thật về một tình huống tồi tệ và giả vờ rằng mọi thứ đang diễn ra tốt đẹp

senses.definition: to show your approval of somebody/something by clapping your hands (= hitting your open hands together several times)

examples.x: He started to applaud and the others joined in.
They rose to applaud the speaker.
She was applauded as she came on stage.
The audience applauded loudly.

senses.definition_vi: thể hiện sự tán thành của bạn đối với ai đó/cái gì đó bằng cách vỗ tay (= đập hai bàn tay đang mở vào nhau nhiều lần)

senses.definition: to express praise for somebody/something because you approve of them or it

examples.x: We applaud her decision.
His efforts to improve the situation are to be applauded.
The decision to save the company has been warmly applauded.
I applaud her for having the courage to refuse.

senses.definition_vi: bày tỏ sự ca ngợi đối với ai đó/cái gì đó vì bạn tán thành họ hoặc nó

senses.definition: to make a formal request, usually in writing, for something such as a job, a loan, permission for something, a place at a university, etc.

examples.x: You should apply in person/by letter.
I have decided to apply for this new job.
They have successfully applied for political asylum.
to apply for a visa/passport/grant/licence
The developers applied for planning permission to build over 200 houses.
to apply to a company/university
They may apply to the court for the decision to be reversed.
He has applied to join the army.

senses.definition_vi: đưa ra một yêu cầu chính thức, thường bằng văn bản, cho một cái gì đó như một công việc, một khoản vay, giấy phép cho một cái gì đó, một suất học tại một trường đại học, v.v.

senses.definition: to affect or be relevant to somebody/something

examples.x: Special conditions apply if you are under 18.
The rules applied to employees and their behaviour at work.
What I am saying applies only to some of you.
The policy will apply equally to everyone.
The law applied only to workers in member states.
The word ‘unexciting’ could never be applied to her novels.

senses.definition_vi: ảnh hưởng hoặc liên quan đến ai đó/cái gì đó

senses.definition: to use something or make something work in a particular situation

examples.x: to apply political pressure
The challenge allows students to apply economic principles they learn in class.
to apply economic sanctions
to apply a test/method/technique/approach/rule
We need to apply the same standards to ourselves as to others.
The new technology was applied to farming.
Now is the time to apply the insights you have gained from your studies.

senses.definition_vi: sử dụng một cái gì đó hoặc làm cho một cái gì đó hoạt động trong một tình huống cụ thể

senses.definition: to put or spread something such as paint, cream, etc. onto a surface

examples.x: Apply the cream sparingly to your face and neck.
The glue should be applied to both surfaces.
She combed her hair and carefully applied her make-up.
The paint was applied with a fine brush.

senses.definition_vi: sơn hoặc trải một cái gì đó như sơn, kem, v.v. lên một bề mặt

senses.definition: to work at something or study something very hard

examples.x: You would pass your exams if you applied yourself.
We applied our minds to finding a solution to our problem.

senses.definition_vi: làm việc hoặc học một cái gì đó rất chăm chỉ

senses.definition: to press on something hard with your hand, foot, etc. to make something work or have an effect on something

examples.x: to apply the brakes (of a vehicle)
Pressure applied to the wound will stop the bleeding.

senses.definition_vi: ấn mạnh vào một cái gì đó bằng tay, chân, v.v. để làm cho một cái gì đó hoạt động hoặc có tác dụng lên một cái gì đó

senses.definition: to recognize the good qualities of somebody/something

examples.x: Over the years he came to appreciate the beauty and tranquillity of the river.
His talents are not fully appreciated in that company.
Her family doesn't appreciate her.
You can't really appreciate foreign literature in translation.
The sound quality was poor so we couldn't fully appreciate the music.

senses.definition_vi: nhận ra những phẩm chất tốt của ai đó/cái gì đó

senses.definition: to be grateful for something that somebody has done; to welcome something

examples.x: I'd appreciate some help.
Your support is greatly appreciated.
Thanks for coming. I appreciate it.
I would appreciate any comments you might have.
Your kindness and generosity is much appreciated.
We really appreciate the extra effort you're making.
I would appreciate it if you paid in cash.
I appreciate having the opportunity to discuss these important issues with you.
I don't appreciate being made to wait half an hour.
We would appreciate you letting us know of any problems.

senses.definition_vi: biết ơn vì điều gì đó mà ai đó đã làm; chào đón một cái gì đó

senses.definition: to understand that something is true

examples.x: What I failed to appreciate was the distance between the two cities.
The experience helped me understand and appreciate some of the difficulties people face.
I don't think you appreciate how expensive it will be.
We didn't fully appreciate that he was seriously ill.

senses.definition_vi: hiểu rằng một điều gì đó là đúng

senses.definition: to increase in value over a period of time

examples.x: Their investments have appreciated over the years.
We wanted a property that would appreciate in value.
The euro continues to appreciate against the dollar.

senses.definition_vi: tăng giá trị trong một khoảng thời gian

senses.definition: pleasure that you have when you recognize and enjoy the good qualities of somebody/something

examples.x: She shows little appreciation of good music.
The crowd murmured in appreciation.

senses.definition_vi: niềm vui mà bạn có khi nhận ra và tận hưởng những phẩm chất tốt của ai đó/cái gì đó

senses.definition: a full understanding of something, such as a situation or a problem, and of what it involves

examples.x: I had no appreciation of the problems they faced.

senses.definition_vi: sự hiểu biết đầy đủ về một cái gì đó, chẳng hạn như một tình huống hoặc một vấn đề, và những gì nó liên quan

senses.definition: the feeling of being grateful for something

examples.x: I would like to express my appreciation and thanks to you all.
Please accept this gift in appreciation of all you've done for us.
She never shows any appreciation for our efforts.
The clock was presented to Snell by his colleagues as an appreciation of his work and friendship.

senses.definition_vi: cảm giác biết ơn vì điều gì đó

senses.definition: increase in value over a period of time

examples.x: an appreciation in the value of the house
capital appreciation

senses.definition_vi: tăng giá trị trong một khoảng thời gian

senses.definition: a piece of writing or a speech in which the strengths and weaknesses of somebody/something, especially an artist or a work of art, are discussed and judged

examples.x: They were asked to write an appreciation of a poem of their choice.

senses.definition_vi: một bài viết hoặc bài phát biểu trong đó điểm mạnh và điểm yếu của ai đó/cái gì đó, đặc biệt là một nghệ sĩ hoặc một tác phẩm nghệ thuật, được thảo luận và đánh giá

senses.definition: a way of dealing with somebody/something; a way of doing or thinking about something such as a problem or a task

examples.x: She took the wrong approach in her dealings with them.
It was time to take a different approach.
an alternative/innovative approach
a traditional/similar approach
The approach they were using no longer seemed to work.
We need to adopt a new approach to the problem.
The therapy takes a holistic approach to health and well-being.
a variety of approaches for the treatment of depression
Will this be a successful approach for providing high-tech offices?

senses.definition_vi: một cách xử lý ai đó/cái gì đó; một cách để làm hoặc suy nghĩ về một cái gì đó như một vấn đề hoặc một nhiệm vụ

senses.definition: movement nearer to somebody/something in distance or time

examples.x: She hadn't heard his approach and jumped as the door opened.
the approach of spring
They felt apprehensive about the approach of war.
The children fell silent at the approach of their teacher.

senses.definition_vi: sự di chuyển đến gần hơn với ai đó/cái gì đó về khoảng cách hoặc thời gian

senses.definition: the act of speaking to somebody about something, especially when making an offer or a request

examples.x: The club has made an approach to a local company for sponsorship.
We've received an approach from the director of a rival company.

senses.definition_vi: hành động nói chuyện với ai đó về một cái gì đó, đặc biệt là khi đưa ra một lời đề nghị hoặc yêu cầu

senses.definition: attempts to start a personal or sexual relationship with somebody

examples.x: She resented his persistent approaches.

senses.definition_vi: những nỗ lực để bắt đầu một mối quan hệ cá nhân hoặc tình dục với ai đó

senses.definition: a path, road, etc. that leads to a place

examples.x: All the approaches to the palace were guarded by troops.
a new approach road to the port
The approach to the village was very pretty.

senses.definition_vi: một con đường, đường, v.v. dẫn đến một địa điểm

senses.definition: the part of an aircraft’s flight immediately before landing

examples.x: to begin the final approach to the runway
The aircraft had to make a steep approach to the landing strip.

senses.definition_vi: phần của chuyến bay của máy bay ngay trước khi hạ cánh

senses.definition: a thing that is like something else that is mentioned

examples.x: That's the nearest approach to an apology you'll get from him.

senses.definition_vi: một thứ giống với một thứ khác được đề cập

senses.definition: if you use the carrot and stick approach, you persuade somebody to try harder by offering them a reward if they do, or a punishment if they do not

examples.x: The emphasis is on the carrot of incentive rather than the stick of taxes.

senses.definition_vi: nếu bạn sử dụng phương pháp cà rốt và cây gậy, bạn thuyết phục ai đó cố gắng hơn bằng cách đưa ra phần thưởng nếu họ làm, hoặc hình phạt nếu họ không làm

senses.definition: suitable, acceptable or correct for the particular circumstances

examples.x: an appropriate response/measure/method
Now that the problem has been identified, appropriate action can be taken.
Is now an appropriate time to make a speech?
I will/will not be able to attend the open day (delete as appropriate) (= cross out the option that does not apply).
This may be an appropriate treatment for many patients.
Skills can be enhanced by the appropriate use of technology in certain circumstances.
He said she had responded to the situation in an entirely appropriate way.
to deem/consider/think something appropriate
Jeans are not appropriate for a formal party.
The book was written in a style appropriate to the age of the children.
All personnel were trained at levels appropriate to the needs of each job.

senses.definition_vi: phù hợp, chấp nhận được hoặc đúng đắn cho các tình huống cụ thể

senses.definition: in a way that is suitable, acceptable or correct for the particular circumstances

examples.x: The government has been accused of not responding appropriately to the needs of the homeless.
The chain of volcanoes is known, appropriately enough, as the ‘Ring of Fire’.

senses.definition_vi: một cách phù hợp, chấp nhận được hoặc đúng đắn cho hoàn cảnh cụ thể

senses.definition: part of a place, town, etc., or a region of a country or the world

examples.x: to improve access to services in rural areas
urban/metropolitan/residential areas
The farm and surrounding area were flooded.
She knows the local area very well.
the area around San Francisco
Large areas of the city were destroyed in the earthquake.
Wreckage from the plane was scattered over a wide area.
Thousands of tourists visit the area every year.
There are lots of things to do in the area.
Ted has lived in this area all his life.
People who live in remote areas of the country may not have access to electricity.
A lot of new people have moved into the area recently.
John is the London area manager.

senses.definition_vi: một phần của một địa điểm, thị trấn, v.v., hoặc một vùng của một quốc gia hoặc thế giới

senses.definition: a part of a room, building or particular space that is used for a special purpose

examples.x: the hotel reception area
a play/parking/dining area

senses.definition_vi: một phần của một căn phòng, tòa nhà hoặc không gian cụ thể được sử dụng cho một mục đích đặc biệt

senses.definition: a particular place on an object

examples.x: The treatment targets the affected areas of the brain.
The tumour had not spread to other areas of the body.
Move the cursor to a blank area of the computer screen.

senses.definition_vi: một vị trí cụ thể trên một vật thể

senses.definition: a particular subject or activity, or an aspect of it

examples.x: Finance is Mark's area.
The course covers two main subject areas.
The report focuses on three key areas of concern.
That's outside my specific area of expertise.
We have identified several areas for improvement.
More research is needed in this area.
to improve skills in the areas of critical thinking and problem-solving

senses.definition_vi: một chủ đề hoặc hoạt động cụ thể, hoặc một khía cạnh của nó

senses.definition: the amount of space covered by a flat surface or piece of land, described as a measurement

examples.x: the area of a triangle
Measure the surface area.
The estate covers an area of 106 acres.
The room is 12 square metres in area.

senses.definition_vi: lượng không gian được bao phủ bởi một bề mặt phẳng hoặc một mảnh đất, được mô tả bằng một phép đo

senses.definition: the area in front of the goal. If the defending team breaks the rules within this area, the other team is given a penalty.

examples.x: He shot from just outside the area.

senses.definition_vi: khu vực trước khung thành. Nếu đội phòng ngự phạm luật trong khu vực này, đội kia sẽ được hưởng một quả phạt đền.

senses.definition: used (often before a comparative or superlative adjective) when you are stating an opinion that you believe you could give reasons to support

examples.x: He is arguably the best actor of his generation.

senses.definition_vi: được sử dụng (thường trước một tính từ so sánh hơn hoặc nhất) khi bạn đưa ra một ý kiến mà bạn tin rằng mình có thể đưa ra lý do để ủng hộ

senses.definition: to speak angrily to somebody because you disagree with them

examples.x: My brothers are always arguing.
He's offering to pay so who am I to argue?
We're always arguing with each other about money.
I know it was a stupid thing to argue about.
All families seem to argue over money.
I don't want to argue with you—just do it!

senses.definition_vi: nói chuyện giận dữ với ai đó vì bạn không đồng ý với họ

senses.definition: to give reasons why you think that something is right/wrong, true/not true, etc., especially to persuade people that you are right

examples.x: They argued for the right to strike.
He argues persuasively against nationalism.
She argued the case for bringing back the death penalty.
He was too tired to argue the point (= discuss the matter).
a well-argued article
Critics argue that Britain is not investing enough in broadband.
It could be argued that laws are made by and for men.
He argued that they needed more time to finish the project.
His lawyer successfully argued that the punishment was excessive.

senses.definition_vi: đưa ra lý do tại sao bạn nghĩ rằng điều gì đó là đúng/sai, đúng/không đúng, v.v., đặc biệt là để thuyết phục mọi người rằng bạn đúng

senses.definition: to show clearly that something exists or is true

examples.x: These latest developments argue a change in government policy.

senses.definition_vi: chỉ rõ ràng rằng điều gì đó tồn tại hoặc là sự thật

senses.definition: to continue to disagree about a decision, especially when it is too late to change it or it is not very important
senses.definition_vi: tiếp tục không đồng ý về một quyết định, đặc biệt là khi đã quá muộn để thay đổi hoặc khi nó không quan trọng lắm

senses.definition: a conversation or discussion in which two or more people disagree, often angrily

examples.x: to win/lose an argument
After some heated argument a decision was finally taken.
She got into an argument with the teacher.
He was killed during a violent argument over money.
We had an argument with the waiter about the bill.
Jack was always the one who settled arguments between us.

senses.definition_vi: một cuộc trò chuyện hoặc thảo luận trong đó hai hoặc nhiều người không đồng ý, thường là giận dữ

senses.definition: a reason or set of reasons that somebody uses to show that something is true or correct

examples.x: a strong/convincing/compelling argument
to advance/present an argument
Having heard both sides of the argument, the court will make a decision.
Her main argument was a moral one.
There are strong arguments for and against euthanasia.
The author makes a compelling argument for the use of hydrogen as a fuel.
What are the arguments in favour of change?
The judge rejected the defence argument that the evidence was too old to be relevant.

senses.definition_vi: một lý do hoặc một tập hợp các lý do mà ai đó sử dụng để chứng tỏ điều gì đó là đúng hoặc chính xác

senses.definition: the act of disagreeing in a conversation or discussion using a reason or set of reasons

examples.x: Let's assume for the sake of argument (= in order to discuss the problem) that we can't start till March.

senses.definition_vi: hành động không đồng ý trong một cuộc trò chuyện hoặc thảo luận bằng cách sử dụng một lý do hoặc một tập hợp các lý do

senses.definition: to happen; to start to exist

examples.x: An opportunity arose to work in the United States.
Questions naturally arose as to who was responsible.
A serious problem can arise if the heart stops pumping effectively.
We only use the car when the need arises (= when it is necessary).
This issue arose as an unintended consequence of the Act.
A new crisis has arisen.
We keep them informed of any changes as they arise.
A storm arose during the night.

senses.definition_vi: xảy ra; bắt đầu tồn tại

senses.definition: to happen as a result of a particular situation

examples.x: injuries arising out of a road accident
Emotional or mental problems can arise from a physical cause.
Are there any matters arising from the minutes of the last meeting?

senses.definition_vi: xảy ra như là kết quả của một tình huống cụ thể

senses.definition: to begin to exist or develop

examples.x: Several new industries arose in the town.

senses.definition_vi: bắt đầu tồn tại hoặc phát triển

senses.definition: to get out of bed; to stand up

examples.x: He arose at dawn.

senses.definition_vi: ra khỏi giường; đứng dậy

senses.definition: to come together to protest about something or to fight for something

examples.x: The peasants arose against their masters.

senses.definition_vi: tập hợp lại để phản đối điều gì đó hoặc để đấu tranh cho điều gì đó

senses.definition: to gradually start to be seen as you move towards it
senses.definition_vi: dần dần bắt đầu được nhìn thấy khi bạn di chuyển về phía nó

senses.definition: either of the two long parts that stick out from the top of the body and connect the shoulders to the hands

examples.x: He escaped with only a broken arm.
Pearl wrapped her arms around her son and hugged him tightly.
She threw her arms around his neck.
He was running forward, waving his arms.
The officer grabbed him by the arm (= grabbed his arm).
She cradled the child in her arms.
They fell asleep in each other's arms (= holding each other).
He walked in with a tall, elegant woman on his arm (= next to him and holding his arm).
He was carrying a number of files under his arm (= between his arm and his body).
He held the dirty rag at arm's length (= as far away from his body as possible).
When we are hungry we tend to eat whatever is within arm's reach (= close enough to be picked up easily).
They walked along arm in arm (= with the arm of one person linked with the arm of the other).
She touched him gently on the arm.
Vincent folded his arms across his chest and turned to walk away.
He has a tattoo on his upper right arm.

senses.definition_vi: một trong hai bộ phận dài nhô ra từ đỉnh cơ thể và nối vai với bàn tay

senses.definition: the part of a piece of clothing that covers the arm

examples.x: The arms will need shortening.

senses.definition_vi: bộ phận của một bộ quần áo che cánh tay

senses.definition: the part of a chair, etc. on which you rest your arms

examples.x: She perched on the arm of the chair.

senses.definition_vi: bộ phận của ghế, v.v. mà bạn đặt tay lên

senses.definition: a long narrow part of an object or a machine, especially one that moves

examples.x: a robotic arm

senses.definition_vi: một bộ phận dài hẹp của một vật thể hoặc máy móc, đặc biệt là một bộ phận có thể di chuyển

senses.definition: a long narrow piece of water or land that is joined to a larger area

examples.x: A small bridge spans the arm of the river.

senses.definition_vi: một dải nước hoặc đất dài hẹp nối với một khu vực lớn hơn

senses.definition: a section of a large organization that deals with one particular activity

examples.x: the research arm of the company
The bank plans to sell part of its US finance arm.

senses.definition_vi: một bộ phận của một tổ chức lớn xử lý một hoạt động cụ thể

senses.definition: with your hands on your hips and your elbows pointing away from your body

examples.x: She stood looking at him with arms akimbo.

senses.definition_vi: với hai tay chống hông và khuỷu tay dang ra hai bên

senses.definition: very long

examples.x: There's a list of repairs as long as your arm.

senses.definition_vi: rất dài

senses.definition: a very small baby that cannot yet walk
senses.definition_vi: một em bé rất nhỏ chưa biết đi

senses.definition: to be a soldier; to fight
senses.definition_vi: trở thành một người lính; chiến đấu

senses.definition: to take a risk although you will probably fail
senses.definition_vi: mạo hiểm mặc dù bạn có thể sẽ thất bại

senses.definition: to cost/pay a lot of money
senses.definition_vi: tốn/trả nhiều tiền

senses.definition: to put one of your arms over the other one and hold them against your body

examples.x: He stood watching her with his arms folded across his chest.
She folded her arms and stared at him.

senses.definition_vi: đặt một cánh tay lên cánh tay kia và giữ chúng sát cơ thể

senses.definition: to put your arms around somebody and hold them against your body
senses.definition_vi: vòng hai tay quanh ai đó và ôm họ sát cơ thể

senses.definition: used to say that somebody is willing to give up a lot in order to have or do something that they really want

examples.x: I'd have given my right arm to have been there with them.

senses.definition_vi: được sử dụng để nói rằng ai đó sẵn sàng từ bỏ nhiều thứ để có hoặc làm điều gì đó mà họ thực sự muốn

senses.definition: to avoid having a close relationship with somebody

examples.x: He keeps all his clients at arm's length.
She kept him at arm's length for months.

senses.definition_vi: tránh có mối quan hệ thân thiết với ai đó

senses.definition: the power and/or authority of something

examples.x: There is no escape from the long arm of the law.

senses.definition_vi: sức mạnh và/hoặc thẩm quyền của một cái gì đó

senses.definition: something that encourages somebody/something or gives them the help they need

examples.x: Their enthusiasm has been a shot in the arm for all of us.

senses.definition_vi: một cái gì đó khuyến khích ai đó/điều gì đó hoặc mang lại cho họ sự giúp đỡ mà họ cần

senses.definition: to persuade or force somebody to do something
senses.definition_vi: thuyết phục hoặc buộc ai đó làm điều gì đó

senses.definition: if you welcome somebody with open arms, you are extremely happy and pleased to see them
senses.definition_vi: nếu bạn chào đón ai đó bằng vòng tay rộng mở, bạn cực kỳ vui mừng và hài lòng khi gặp họ

senses.definition: to plan or organize something in advance

examples.x: The party was arranged quickly.
Can I arrange an appointment for Monday?
The meeting was provisionally arranged for 9 October.
She arranged a loan with the bank.
We met at six, as arranged.
We've still got to arrange how to get to the airport.
Have you arranged to meet him?
I've arranged that we can borrow their car.

examples.cf: arrange for something to do something
examples.x: We arranged for a car to collect us from the airport.
The president arranged for a meeting in his office.
I've arranged with the neighbours about feeding the cat while we are away.

senses.definition_vi: lên kế hoạch hoặc tổ chức một cái gì đó trước

senses.definition: to put something in a particular order; to make something neat or attractive

examples.x: The books are arranged alphabetically by author.
The photos are arranged in chronological order.
I arranged the flowers in a vase.
The streets are arranged in a grid pattern.
I must arrange my financial affairs and make a will.

senses.definition_vi: đặt một cái gì đó theo một thứ tự cụ thể; làm cho một cái gì đó gọn gàng hoặc hấp dẫn

senses.definition: to change a piece of music so that it is suitable for a particular instrument or voice

examples.x: He arranged traditional folk songs for the piano.

senses.definition_vi: thay đổi một bản nhạc để nó phù hợp với một nhạc cụ hoặc giọng hát cụ thể

senses.definition: a plan or preparation that you make so that something can happen

examples.x: Travel and accommodation arrangements have been finalized.
I'll make arrangements for you to be met at the airport.

senses.definition_vi: một kế hoạch hoặc sự chuẩn bị mà bạn thực hiện để một điều gì đó có thể xảy ra

senses.definition: the way things are done or organized

examples.x: She's happy with her unusual living arrangements.
new security arrangements
There are special arrangements for people working overseas.
Their domestic arrangements were considered unconventional at the time.

senses.definition_vi: cách mọi thứ được thực hiện hoặc tổ chức

senses.definition: an agreement that you make with somebody that you can both accept

examples.x: We can come to an arrangement over the price.
an arrangement between the school and the parents
Guided tours are available by prior arrangement with the museum.

examples.cf: arrangement with somebody to do something
examples.x: They worked out an arrangement with another company to handle things.
They had an arrangement that the children would spend two weeks with each parent.

senses.definition_vi: một thỏa thuận mà bạn đạt được với ai đó mà cả hai đều có thể chấp nhận

senses.definition: a group of things that are organized or placed in a particular order or position; the act of placing things in a particular order

examples.x: plans of the possible seating arrangements
the art of flower arrangement

senses.definition_vi: một nhóm các vật được tổ chức hoặc đặt theo một thứ tự hoặc vị trí cụ thể; hành động đặt các vật theo một thứ tự cụ thể

senses.definition: a piece of music that has been changed, for example for another instrument to play

examples.x: an arrangement of a Mozart aria for clarinet and piano

senses.definition_vi: một bản nhạc đã được thay đổi, ví dụ để một nhạc cụ khác chơi

senses.definition: a thin stick with a sharp point at one end, which is shot from a bow

examples.x: a bow and arrow
to fire/shoot an arrow
The road continues as straight as an arrow.

senses.definition_vi: một que mỏng có đầu nhọn ở một đầu, được bắn từ cung

senses.definition: a mark or sign like an arrow (➞), used to show direction or position

examples.x: Follow the arrows.
Use the arrow keys to move the cursor.

senses.definition_vi: một dấu hoặc ký hiệu giống như mũi tên (➞), được sử dụng để chỉ hướng hoặc vị trí

senses.definition: to say or write something in the form of a question, in order to get information

examples.x: How old are you—if you don’t mind me/my asking?
He asked about her family.
Can I ask a question?
Did you ask the price?
You do what I tell you to, no questions asked.
There are three important questions to ask.
frequently asked questions
‘Where are you going?’ she asked.
‘Are you sure?’ he asked her.
She asked the students their names.
I often get asked that!
I had to ask myself some very difficult questions.
I'd like to ask you a few questions.
Why does everyone keep asking me that?
The interviewer asked me about my future plans.
When specifically asked about the report, she indicated she had not read it.
He asked where I lived.
I had to ask the teacher what to do next.
I was asked if/whether I could drive.

senses.definition_vi: nói hoặc viết một cái gì đó dưới dạng câu hỏi, để lấy thông tin

senses.definition: to tell somebody that you would like them to do something or that you would like something to happen

examples.x: Anyone with information is asked to contact the police.
Parents with young children are asked to attend this meeting.
They were politely asked to leave the shop.
Eric asked me to marry him.
All the students were asked to complete a questionnaire.
I asked whether they could change my ticket.
She asked me if I would give her English lessons.
She asked that she be kept informed of developments.
She asked that she should be kept informed.
If you ask her nicely, she'll give you a hand.

senses.definition_vi: nói với ai đó rằng bạn muốn họ làm điều gì đó hoặc bạn muốn điều gì đó xảy ra

senses.definition: to say that you would like somebody to give you something

examples.x: Don't be afraid to ask for help.
I am writing to ask for some information about courses.
to ask for a job/a drink/an explanation
Did your friend ask for permission to use the image?
Why don't you ask his advice?
Why don't you ask him for his advice?
Can I ask a favour of you?
Can I ask you a favour?

senses.definition_vi: nói rằng bạn muốn ai đó cho bạn một cái gì đó

senses.definition: to request permission to do something

examples.x: I immediately asked to speak to a supervisor.
I asked to see the manager.
Did you ask to use the car?
I'll ask if it's all right to park here.
She asked her boss whether she could have the day off.

senses.definition_vi: xin phép làm điều gì đó

senses.definition: to invite somebody

examples.x: They've asked me to dinner.
Thank you so much for asking me.
I didn't ask them in (= to come into the house).
We must ask the neighbours round (= to our house).
She's asked him to come to the party.

senses.definition_vi: mời ai đó

senses.definition: to request a particular amount of money for something that you are selling

examples.x: He's asking £2 000 for the car.
How much were they asking for their house?

senses.definition_vi: yêu cầu một số tiền cụ thể cho một thứ bạn đang bán

senses.definition: to expect or demand something

examples.x: I know I'm asking a great deal.
You're asking too much of him.
I know it's asking a lot to expect them to win again.

senses.definition_vi: mong đợi hoặc đòi hỏi một cái gì đó

senses.definition: to deserve something bad that happens to you or that somebody does to you

examples.x: ‘You shouldn’t have said that to her.’ ‘Well, she asked for it!’

senses.definition_vi: xứng đáng nhận điều gì đó tồi tệ xảy ra với bạn hoặc ai đó làm với bạn

senses.definition: to behave in a way that is very likely to result in trouble

examples.x: He was asking for trouble when he insulted their country.

senses.definition_vi: hành xử theo cách rất có khả năng dẫn đến rắc rối

senses.definition: if you say don’t ask to somebody, you mean that you do not want to reply to their question, because it would be difficult to explain, embarrassing, etc.

examples.x: ‘And what did he do then?’ ‘Don’t ask!’

senses.definition_vi: nếu bạn nói 'đừng hỏi' với ai đó, bạn có nghĩa là bạn không muốn trả lời câu hỏi của họ, vì nó sẽ khó giải thích, đáng xấu hổ, v.v.

senses.definition: if you say don’t ask me, you mean that you do not know the answer to a question and are annoyed you have been asked

examples.x: ‘What will the meeting be about?’ ‘Don’t ask me.’

senses.definition_vi: nếu bạn nói 'đừng hỏi tôi', bạn có nghĩa là bạn không biết câu trả lời cho một câu hỏi và khó chịu vì đã bị hỏi

senses.definition: if you can have something for the asking, it is very easy for you to get it if you ask for it

examples.x: The job is yours for the asking.

senses.definition_vi: nếu bạn có thể có được thứ gì đó 'chỉ cần hỏi', thì rất dễ để bạn có được nó nếu bạn yêu cầu

senses.definition: if you say I ask you, you are expressing shock, anger or a strong feeling of dislike about something/somebody

examples.x: He told me I had to work late on Friday night. I ask you!

senses.definition_vi: nếu bạn nói 'tôi hỏi bạn', bạn đang bày tỏ sự sốc, tức giận hoặc cảm giác ghê tởm mạnh mẽ về điều gì đó/ai đó

senses.definition: in my personal opinion

examples.x: Their marriage was a mistake, if you ask me.

senses.definition_vi: theo ý kiến cá nhân của tôi

senses.definition: sleeping

examples.x: I waited until they were all fast asleep (= sleeping deeply).
The baby was sound asleep (= sleeping deeply) upstairs.
He was so exhausted that he fell asleep at his desk.
My mother fell asleep at the wheel (= while driving) and crashed into a tree.
She was still half asleep (= not fully awake) when she arrived at work.
The police found him asleep in a garage.

senses.definition_vi: đang ngủ

senses.definition: used to describe a part of the body that has no feeling in it, usually because it has been in the same position for too long

examples.x: I couldn't move straight away, as my leg was completely asleep.

senses.definition_vi: được sử dụng để mô tả một bộ phận cơ thể không có cảm giác, thường là do nó ở cùng một vị trí quá lâu

senses.definition: not paying enough attention to what you need to do

examples.x: They were asleep on the job as the financial crisis deepened.
Let's hope the regulators are not asleep at the wheel.
Somebody must have been asleep at the switch to allow this to happen.

senses.definition_vi: không chú ý đủ đến những gì bạn cần làm

senses.definition: a particular part or feature of a situation, an idea, a problem, etc.; a way in which it may be considered

examples.x: The book aims to cover all aspects of city life.
The exhibition will focus on various aspects of life and culture in the Middle Ages.
the most important aspect of the debate
She felt she had looked at the problem from every aspect.
This was one aspect of her character he hadn't seen before.
We have worked very hard on certain aspects of our game.
The consultancy gives advice to manufacturers on the health and safety aspects of their products.

senses.definition_vi: một phần hoặc đặc điểm cụ thể của một tình huống, một ý tưởng, một vấn đề, v.v.; một cách nó có thể được xem xét

senses.definition: the appearance of a place, a situation or a person

examples.x: Events began to take on a more sinister aspect.
the dirty and seedy aspect of the bar

senses.definition_vi: vẻ ngoài của một địa điểm, một tình huống hoặc một người

senses.definition: the direction in which a building, window, piece of land, etc. faces; the side of a building that faces a particular direction

examples.x: Our room had a western aspect.
The southern aspect of the school was dominated by the mountain.

senses.definition_vi: hướng mà một tòa nhà, cửa sổ, mảnh đất, v.v. đối diện; mặt của một tòa nhà đối diện với một hướng cụ thể

senses.definition: the form of a verb that shows, for example, whether the action happens once or repeatedly, is completed or still continuing
senses.definition_vi: hình thái của động từ cho biết, ví dụ, liệu hành động xảy ra một lần hay lặp đi lặp lại, đã hoàn thành hay vẫn đang tiếp diễn

senses.definition: to come together as a group; to bring people or things together as a group

examples.x: All the students were asked to assemble in the main hall.
She then addressed the assembled company (= all the people there).
to assemble evidence/data
The manager has assembled a world-class team.
He tried to assemble his thoughts.

senses.definition_vi: tụ họp thành một nhóm; mang mọi người hoặc mọi vật lại với nhau thành một nhóm

senses.definition: to fit together all the separate parts of something, for example a piece of furniture

examples.x: The shelves are easy to assemble.

senses.definition_vi: lắp ráp tất cả các bộ phận riêng lẻ của một cái gì đó, ví dụ như một món đồ nội thất

senses.definition: to state clearly and definitely that something is true

examples.x: She continued to assert that she was innocent.
The report asserts confidently that the industry will grow.
She continued to assert her innocence.
The German Chancellor was anxious to assert his government's commitment to European unity.
‘That is wrong,’ he asserted.
It is commonly asserted that older people prefer to receive care from family members.

senses.definition_vi: nêu rõ ràng và dứt khoát rằng một điều gì đó là đúng

senses.definition: to behave in a confident and determined way so that other people pay attention to your opinions

examples.x: You’re too timid—you must try to assert yourself more.

senses.definition_vi: hành xử một cách tự tin và quyết đoán để người khác chú ý đến ý kiến của bạn

senses.definition: to make other people recognize your right or authority to do something, by behaving in a determined and confident way

examples.x: to assert your independence/rights
I was determined to assert my authority from the beginning.

senses.definition_vi: làm cho người khác nhận ra quyền hoặc thẩm quyền của bạn để làm điều gì đó, bằng cách hành xử một cách quyết đoán và tự tin

senses.definition: to start to have an effect

examples.x: Good sense asserted itself.

senses.definition_vi: bắt đầu có tác dụng

senses.definition: a statement saying that you strongly believe something to be true

examples.x: He was correct in his assertion that the minister had been lying.
Do you have any evidence to support your assertions?

senses.definition_vi: một tuyên bố nói rằng bạn tin chắc điều gì đó là đúng

senses.definition: the act of stating, using or claiming something strongly

examples.x: the assertion of his authority
The demonstration was an assertion of the right to peaceful protest.

senses.definition_vi: hành động tuyên bố, sử dụng hoặc yêu cầu một cái gì đó một cách mạnh mẽ

senses.definition: to make a judgement about the nature or quality of somebody/something

examples.x: Accurately assessing environmental impacts is very complex.
to assess a patient’s needs
It's difficult to assess the effects of these changes.
Interviews allow you to assess the suitability of candidates.
She engaged a safety consultant to assess the risks.
Quality of life was assessed using a questionnaire.
The young men were assessed as either safe or unsafe drivers.
I'd assess your chances as low.
The committee assesses whether a building is worth preserving.
We are trying to assess how well the system works.

senses.definition_vi: đưa ra một nhận định về bản chất hoặc chất lượng của ai đó/cái gì đó

senses.definition: to calculate the amount or value of something

examples.x: They have assessed the amount of compensation to be paid.
Damage to the building was assessed at £40 000.

senses.definition_vi: tính toán số lượng hoặc giá trị của một cái gì đó

senses.definition: to think or accept that something is true but without having proof of it

examples.x: It is reasonable to assume (that) the economy will continue to improve.
It's probably safe to assume (that) we'll be hearing more about this story.
Let us assume for a moment that the plan succeeds.
She would, he assumed, be home at the usual time.
It is generally assumed that stress is caused by too much work.
Don't always assume the worst (= that something bad has happened).
In this example we have assumed a unit price of $10.
I had assumed him to be a Belgian.

senses.definition_vi: nghĩ hoặc chấp nhận rằng điều gì đó là đúng nhưng không có bằng chứng về nó

senses.definition: to take or begin to have power or responsibility

examples.x: Rebel forces have assumed control of the capital.
The court assumed responsibility for the girl's welfare.
Goodman will assume the role of president.
Lynch assumed office in April.

senses.definition_vi: tiếp nhận hoặc bắt đầu có quyền lực hoặc trách nhiệm

senses.definition: to begin to have a particular quality or appearance

examples.x: This matter has assumed considerable importance.
In the story the god assumes the form of an eagle.

senses.definition_vi: bắt đầu có một phẩm chất hoặc vẻ ngoài đặc biệt

senses.definition: to pretend to have a particular feeling or quality

examples.x: He assumed an air of concern.
He had assumed a stage Southern accent.

senses.definition_vi: giả vờ có một cảm giác hoặc phẩm chất đặc biệt

senses.definition: a belief or feeling that something is true or that something will happen, although there is no proof

examples.x: an underlying/implicit assumption
We need to challenge some of the basic assumptions of Western philosophy.
We are working on the assumption that everyone invited will turn up.
It was impossible to make assumptions about people's reactions.
His actions were based on a false assumption.
She arrived at college with a whole set of assumptions inherited from her family.

senses.definition_vi: một niềm tin hoặc cảm giác rằng điều gì đó là đúng hoặc sẽ xảy ra, mặc dù không có bằng chứng

senses.definition: the act of taking or beginning to have power or responsibility

examples.x: their assumption of power/control
the assumption of responsibility by the government for the disaster

senses.definition_vi: hành động tiếp nhận hoặc bắt đầu có quyền lực hoặc trách nhiệm

senses.definition: a statement that something will certainly be true or will certainly happen, particularly when there has been doubt about it

examples.x: They called for assurances that the government is committed to its education policy.
Unemployment seems to be rising, despite repeated assurances to the contrary.

senses.definition_vi: một lời khẳng định rằng điều gì đó chắc chắn sẽ đúng hoặc chắc chắn sẽ xảy ra, đặc biệt khi đã có nghi ngờ về nó

senses.definition: belief in your own abilities or strengths

examples.x: There was an air of easy assurance about him.
It was good to see some of her old assurance coming back.

senses.definition_vi: niềm tin vào khả năng hoặc điểm mạnh của bản thân

senses.definition: a type of insurance in which money is paid out when somebody dies or after an agreed period of time

examples.x: a life assurance company
We bought a life assurance policy.

senses.definition_vi: một loại bảo hiểm trong đó tiền được chi trả khi ai đó qua đời hoặc sau một khoảng thời gian đã thỏa thuận

senses.definition: to tell somebody that something is definitely true or is definitely going to happen, especially when they have doubts about it

examples.x: You think I did it deliberately, but I assure you (that) I did not.
Let me assure you that I will try to help you.
We were assured that everything possible was being done.
She's perfectly safe, I can assure you.
We assured him of our support.
I won’t let you down, I can assure you of that.
‘He'll come back,’ Susan assured her.

senses.definition_vi: nói với ai đó rằng điều gì đó chắc chắn là đúng hoặc chắc chắn sẽ xảy ra, đặc biệt là khi họ có nghi ngờ về nó

senses.definition: to make yourself certain about something

examples.x: He assured himself of her safety.
She assured herself that the letter was still in the drawer.

senses.definition_vi: tự làm cho mình chắc chắn về một điều gì đó

senses.definition: to make something certain to happen

examples.x: Victory would assure a place in the finals.
Victory would assure them a place in the finals.
This achievement has assured her a place in the history books.

senses.definition_vi: làm cho một điều gì đó chắc chắn xảy ra

senses.definition: to insure something, especially against somebody’s death

examples.x: What is the sum assured?

senses.definition_vi: bảo hiểm một cái gì đó, đặc biệt là chống lại cái chết của ai đó

senses.definition: very surprising; difficult to believe

examples.x: She ran 100m in an astonishing 10.6 seconds.
I find it absolutely astonishing that you didn't like it.

senses.definition_vi: rất đáng ngạc nhiên; khó tin

senses.definition: to fasten or join one thing to another

examples.x: I attach a copy of my notes for your information.
A copy of his document is attached as Appendix 3 at the end of this book.
Attach the coupon to the front of your letter.
They have attached a number of conditions to the agreement (= said that the conditions must be part of the agreement)

senses.definition_vi: buộc hoặc nối một thứ này với một thứ khác

senses.definition: to send an electronic document with an email

examples.x: I attach a copy of the spreadsheet.
I am attaching the image as a PDF file.

senses.definition_vi: gửi một tài liệu điện tử cùng với email

senses.definition: to believe that something is important or worth thinking about

examples.cf: attach importance, significance, value, weight to something
examples.x: I attach great importance to this research.
I wouldn't attach too much weight to these findings.

senses.definition_vi: tin rằng điều gì đó là quan trọng hoặc đáng để suy nghĩ

senses.definition: to join somebody for a time, sometimes when you are not welcome or have not been invited

examples.x: He attached himself to me at the party and I couldn't get rid of him.

senses.definition_vi: đi cùng ai đó trong một thời gian, đôi khi khi bạn không được chào đón hoặc không được mời

senses.definition: to be connected with somebody/something; to connect something to something

examples.x: No one is suggesting that any health risks attach to this product.
No blame attaches to you.
This does not attach any blame to you.
Nowadays, there is less stigma attached to mental illness than in the past.

senses.definition_vi: liên quan đến ai đó/cái gì đó; nối một cái gì đó với một cái gì đó

senses.definition: to succeed in getting something, usually after a lot of effort

examples.x: Most of our students attained five ‘A’ grades in their exams.
We only consider applicants who have attained a high level of academic achievement.
attain (a) degree/standard/level/proficiency/mastery

senses.definition_vi: thành công trong việc đạt được một cái gì đó, thường là sau nhiều nỗ lực

senses.definition: to reach a particular age, level or condition

examples.x: The cheetah can attain speeds of up to 97 kph.

senses.definition_vi: đạt đến một độ tuổi, cấp độ hoặc tình trạng nhất định

senses.definition: an act of trying to do something, especially something difficult, often with no success

examples.x: I passed my driving test at the first attempt.
They made no attempt to escape.
The launch will go ahead despite the failure of previous attempts to create an online business.
Why have repeated attempts to find a permanent solution to the problem failed?
They were frustrated in their attempts to get an explanation.
He has failed in three previous attempts to win the world title.

examples.cf: in an attempt to do something
examples.x: Two factories were closed in an attempt to cut costs.
The couple made an unsuccessful attempt at a compromise.
They were praised for making an attempt at solving the problem.

senses.definition_vi: hành động cố gắng làm một điều gì đó, đặc biệt là một điều khó khăn, thường không thành công

senses.definition: an act of trying to kill somebody

examples.x: Someone has made an attempt on the president's life.
an assassination attempt
a murder/suicide attempt

senses.definition_vi: hành động cố gắng giết ai đó

senses.definition: an effort to do better than something, such as a very good performance in sport

examples.x: his attempt on the world land speed record
a world-record attempt

senses.definition_vi: nỗ lực để làm tốt hơn một cái gì đó, chẳng hạn như một màn trình diễn rất tốt trong thể thao

senses.definition: a thing that you produce as a result of trying to make or achieve something

examples.x: He was clearly pleased with his first attempt at a cake.

senses.definition_vi: một thứ bạn tạo ra như kết quả của việc cố gắng làm hoặc đạt được một cái gì đó

senses.definition: used for asking people to listen to something that is being announced

examples.x: Attention, please! Passengers for flight KL412 are requested to go to gate 21 immediately.

senses.definition_vi: dùng để yêu cầu mọi người lắng nghe điều gì đó đang được thông báo

senses.definition: used for ordering soldiers to stand to attention
senses.definition_vi: dùng để ra lệnh cho binh lính đứng nghiêm

senses.definition: the way that you think and feel about somebody/something; the way that you behave towards somebody/something that shows how you think and feel

examples.x: These societies have to change their attitudes towards women.
the government’s attitude towards single parents
to have a positive/negative attitude towards somebody/something
changes in public attitudes to marriage
social attitudes about education
changing attitudes on issues such as mental health
Youth is simply an attitude of mind.
If you want to pass your exams you'd better change your attitude!
If they can adopt that kind of attitude then the future looks very promising.
You're taking a pretty selfish attitude over this, aren't you?

senses.definition_vi: cách bạn suy nghĩ và cảm nhận về ai đó/cái gì đó; cách bạn cư xử với ai đó/cái gì đó thể hiện cách bạn suy nghĩ và cảm nhận

senses.definition: confident, sometimes aggressive behaviour that shows you do not care about other people’s opinions and that you want to do things in an individual way

examples.x: Don't give me any attitude!
a band with attitude

senses.definition_vi: hành vi tự tin, đôi khi hung hăng, cho thấy bạn không quan tâm đến ý kiến của người khác và bạn muốn làm mọi việc theo cách riêng của mình

senses.definition: a position of the body

examples.x: Her hands were folded in an attitude of prayer.

senses.definition_vi: vị trí của cơ thể

senses.definition: to hold your body in a particular way to create a particular impression

examples.x: to strike a dramatic pose
He strikes an attitude of bravery and lonely defiance.

senses.definition_vi: giữ cơ thể theo một cách nhất định để tạo ấn tượng đặc biệt

senses.definition: if you are attracted by something, it interests you and makes you want it; if you are attracted by somebody, you like or admire them

examples.x: I had always been attracted by the idea of working abroad.
What first attracted me to her was her sense of humour.
She finds herself increasingly attracted to them and their lifestyle.

senses.definition_vi: nếu bạn bị thu hút bởi một cái gì đó, nó làm bạn quan tâm và muốn có nó; nếu bạn bị thu hút bởi ai đó, bạn thích hoặc ngưỡng mộ họ

senses.definition: to have a sexual or romantic interest in somebody

examples.x: I am not attracted to him at all.

senses.definition_vi: có sự quan tâm tình dục hoặc lãng mạn đối với ai đó

senses.definition: to make somebody/something come somewhere or take part in something

examples.x: Officials hope to attract more tourists to the area.
The new city is expected to attract investment worth £45 billion.
The exhibition has attracted thousands of visitors.
to attract a crowd/audience/customers
The warm damp air attracts a lot of mosquitoes.
Figure out how to continue to attract and retain businesses.

senses.definition_vi: làm cho ai đó/cái gì đó đến một nơi nào đó hoặc tham gia vào một cái gì đó

senses.definition: to make people have a particular reaction

examples.x: This proposal has attracted a lot of interest.
His comments were bound to attract criticism.
She tried to attract the attention of the waiter.

senses.definition_vi: làm cho mọi người có một phản ứng cụ thể

senses.definition: if a magnet or gravity attracts something, it makes it move towards it
senses.definition_vi: nếu nam châm hoặc trọng lực hút một vật, nó làm cho vật đó di chuyển về phía nó

senses.definition: used to say that people who are very different are often attracted to each other
senses.definition_vi: dùng để nói rằng những người rất khác nhau thường bị thu hút lẫn nhau

senses.definition: an interesting or lively place to go or thing to do

examples.x: Buckingham Palace is a major tourist attraction.
The main attraction at Giverny is Monet's garden.
Attractions at the fair include a mini-circus, clowns, dancers and a jazz band.
Feeding the animals proved a popular attraction for visitors to the farm.
The library is expected to be a major visitor attraction for the town.

senses.definition_vi: một địa điểm hoặc hoạt động thú vị hoặc sôi nổi để đến

senses.definition: a feeling of liking somebody, especially sexually

examples.x: She felt an immediate attraction to him.
Sexual attraction is a large part of falling in love.
They felt a strong mutual attraction.
My attraction to him was totally physical.

senses.definition_vi: cảm giác thích ai đó, đặc biệt là về mặt tình dục

senses.definition: a feature, quality or person that makes something seem interesting and fun, and worth having or doing

examples.x: I can't see the attraction of sitting on a beach all day.
City life holds little attraction for me.
She is the star attraction of the show.
And there’s the added attraction of free champagne on all flights.
I could now see the attraction of a steady job and regular income.
Long flights hold no attraction for me.
The main attraction of the place is the nightlife.
The stunning landscape is only part of the attraction of the region.
Sophie was plainly the centre of attraction in the room.

senses.definition_vi: một đặc điểm, phẩm chất hoặc con người khiến điều gì đó có vẻ thú vị và vui vẻ, đáng để có hoặc làm

senses.definition: a force that pulls things towards each other

examples.x: gravitational/magnetic attraction

senses.definition_vi: một lực kéo mọi thứ lại gần nhau

senses.definition: pleasant to look at, especially in a sexual way

examples.x: an attractive woman
I like John but I don't find him attractive physically.
I find men look more attractive as they age.

senses.definition_vi: dễ nhìn, đặc biệt là theo cách tình dục

senses.definition: pleasant

examples.x: a big house with an attractive garden
Your new glasses are very attractive.
Antique furniture is used to make an attractive contrast with a modern setting.
That's one of the less attractive aspects of her personality.
The city itself is very attractive.

senses.definition_vi: dễ chịu

senses.definition: having features or qualities that make something seem interesting and worth having

examples.x: an attractive offer/proposition/option
Proposed improvements will make these areas attractive to first-time buyers.
They are able to offer attractive career opportunities to graduates.
The deal is said to be particularly attractive to investors.

senses.definition_vi: có những đặc điểm hoặc phẩm chất khiến điều gì đó có vẻ thú vị và đáng có

senses.definition: calculated by adding several amounts together, finding a total, and dividing the total by the number of amounts

examples.x: The average age of participants was 52 years.
an average rate/cost/price
an average annual income/wage/salary
Average daily summer temperatures are about 20°C .
Average earnings are around £35 000 per annum.
The school has an average class size of 24 students.
at an average speed of 100 miles per hour

senses.definition_vi: được tính bằng cách cộng nhiều số lại với nhau, tìm tổng số và chia tổng số đó cho số lượng các số

senses.definition: typical or normal

examples.x: babies of below average birth weight
£20 for dinner is about average.
The average person can't afford to fly first class everywhere.
40 hours is a fairly average working week for most people.

senses.definition_vi: điển hình hoặc bình thường

senses.definition: ordinary; not especially good

examples.x: I was just an average sort of student.
The route is for walkers of average ability.
The quality has been pretty average (= not very good).

senses.definition_vi: bình thường; không đặc biệt tốt

senses.definition: to prevent something bad from happening

examples.x: to avoid conflict/confrontation
We must find a way to avoid similar problems in future.
They narrowly avoided defeat.
The name was changed to avoid confusion with another firm.
The accident could have been avoided.
Efforts are being made to avoid war at all costs.
They built a wall to avoid soil being washed away.

senses.definition_vi: ngăn chặn điều gì đó tồi tệ xảy ra

senses.definition: to keep away from somebody/something; to try not to do something

examples.x: He's been avoiding me all week.
She kept avoiding my eyes (= avoided looking at me).
By staying at home he manages to avoid all contact with strangers.
Certain foods should be avoided during pregnancy.
I left early to avoid the rush hour.
He tried to avoid paying his taxes and was taken to court.

senses.definition_vi: tránh xa ai đó/điều gì đó; cố gắng không làm điều gì đó

senses.definition: to prevent yourself from hitting something

examples.x: The car swerved to avoid a cat.

senses.definition_vi: ngăn mình va vào thứ gì đó

senses.definition: to try very hard not to meet somebody, do something, etc.

examples.x: She's been avoiding me like the plague since the party last Saturday.
I hate office parties—I avoid them like the plague.

senses.definition_vi: cố gắng hết sức để không gặp ai đó, làm điều gì đó, v.v.

senses.definition: to do/avoid doing something that is a mistake but that seems at first to be a good idea

examples.x: Parents often fall into the trap of trying to do everything for their children.
The movie avoids the trap of spending too much time explaining things.

senses.definition_vi: làm/tránh làm điều gì đó là một sai lầm nhưng thoạt nhìn có vẻ là một ý tưởng hay

senses.definition: to wait for somebody/something

examples.x: He is in custody awaiting trial.
Her latest novel is eagerly awaited.

senses.definition_vi: chờ đợi ai đó/điều gì đó

senses.definition: to be going to happen to somebody

examples.x: A warm welcome awaits all our guests.
Who knows what dangers may await us?

senses.definition_vi: sẽ xảy ra với ai đó

senses.definition: knowing or realizing something

examples.x: As you're aware, this is not a new problem.
As far as I'm aware, nobody has done anything about it.
acutely/painfully/keenly (= very) aware
He was well aware of the problem.
She slipped away without him being aware of it.
They suddenly became aware of people looking at them.
Everybody should be made aware of the risks involved.
We're just making the public aware of the issue.
I am fully aware of the fact that change needs time.
I don't think people are really aware of just how much it costs.
Were you aware that something was wrong?
I was aware that she was trembling.

senses.definition_vi: biết hoặc nhận ra điều gì đó

senses.definition: interested in and knowing about something, and thinking it is important

examples.x: Young people are very environmentally aware.
People are becoming more politically and socially aware.
Food manufacturers are dealing with increasingly aware consumers.

senses.definition_vi: quan tâm và biết về điều gì đó, và cho rằng điều đó là quan trọng

senses.definition: knowing something; knowing that something exists and is important

examples.x: an awareness of the importance of eating a healthy diet
There was an almost complete lack of awareness of the issues involved.
to raise/heighten/increase public awareness of something
a greater/a growing/an increasing awareness of something
a marketing campaign to increase brand awareness
There seems to be a general awareness that this is not the solution.

senses.definition_vi: biết điều gì đó; biết rằng điều gì đó tồn tại và quan trọng

senses.definition: interest in and concern about a particular situation or area of interest

examples.x: environmental awareness
Energy Awareness Week
the emergence of a new social awareness among young people
The group is trying to raise public awareness about homelessness.

senses.definition_vi: sự quan tâm và quan tâm đến một tình huống hoặc lĩnh vực quan tâm cụ thể

senses.definition: very bad or unpleasant

examples.x: That's an awful colour.
‘They didn't even offer to pay.’ ‘Oh that's awful.’
I feel awful about forgetting her birthday.
to look/feel awful (= to look/feel ill)
There's an awful smell in here.
The awful thing is, it was my fault.
It sounds awful to say it, but the war was exciting.
The weather conditions were just awful.
It's awful, isn't it?
The weather last summer was awful.

senses.definition_vi: rất tệ hoặc khó chịu

senses.definition: that shocks people very much

examples.x: the awful horrors of war
It was only later that we learned the awful truth.

senses.definition_vi: gây sốc cho mọi người rất nhiều

senses.definition: used to emphasize something, especially that there is a large amount or too much of something

examples.x: It's going to cost an awful lot of money.
There's not an awful lot of room.
I feel an awful lot better than I did yesterday.
I had an awful job persuading him to come (= it was very difficult).

senses.definition_vi: được sử dụng để nhấn mạnh điều gì đó, đặc biệt là có một lượng lớn hoặc quá nhiều thứ

senses.definition: making you feel embarrassed

examples.x: There was an awkward silence.
I felt awkward because they obviously wanted to be alone.

senses.definition_vi: làm bạn cảm thấy xấu hổ

senses.definition: difficult to deal with

examples.x: Don't ask awkward questions.
You've put me in an awkward position.
an awkward customer (= a person who is difficult to deal with)
Please don't be awkward about letting him come.
It makes things awkward for everyone when you behave like that.

senses.definition_vi: khó xử lý

senses.definition: not convenient

examples.x: Have I come at an awkward time?
That's a bit awkward for me—could we make it earlier?

senses.definition_vi: không thuận tiện

senses.definition: difficult or dangerous because of its shape or design

examples.x: This box is very awkward for one person to carry.
This tool will reach into awkward corners, such as under kitchen units.

senses.definition_vi: khó khăn hoặc nguy hiểm vì hình dạng hoặc thiết kế của nó

senses.definition: not moving in an easy way; not comfortable

examples.x: He tried to dance, but he was too clumsy and awkward.
I must have slept in an awkward position—I'm aching all over.

senses.definition_vi: không di chuyển một cách dễ dàng; không thoải mái

senses.definition: a unit for measuring liquid. In the UK, Canada and other countries it is equal to about 4.5 litres; in the US it is equal to about 3.8 litres. There are four quarts in a gallon.

examples.x: The tankers carried 130 000 gallons of fuel.

senses.definition_vi: một đơn vị đo chất lỏng. Ở Vương quốc Anh, Canada và các quốc gia khác, nó tương đương khoảng 4,5 lít; ở Mỹ, nó tương đương khoảng 3,8 lít. Có bốn quart trong một gallon.

senses.definition: a space where something is missing

examples.x: Extra funding is needed to plug the gap.
Fill the gaps in these sentences.
There are huge gaps in their knowledge.
His death left an enormous gap in my life.
There were several gaps in my education.
We think we've identified a gap in the market (= a business opportunity to make or sell something that is not yet available).

senses.definition_vi: một không gian nơi có thứ gì đó bị thiếu

senses.definition: a space between two things or in the middle of something, especially because there is a part missing

examples.x: There should be a six-inch gap at the bottom.
a gap in a hedge
Leave a gap between your car and the next.
I managed to squeeze through the gap.

senses.definition_vi: một khoảng trống giữa hai vật hoặc ở giữa một cái gì đó, đặc biệt là vì có một phần bị thiếu

senses.definition: a period of time when something stops, or between two events

examples.x: a gap in the conversation
He wrote his first novel in the gap between school and university.
They met again after a gap of twenty years.
There’s a big age gap between them (= a big difference in their ages).

senses.definition_vi: một khoảng thời gian khi điều gì đó dừng lại, hoặc giữa hai sự kiện

senses.definition: a difference that separates people, or their opinions, situation, etc.

examples.x: A huge gap has opened up between expectations and what is deliverable.
The only way to close this gap is to innovate.
the gap between rich and poor
the gap between theory and practice
to bridge the gap between urban and rural communities

senses.definition_vi: sự khác biệt ngăn cách mọi người, hoặc ý kiến, tình huống của họ, v.v.

senses.definition: a long, steady look at somebody/something

examples.x: He met her gaze (= looked at her while she looked at him).
She dropped her gaze (= stopped looking).
In his last years, he lived almost entirely secluded from the public gaze (= away from public attention).

senses.definition_vi: một cái nhìn dài, ổn định vào ai đó/điều gì đó

senses.definition: affecting all or most people, places or things

examples.x: books of general interest (= of interest to most people)
The general feeling was one of relief.
The general opinion is that the conference was a success.
There is general agreement on that point.
The general trend has been a slow decline in output.
The bad weather has been fairly general (= has affected most areas).

senses.definition_vi: ảnh hưởng đến tất cả hoặc hầu hết mọi người, địa điểm hoặc sự vật

senses.definition: normal; usual

examples.x: There is one exception to this general principle.
As a general rule (= usually) he did what he could to be helpful.
This opinion is common among the general population (= ordinary people).

senses.definition_vi: bình thường; thông thường

senses.definition: including the most important aspects of something; not exact or detailed

examples.x: I check the bookings to get a general idea of what activities to plan.
I know how it works in general terms.
They gave a general description of the man.
