Carton here uses the word ‘business’ in a very general sense.

senses.definition_vi: bao gồm các khía cạnh quan trọng nhất của điều gì đó; không chính xác hoặc chi tiết

senses.definition: approximately, but not exactly, the direction/area mentioned

examples.x: They fired in the general direction of the enemy.

senses.definition_vi: xấp xỉ, nhưng không chính xác, hướng/khu vực được đề cập

senses.definition: not limited to a particular subject, use or activity

examples.x: a general hospital
general education
We shall keep the discussion fairly general.

senses.definition_vi: không giới hạn ở một chủ đề, mục đích hoặc hoạt động cụ thể

senses.definition: not limited to one part or aspect of a person or thing

examples.x: a general anaesthetic
The building was in a general state of disrepair.

senses.definition_vi: không giới hạn ở một phần hoặc khía cạnh của một người hoặc sự vật

senses.definition: highest in rank; chief

examples.x: the general manager
the Inspector General of Police

senses.definition_vi: cao nhất trong cấp bậc; chính

senses.definition: usually; mainly

examples.x: In general, Japanese cars are very reliable and breakdowns are rare.

senses.definition_vi: thường xuyên; chủ yếu

senses.definition: as a whole

examples.x: This is a crucial year for your relationships in general and your love life in particular.

senses.definition_vi: nhìn chung, toàn bộ

senses.definition: by or to most people

examples.x: The initiative was generally considered a success.
He is generally regarded as the most important American painter of his generation.
It was not until 1908 that Freud's importance began to be generally recognized.
The plan was generally welcomed.
It is generally accepted/agreed/believed that…
The new drug will be generally available from January.
He was a generally unpopular choice for captain.

senses.definition_vi: đối với hầu hết mọi người; nhìn chung

senses.definition: in most cases

examples.x: I generally get up at six.
These systems generally use solar power.
The male is generally larger with a shorter beak.
Generally speaking, first-time offenders aged 13 and 14 should not be detained in custody.

senses.definition_vi: trong hầu hết các trường hợp

senses.definition: without discussing the details of something

examples.x: Let's talk just about investment generally.

senses.definition_vi: mà không thảo luận chi tiết về điều gì đó

senses.definition: shared by, including or typical of a whole group of things; not specific

examples.x: ‘Vine fruit’ is the generic term for currants and raisins.

senses.definition_vi: chung cho, bao gồm hoặc điển hình của một nhóm lớn sự vật; không cụ thể

senses.definition: not using the name of the company that made it

examples.x: The doctor offered me a choice of a branded or a generic drug.

senses.definition_vi: không sử dụng tên của công ty đã sản xuất ra nó

senses.definition: lacking imagination and so not original

examples.x: The movie was pretty boring, with a generic storyline and emotionless characters.

senses.definition_vi: thiếu trí tưởng tượng và do đó không nguyên bản

senses.definition: truly; in a way that is exactly what it appears to be and is not artificial

examples.x: There are some genuinely funny moments in the film.
The election result was genuinely democratic.
a genuinely new kind of politician

senses.definition_vi: thực sự; theo cách mà nó thực sự trông như thế và không phải là nhân tạo

senses.definition: in a sincere and honest way that can be trusted

examples.x: She was genuinely sorry.

senses.definition_vi: một cách chân thành và trung thực có thể tin cậy

senses.definition: to receive something

examples.x: I got a call from Dave this morning.
What (= What presents) did you get for your birthday?
He gets (= earns) about $40 000 a year.
This room gets very little sunshine.
I got a shock when I saw the bill.
I will report back when I get a chance.
I get the impression that he is bored with his job.
Where did you get the idea from?
It's the best way to get a sense of what's actually going on here.
She got great satisfaction from seeing his embarrassment.

senses.definition_vi: nhận một cái gì đó

senses.definition: to obtain something

examples.x: He has just got a new job.
I'll get the money somehow.
She opened the door wider to get a better look.
Try to get some sleep.
You can also get information on careers in social work from their website.
I think someone's trying to get your attention.
She really knows how to get results.

senses.definition_vi: có được một cái gì đó

senses.definition: to buy something

examples.x: Where did you get that skirt?
Did you manage to get tickets for the concert?
Can I get a Coke?
Did you get a present for your mother?
Did you get your mother a present?
Why don't you get yourself a car?
$100 will get you the basic model.
You can get yourself the basic model for $100.

senses.definition_vi: mua một cái gì đó

senses.definition: to obtain or receive an amount of money by selling something

examples.x: If you sell it at auction you can expect to get roughly £800.
How much did you get for your car?
We got £420 000 for the house.

senses.definition_vi: có được hoặc nhận một khoản tiền bằng cách bán một cái gì đó

senses.definition: to go to a place and bring somebody/something back

examples.x: Quick—go and get a cloth!
Somebody get a doctor!
She went to get help.
I have to go and get my mother from the airport (= collect her).
Get a drink for John.
Get John a drink.

senses.definition_vi: đi đến một địa điểm và mang ai đó/cái gì đó về

senses.definition: to achieve or be given a particular mark or grade in an exam

examples.x: He got a ‘C’ in Chemistry and a ‘B’ in English.

senses.definition_vi: đạt được hoặc được cho một điểm hoặc xếp loại cụ thể trong một kỳ thi

senses.definition: to start to develop an illness; to suffer from a pain, etc.

examples.x: I got this cold off (= from) you!
She gets (= often suffers from) really bad headaches.
I think I'm getting a cold.

senses.definition_vi: bắt đầu phát triển một căn bệnh; bị đau, v.v.

senses.definition: to receive something as a punishment

examples.x: He got ten years (= was sent to prison for ten years) for armed robbery.

senses.definition_vi: nhận một cái gì đó như một sự trừng phạt

senses.definition: to connect to the internet or a phone network; to receive broadcasts from a particular television or radio station

examples.x: 95 per cent of the UK can now get superfast broadband.
I couldn't get any mobile phone reception.
We can't get Channel 5 in our area.

senses.definition_vi: kết nối với internet hoặc mạng điện thoại; nhận tín hiệu từ một đài truyền hình hoặc đài phát thanh cụ thể

senses.definition: to be connected with somebody by phone

examples.x: I wanted to speak to the manager but I got her assistant instead.

senses.definition_vi: được kết nối với ai đó qua điện thoại

senses.definition: to arrive at or reach a place or point

examples.x: We got to San Diego at 7 o'clock.
We're aiming to get to the party at about nine.
You got in very late last night.
I got back an hour ago.
Wait till we get home.
What time did you get here?
Let me know when you get there.
I haven't got very far with the book I'm reading.

senses.definition_vi: đến hoặc tới một địa điểm hoặc điểm nào đó

senses.definition: to move to or from a particular place or in a particular direction, sometimes with difficulty; to make somebody/something do this

examples.x: The bridge was destroyed so we couldn't get across the river.
She got into bed.
He got down from the ladder.
We didn't get (= go) to bed until 3 a.m.
Where do we get on the bus?
I'm getting off (= leaving the train) at the next station.
Where have they got to (= where are they)?
We must be getting home; it's past midnight.
We couldn't get the piano through the door.
We'd better call a taxi and get you home.
The general had to get his troops across the river.
I can't get the lid off.

senses.definition_vi: di chuyển đến hoặc từ một địa điểm cụ thể hoặc theo một hướng cụ thể, đôi khi gặp khó khăn; làm cho ai đó/cái gì đó làm điều này

senses.definition: to use a bus, taxi, plane, etc.

examples.x: We're going to be late—let's get a taxi.
I usually get the bus to work.

senses.definition_vi: sử dụng xe buýt, taxi, máy bay, v.v.

senses.definition: to reach a particular state or condition; to make somebody/something/yourself reach a particular state or condition

examples.x: to get angry/bored/hungry/fat
to get better/worse
You'll soon get used to the climate here.
We ought to go; it's getting late.
to get dressed/undressed (= to put your clothes on/take your clothes off)
They plan to get married in the summer.
She's upstairs getting ready.
As he's got older his tastes have changed.
She was getting sick of hearing him complain.
There's nothing to get excited about.
He got drunk and passed out.
I was starting to get tired.
I wouldn't go there alone; you might get (= be) mugged.
My car got (= was) stolen at the weekend.
Don't get your dress dirty!
He got his fingers caught in the door.
I'm trying to get the children ready for school.

senses.definition_vi: đạt đến một trạng thái hoặc điều kiện cụ thể; làm cho ai đó/cái gì đó/chính bạn đạt đến một trạng thái hoặc điều kiện cụ thể

senses.definition: to reach the point at which you feel, know, are, etc. something

examples.x: After a time you get to realize that these things don't matter.
You'll like her once you get to know her.
His drinking is getting to be a problem.
She's getting to be an old lady now.

senses.definition_vi: đạt đến điểm mà bạn cảm thấy, biết, đang, v.v. điều gì đó

senses.definition: to cause something to happen or be done

examples.x: I must get my hair cut.
I'll never get all this work finished.
She has a reputation for getting things done.

senses.definition_vi: gây ra điều gì đó xảy ra hoặc được thực hiện

senses.definition: to make, persuade, etc. somebody/something to do something

examples.x: I couldn't get the car to start this morning.
He got his sister to help him with his homework.
You'll never get him to understand.
It's not hard to get him talking—the problem is stopping him!
Can you really get that old car going again?

senses.definition_vi: làm cho, thuyết phục, v.v. ai đó/cái gì đó làm điều gì đó

senses.definition: to start doing something

examples.x: I got talking to her.
We need to get going soon.

senses.definition_vi: bắt đầu làm điều gì đó

senses.definition: to have the opportunity to do something

examples.x: He got to try out all the new software.
It's not fair—I never get to go first.

senses.definition_vi: có cơ hội làm điều gì đó

senses.definition: to prepare a meal

examples.x: Who's getting the lunch?
You sit down and relax. I'll get supper.
I must go home and get tea for the kids.
I must go home and get the kids their tea.

senses.definition_vi: chuẩn bị một bữa ăn

senses.definition: to answer the phone or a door when somebody calls, knocks, etc.

examples.x: Will you get the door?

senses.definition_vi: trả lời điện thoại hoặc cửa khi ai đó gọi, gõ cửa, v.v.

senses.definition: to catch or take hold of somebody, especially in order to harm or punish them

examples.x: He was on the run for a week before the police got him.
to get somebody by the arm/wrist/throat
She fell overboard and the sharks got her.
He thinks everybody is out to get him (= trying to harm him).
I'll get you for that!

senses.definition_vi: bắt hoặc nắm lấy ai đó, đặc biệt là để làm hại hoặc trừng phạt họ

senses.definition: to hit or wound somebody

examples.x: The bullet got him in the neck.

senses.definition_vi: đánh hoặc làm bị thương ai đó

senses.definition: to understand somebody/something

examples.x: I don't get you.
She didn't get the joke.
I don't get it—why would she do a thing like that?
I get the message—you don't want me to come.

senses.definition_vi: hiểu ai đó/cái gì đó

senses.definition: used to say that something happens or exists

examples.x: You get (= There are) all these kids hanging around in the street.
They still get cases of typhoid there.

senses.definition_vi: được sử dụng để nói rằng điều gì đó xảy ra hoặc tồn tại

senses.definition: to make somebody feel confused because they do not understand something

examples.x: ‘What's the capital of Bhutan?’ ‘You've got me there!’ (= I don't know)

senses.definition_vi: làm cho ai đó bối rối vì họ không hiểu điều gì đó

senses.definition: to annoy somebody

examples.x: What gets me is having to do the same thing all day long.

senses.definition_vi: làm phiền ai đó

senses.definition: to be becoming old
senses.definition_vi: trở nên già đi

senses.definition: to be becoming late

examples.x: The time's getting on—we ought to be going.

senses.definition_vi: trở nên muộn

senses.definition: to be nearly a particular time, age or number

examples.x: It must be getting on for midnight.
He's getting on for eighty.

senses.definition_vi: gần đến một thời gian, tuổi hoặc số lượng cụ thể

senses.definition: used to say that you are shocked, surprised, etc. by something

examples.x: I can't get over how rude she was.

senses.definition_vi: được sử dụng để nói rằng bạn bị sốc, ngạc nhiên, v.v. bởi điều gì đó

senses.definition: to have a short holiday in a place where you can relax
senses.definition_vi: có một kỳ nghỉ ngắn ở một nơi bạn có thể thư giãn

senses.definition: to leave a place in order to go somewhere else

examples.x: It's been lovely to see you, but it's probably time we got going.

senses.definition_vi: rời khỏi một địa điểm để đi đến một nơi khác

senses.definition: to start happening or being done

examples.x: The project hasn't really got going yet.

senses.definition_vi: bắt đầu xảy ra hoặc được thực hiện

senses.definition: to make somebody angry, worried or excited
senses.definition_vi: làm cho ai đó tức giận, lo lắng hoặc phấn khích

senses.definition: to succeed in starting a machine, vehicle, process, etc.

examples.x: We finally managed to get the car going.

senses.definition_vi: thành công trong việc khởi động một máy, phương tiện, quy trình, v.v.

senses.definition: to be punished or spoken to angrily about something

examples.x: If your dad finds out you'll really get it!

senses.definition_vi: bị phạt hoặc bị nói chuyện giận dữ về điều gì đó

senses.definition: to have sex with somebody
senses.definition_vi: có quan hệ tình dục với ai đó

senses.definition: to have an erection
senses.definition_vi: bị cương cứng

senses.definition: to not help somebody make progress or succeed

examples.x: This line of investigation is getting us nowhere.
Being rude to me won't get you anywhere.

senses.definition_vi: không giúp ai đó tiến bộ hoặc thành công

senses.definition: to make some progress/no progress

examples.x: After six months' work on the project, at last I feel I'm getting somewhere.
I don't seem to be getting anywhere with this essay.

senses.definition_vi: tiến triển/không tiến triển

senses.definition: to achieve your aim or complete a task

examples.x: I'm sure you'll get there in the end.
It's not perfect but we're getting there (= making progress).

senses.definition_vi: đạt được mục tiêu của bạn hoặc hoàn thành một nhiệm vụ

senses.definition: used to say that you are going to tell somebody something that they will find surprising or interesting

examples.x: OK, get this guys—there are only two left!
So get this—I did all the work and he got the money.

senses.definition_vi: được sử dụng để nói rằng bạn sắp nói với ai đó điều mà họ sẽ thấy ngạc nhiên hoặc thú vị

senses.definition: used to express surprise or disapproval that somebody has been so selfish, stupid, etc.
senses.definition_vi: được sử dụng để bày tỏ sự ngạc nhiên hoặc không tán thành rằng ai đó đã ích kỷ, ngu ngốc, v.v.

senses.definition: you have to admit that something unpleasant is true
senses.definition_vi: bạn phải thừa nhận rằng điều gì đó khó chịu là đúng

senses.definition: used to ask, especially in an angry way, what somebody is/was suggesting

examples.x: I'm partly to blame? What exactly are you getting at?

senses.definition_vi: được sử dụng để hỏi, đặc biệt là một cách giận dữ, những gì ai đó đang/đã đề xuất

senses.definition: used to say that somebody has suddenly started to behave in a strange or different way

examples.x: What's got into Alex? He never used to worry like that.
I’m sorry for laughing like that—I don’t know what got into me.

senses.definition_vi: được sử dụng để nói rằng ai đó đột nhiên bắt đầu hành xử một cách kỳ lạ hoặc khác biệt

senses.definition: very large; much larger or more important than similar things usually are

examples.x: The match was shown on a giant screen outside the town hall.
a giant step towards achieving independence
a giant squid
a giant-size box of tissues

senses.definition_vi: (trong truyện) một người rất lớn, khỏe mạnh, thường độc ác và ngu ngốc

senses.definition: a thing that you give to somebody, especially on a special occasion or to say thank you

examples.x: to give/receive a gift
a Christmas/birthday/wedding gift
Thank you for your generous gift.
The watch was a gift from my mother.
a free gift for every reader
This dinner is my gift to you.
gifts of toys for the children
By becoming a blood donor you will be making a vital gift of life to someone else.
The family made a gift of his paintings to the gallery.
She gave me the book as a gift.

senses.definition_vi: một thứ bạn tặng cho ai đó, đặc biệt là vào dịp đặc biệt hoặc để nói lời cảm ơn

senses.definition: a natural ability

examples.x: She can pick up a tune instantly on the piano. It's a gift.
He knew from an early age he had a special gift.
She showed a natural gift for comedy.
He has a gift for making friends easily.
his great gifts as a teacher

senses.definition_vi: một khả năng tự nhiên

senses.definition: a thing that is very easy to do or cheap to buy

examples.x: Their second goal was an absolute gift.
At £500 it's a gift.

senses.definition_vi: một thứ rất dễ làm hoặc rẻ tiền để mua

senses.definition: if something such as an important job or a special right or advantage is in somebody’s gift, that person can decide who to give it to

examples.x: All such posts are in the gift of the managing director (= only given by the managing director).

senses.definition_vi: nếu một công việc quan trọng hoặc một đặc quyền hoặc lợi thế đặc biệt nằm trong quyền quyết định của ai đó, người đó có thể quyết định trao nó cho ai

senses.definition: the ability to speak easily and to persuade other people with your words

examples.x: Joe’s got the gift of the gab—he can sell anything.

senses.definition_vi: khả năng nói năng lưu loát và thuyết phục người khác bằng lời nói của mình

senses.definition: a person who thinks that they are particularly good at something or who thinks that somebody will find them particularly attractive

examples.x: He seems to think he's God's gift to women.

senses.definition_vi: một người nghĩ rằng họ đặc biệt giỏi về một điều gì đó hoặc nghĩ rằng ai đó sẽ thấy họ đặc biệt hấp dẫn

senses.definition: to refuse or criticize something that is given to you for nothing

examples.x: I’m never one to look a gift horse in the mouth.

senses.definition_vi: từ chối hoặc chỉ trích một cái gì đó được tặng cho bạn miễn phí

senses.definition: to hand something to somebody so that they can look at it, use it or keep it for a time

examples.x: Give the letter to your mother when you've read it.
She gave her ticket to the woman at the check-in desk.
Give your mother the letter.
They were all given a box to carry.

senses.definition_vi: trao một thứ gì đó cho ai đó để họ xem, sử dụng hoặc giữ trong một thời gian

senses.definition: to hand something to somebody as a present; to allow somebody to have something as a present

examples.x: What are you giving your father for his birthday?
She was given a huge bunch of flowers.
Did you give the waiter a tip?
She gave a couple of pounds to a homeless man.
We all agreed not to give presents this year.
They say it's better to give than to receive.

senses.definition_vi: trao một thứ gì đó cho ai đó như một món quà; cho phép ai đó có được thứ gì đó như một món quà

senses.definition: to provide somebody with something

examples.x: They were all thirsty so I gave them a drink.
Give me your name and address.
We've been given a 2 per cent pay increase.
I was hoping you would give me a job.
He was given a new heart in a five-hour operation.
Give me some time to decide.
We should at least give him the opportunity to explain why he did this.
This should give you some idea of the extent of the problem.
Can you give us some sense of exactly what is at stake here?
We'll give you all the help we can.
She wants a job that gives her more responsibility.
Can I give you a ride to the station?
I'll give you (= allow you to have) ten minutes to prepare your answer.
Don't give me any of that backchat (= don't be rude).
He gives Italian lessons to his colleagues.
The reforms should give a better chance to the less able children.
She gave some helpful advice.
She gives the impression of being very busy.
I was asked to give evidence at the trial.

senses.definition_vi: cung cấp cho ai đó một cái gì đó

senses.definition: to pay money to a charity, etc., to help people

examples.x: We need your help—please give generously.
They both gave regularly to charity.
I gave a small donation.
A lot of people give money to good causes.

senses.definition_vi: trả tiền cho một tổ chức từ thiện, v.v., để giúp đỡ mọi người

senses.definition: to pay in order to have or do something

examples.x: I'll give you £100 and not a penny more!
How much will you give me for the car?
I'd give anything to see him again.
I gave £50 for the lot.

senses.definition_vi: trả tiền để có hoặc làm một cái gì đó

senses.definition: used with a noun to describe a particular action, giving the same meaning as the related verb

examples.x: She gave a shrug of her shoulders (= shrugged).
He turned to us and gave a big smile (= smiled broadly).
She looked up from her work and gave a yawn (= yawned).
He gave a loud cry (= cried out loudly) and fell to the floor.
Her work has given pleasure to (= pleased) millions of readers.
He gave her a kiss (= kissed her).
I have to admit that the news gave us a shock (= shocked us).
He gave me a suspicious look (= looked at me suspiciously).

senses.definition_vi: được sử dụng với một danh từ để mô tả một hành động cụ thể, mang ý nghĩa tương tự như động từ liên quan

senses.definition: to produce a particular feeling in somebody

examples.x: All that driving has given me a headache.
Go for a walk. It'll give you an appetite.

senses.definition_vi: tạo ra một cảm giác cụ thể ở ai đó

senses.definition: to make a phone call to somebody

examples.x: Give me a call tomorrow.
I'll give you a ring.

senses.definition_vi: thực hiện một cuộc gọi điện thoại cho ai đó

senses.definition: to judge somebody/something to be of a particular standard

examples.x: She had given the assignment an A.
I give it ten out of ten for originality.
He virtually never gives a grade of less than C.
I gave top marks to her essay.

senses.definition_vi: đánh giá ai đó/cái gì đó đạt một tiêu chuẩn nhất định

senses.definition: to pass an illness onto somebody and make them ill

examples.x: You've given me your cold.
She'd given the bug to all her colleagues.

senses.definition_vi: truyền một căn bệnh cho ai đó và làm họ bị ốm

senses.definition: to make somebody suffer a particular punishment

examples.x: The judge gave him a nine-month suspended sentence.
We discussed what punishment should be given to the boys.

senses.definition_vi: làm cho ai đó phải chịu một hình phạt cụ thể

senses.definition: if you give a party, you organize it and invite people

examples.x: We're giving a party to celebrate our silver wedding.

senses.definition_vi: tổ chức và mời mọi người đến một bữa tiệc

senses.definition: to perform something in public

examples.x: He gave a rousing performance of the Bob Marley song.
She gave a reading from her latest volume of poetry.
The President will be giving a press conference this afternoon.
She gave a fine speech to the waiting crowd.

senses.definition_vi: thực hiện một điều gì đó trước công chúng

senses.definition: to use time, energy, etc. for somebody/something

examples.x: I gave the matter a lot of thought.
I gave a lot of thought to the matter.
The government has given top priority to reforming the tax system.

senses.definition_vi: sử dụng thời gian, năng lượng, v.v. cho ai đó/cái gì đó

senses.definition: to predict that something will last a particular length of time

examples.x: That marriage won't last. I'll give them two years at the outside.

senses.definition_vi: dự đoán rằng một điều gì đó sẽ kéo dài trong một khoảng thời gian nhất định

senses.definition: to say that a player or the ball is in a particular position or that a goal has been scored

examples.x: The umpire gave the ball out.
The ref gave the goal.

senses.definition_vi: cho biết một cầu thủ hoặc bóng ở một vị trí cụ thể hoặc một bàn thắng đã được ghi

senses.definition: to bend or stretch under pressure

examples.x: The branch began to give under his weight.
We can't go on like this—something's got to give.

senses.definition_vi: bị cong hoặc dãn ra dưới áp lực

senses.definition: to agree to change your mind or give up some of your demands

examples.x: You're going to have to give a little.

senses.definition_vi: đồng ý thay đổi ý kiến hoặc từ bỏ một số yêu cầu của mình

senses.definition: used to tell somebody that you do not accept what they say

examples.x: ‘I didn't have time to do it.’ ‘Oh, don't give me that!’

senses.definition_vi: dùng để nói với ai đó rằng bạn không chấp nhận điều họ nói

senses.definition: to be willing, in a relationship, to accept what somebody else wants and to give up some of what you want

examples.x: You're going to have to learn to give and take.

senses.definition_vi: sẵn lòng, trong một mối quan hệ, chấp nhận những gì người khác muốn và từ bỏ một phần những gì bạn muốn

senses.definition: to react with equal force when somebody attacks or criticizes you

examples.x: She can give as good as she gets.

senses.definition_vi: phản ứng với lực tương đương khi ai đó tấn công hoặc chỉ trích bạn

senses.definition: to show your approval of somebody by clapping your hands

examples.x: Give it up for Ed Sheeran!

senses.definition_vi: thể hiện sự tán thành của bạn đối với ai đó bằng cách vỗ tay

senses.definition: used to say that you prefer a particular thing or person to the one that has just been mentioned

examples.x: We don't go out much. Give me a quiet night in front of the TV any day!

senses.definition_vi: dùng để nói rằng bạn thích một điều gì đó hoặc một người nào đó hơn điều vừa được đề cập

senses.definition: if something is correct give or take a particular amount, it is approximately correct

examples.x: It'll take about three weeks, give or take a day or so.

senses.definition_vi: nếu một cái gì đó là đúng, thì nó đúng hoặc sai lệch một lượng nhất định, tức là nó xấp xỉ đúng

senses.definition: to make somebody believe/understand something

examples.x: I was given to understand that she had resigned.

senses.definition_vi: làm cho ai đó tin/hiểu điều gì đó

senses.definition: to severely punish or criticize somebody for doing something wrong

examples.x: My son was rude to my friends so I gave him what for.

senses.definition_vi: trừng phạt hoặc chỉ trích nặng nề ai đó vì đã làm điều gì đó sai trái

senses.definition: used to ask people to drink a toast to somebody

examples.x: Ladies and gentlemen, I give you Geoff Ogilby!

senses.definition_vi: dùng để yêu cầu mọi người nâng cốc chúc mừng ai đó

senses.definition: used when you are admitting that something is true
senses.definition_vi: dùng khi bạn thừa nhận rằng điều gì đó là đúng

senses.definition: what is happening?; what is the news?
senses.definition_vi: chuyện gì đang xảy ra?; có tin tức gì không?

senses.definition: a quick look

examples.x: to take/have a glance at the newspaper headlines
a cursory/brief/casual/furtive glance
The sisters exchanged glances (= looked at each other).
She shot him a sideways glance.
He walked away without a backward glance.
She stole a glance (= looked secretly) at her watch.

senses.definition_vi: nhìn nhanh vào cái gì đó/ai đó

senses.definition: when you first look at or think about something, often rather quickly

examples.x: At first glance the problem seemed easy.
At first glance the contract seemed to be fine.

senses.definition_vi: nhìn nhanh vào cái gì đó/ai đó

senses.definition: immediately; with only a quick look

examples.x: He could tell at a glance what was wrong.
The software allows you to see at a glance what fonts you have on the computer.

senses.definition_vi: nhìn nhanh vào cái gì đó/ai đó

senses.definition: a sight of somebody/something for a very short time, when you do not see the person or thing completely

examples.x: He caught a glimpse of her in the crowd.
I came up on deck to get my first glimpse of the island.
Fans crowded the street outside waiting for a glimpse of their hero.
I just got a glimpse at the baby, but she was very cute.

senses.definition_vi: một cái nhìn thoáng qua về ai đó/điều gì đó trong một thời gian rất ngắn, khi bạn không nhìn thấy người hoặc vật đó một cách trọn vẹn.

senses.definition: a short experience of something that helps you to understand it

examples.x: The programme gives us a rare glimpse of a great artist at work.
Take a glimpse into the future of rail travel.
The exhibition offers a fascinating glimpse at life beneath the waves.

senses.definition_vi: một trải nghiệm ngắn về điều gì đó giúp bạn hiểu rõ hơn về nó.

senses.definition: a piece of clothing for the hand, made of wool, leather, etc. with separate parts for each finger and the thumb

examples.x: a pair of gloves
rubber/latex gloves
gardening/boxing gloves
The burglar must have been wearing gloves.
She peeled off her glove to reveal a wedding ring.

senses.definition_vi: một loại quần áo cho bàn tay, làm bằng len, da, v.v. với các bộ phận riêng cho từng ngón tay và ngón cái.

senses.definition: to be the perfect size or shape for somebody

examples.x: The dress fits me like a glove.

senses.definition_vi: có kích thước hoặc hình dạng hoàn hảo cho ai đó.

senses.definition: used to say that somebody is ready for a fight or an argument
senses.definition_vi: dùng để nói rằng ai đó đã sẵn sàng cho một cuộc chiến hoặc một cuộc tranh cãi.

senses.definition: working closely with somebody, especially in a secret and/or illegal way
senses.definition_vi: làm việc chặt chẽ với ai đó, đặc biệt là theo cách bí mật và/hoặc bất hợp pháp.

senses.definition: to deal with somebody in a very careful way so that you do not offend or upset them

examples.x: Treat her with kid gloves—she's very sensitive.

senses.definition_vi: xử lý ai đó một cách rất cẩn thận để không xúc phạm hoặc làm họ buồn.

senses.definition: if you use the words an iron fist/hand when describing the way that somebody behaves, you mean that they treat people severely. This treatment may be hidden behind a kind appearance (the velvet glove).

examples.x: They promised that the army would strike with an iron fist at any resistance.
The iron hand in the velvet glove approach seems to work best with this age group.

senses.definition_vi: nếu bạn sử dụng cụm từ 'nắm đấm sắt/bàn tay sắt' khi mô tả cách ai đó cư xử, bạn có nghĩa là họ đối xử với mọi người một cách nghiêm khắc. Sự đối xử này có thể được che giấu sau một vẻ ngoài tử tế (vỏ bọc nhung).

senses.definition: a person’s turn to move or play in a game or an activity

examples.x: Whose go is it?
It's your go.
‘How much is it to play?’ ‘It's 50p a go.’
Can I have a go on your new bike?

senses.definition_vi: di chuyển hoặc đi từ nơi này đến nơi khác

senses.definition: an attempt at doing something

examples.x: It took three goes to get it right.
I doubt if he'll listen to advice from me, but I'll give it a go (= I'll try but I don't think I will succeed).

senses.definition_vi: di chuyển hoặc đi từ nơi này đến nơi khác

senses.definition: energy and enthusiasm

examples.x: Mary's always got plenty of go.

senses.definition_vi: di chuyển hoặc đi từ nơi này đến nơi khác

senses.definition: in one single attempt or try

examples.x: She blew out the candles at one go.

senses.definition_vi: di chuyển hoặc đi từ nơi này đến nơi khác

senses.definition: to be very busy or full of activity

examples.x: It was all go in the office today.

senses.definition_vi: di chuyển hoặc đi từ nơi này đến nơi khác

senses.definition: to be planned and possible or allowed

examples.x: I'm not sure if Friday's trip is a go.

senses.definition_vi: di chuyển hoặc đi từ nơi này đến nơi khác

senses.definition: to be very active and busy

examples.x: I've been on the go all day.
Having four children keeps me on the go.

senses.definition_vi: di chuyển hoặc đi từ nơi này đến nơi khác

senses.definition: used to ask somebody to be reasonable

examples.x: I just wanted to say, ‘Hey mate, fair go!’

senses.definition_vi: di chuyển hoặc đi từ nơi này đến nơi khác

senses.definition: (to give somebody/get) fair treatment that gives you the same chance as somebody else

examples.x: Are minority students getting a fair shake at college?
We need a government that cares about equity and a fair go for all.

senses.definition_vi: di chuyển hoặc đi từ nơi này đến nơi khác

senses.definition: at the first, second, etc. attempt

examples.x: I passed my driving test first go.

senses.definition_vi: di chuyển hoặc đi từ nơi này đến nơi khác

senses.definition: to attack somebody physically

examples.x: There were about seven of them standing round him, all waiting to have a go.

senses.definition_vi: di chuyển hoặc đi từ nơi này đến nơi khác

senses.definition: to make an attempt to do something

examples.x: ‘I can't start the engine.’ ‘Let me have a go.’
I'll have a go at fixing it tonight.
You should have a go at answering all the questions.

senses.definition_vi: di chuyển hoặc đi từ nơi này đến nơi khác

senses.definition: to criticize somebody or complain about somebody

examples.x: The boss had a go at me for being late for work.
The government are always having a go at teachers.

senses.definition_vi: di chuyển hoặc đi từ nơi này đến nơi khác

senses.definition: to be in the middle of an activity or a project

examples.x: The award-winning novelist often has three or four books on the go at once.

senses.definition_vi: di chuyển hoặc đi từ nơi này đến nơi khác

senses.definition: all together on one occasion

examples.x: I'd rather do the journey in one go, and not stop on the way.
They ate the packet of biscuits all in one go.

senses.definition_vi: di chuyển hoặc đi từ nơi này đến nơi khác

senses.definition: to stop holding on to something

examples.x: Leave go of my arm—you're hurting me!

senses.definition_vi: di chuyển hoặc đi từ nơi này đến nơi khác

senses.definition: to stop holding somebody/something

examples.x: Don't let go of the rope.
Don't let the rope go.
Let go! You're hurting me!

senses.definition_vi: di chuyển hoặc đi từ nơi này đến nơi khác

senses.definition: to give up an idea or an attitude, or control of something

examples.x: It's time to let go of the past.
It's time to let the past go.

senses.definition_vi: di chuyển hoặc đi từ nơi này đến nơi khác

senses.definition: to stop holding somebody/something

examples.x: Don't let the rope go.
Don't let go of the rope.
Let go! You're hurting me!

senses.definition_vi: di chuyển hoặc đi từ nơi này đến nơi khác

senses.definition: to give up an idea or an attitude, or control of something

examples.x: It's time to let the past go.
It's time to let go of the past.

senses.definition_vi: di chuyển hoặc đi từ nơi này đến nơi khác

senses.definition: to be successful in something

examples.x: We've had a few problems in our marriage, but we're both determined to make a go of it.

senses.definition_vi: di chuyển hoặc đi từ nơi này đến nơi khác

senses.definition: made of gold

examples.x: a golden crown

senses.definition_vi: làm bằng vàng

senses.definition: bright yellow in colour like gold

examples.x: golden hair
miles of golden beaches
Bake for ten minutes until the pastry is crisp and golden.

senses.definition_vi: màu vàng tươi như vàng

senses.definition: special; wonderful

examples.x: golden memories
Businesses have a golden opportunity to expand into new markets.
Hollywood’s golden boy

senses.definition_vi: đặc biệt; tuyệt vời

senses.definition: to be in a situation where you are successful or do not have any problems

examples.x: He thinks once he gets the money he'll be golden.
If it works this time, we’re golden.

senses.definition_vi: ở trong một tình huống mà bạn thành công hoặc không gặp vấn đề gì

senses.definition: a course of action that is not extreme
senses.definition_vi: một hướng hành động không cực đoan

senses.definition: to destroy something that would make you rich, successful, etc.
senses.definition_vi: hủy hoại một thứ gì đó có thể mang lại cho bạn sự giàu có, thành công, v.v.

senses.definition: it is often best not to say anything
senses.definition_vi: thường là tốt nhất không nên nói bất cứ điều gì

senses.definition: of high quality or an acceptable standard

examples.x: a good book
good food
The piano was in really good condition.
Your work is just not good enough.
The results were pretty good.
Sorry, my English is not very good.
They've done a reasonably good job.
Keep up the good work!
It's a good way to make friends.
The sound and picture are both of good quality.
Things are looking good at the moment.
You'll never marry her—she's much too good for you.

senses.definition_vi: hành vi đúng đắn hoặc chấp nhận được về mặt đạo đức

senses.definition: pleasant; that you enjoy or want

examples.x: Did you have a good time in London?
This is very good news.
Let's hope we have good weather tomorrow.

examples.cf: it is good to do something
examples.x: It's good to see you again.
There are loads of good things about working here.
We are still friends, though, which is good.

senses.definition_vi: hành vi đúng đắn hoặc chấp nhận được về mặt đạo đức

senses.definition: sensible, logical or strongly supporting what is being discussed

examples.x: Thank you, good question.
Yes, that's a good point.
I have good reason to be suspicious.
What a good idea!
This is a good example of what I mean.

senses.definition_vi: hành vi đúng đắn hoặc chấp nhận được về mặt đạo đức

senses.definition: showing or getting approval or respect

examples.x: The play had good reviews.
The hotel has a good reputation.
He comes from a good family.

senses.definition_vi: hành vi đúng đắn hoặc chấp nhận được về mặt đạo đức

senses.definition: able to do something well

examples.x: a good player
a good actor/cook
to be good at languages/your job
Nick has always been good at finding cheap flights.

senses.definition_vi: hành vi đúng đắn hoặc chấp nhận được về mặt đạo đức

senses.definition: able to use something or deal with people well

examples.x: She's good with her hands (= able to make things, etc.).
He's very good with children.
She's good with figures.

senses.definition_vi: hành vi đúng đắn hoặc chấp nhận được về mặt đạo đức

senses.definition: morally right; behaving in a way that is morally right

examples.x: She has tried to lead a good life.
I took Sarah's children to school so I've done my good deed for the day.
Giving her that money was a good thing to do.
He is a very good man.
She prayed that God would make her a better person.

senses.definition_vi: hành vi đúng đắn hoặc chấp nhận được về mặt đạo đức

senses.definition: following strictly a set of rules or principles

examples.x: It is good practice to supply a written report to the buyer.
She was a good Catholic girl.

senses.definition_vi: hành vi đúng đắn hoặc chấp nhận được về mặt đạo đức

senses.definition: willing to help; kind to other people

examples.x: You've always been such a good friend.
He was very good to me when I was ill.
She looked into it for me, which was very good of her.

examples.cf: good of somebody to do something
examples.x: It was very good of you to come.
I had to take a week off work but my colleagues were very good about it.

senses.definition_vi: hành vi đúng đắn hoặc chấp nhận được về mặt đạo đức

senses.definition: behaving well or politely

examples.x: You can stay up late if you're good.
Get dressed now, there's a good girl.
‘That's a good dog,’ I said, patting its head.

senses.definition_vi: hành vi đúng đắn hoặc chấp nhận được về mặt đạo đức

senses.definition: healthy or strong

examples.x: Can you speak into my good ear?
I don't feel too good today.
‘How are you?’ ‘I'm good.’ (= used as a general reply to a greeting)

senses.definition_vi: hành vi đúng đắn hoặc chấp nhận được về mặt đạo đức

senses.definition: having a useful or helpful effect on somebody/something

examples.x: Living so close to a chemicals factory can't be good.
Too much sun isn't good for you.
Vegetables are good for you.
policies that are good for business
The deal will be good for the country as a whole.

examples.cf: it is good for somebody/something to do something
examples.x: It's probably good for you to get some criticism now and then.
Shut your mouth, if you know what's good for you (= used as a threat).

senses.definition_vi: hành vi đúng đắn hoặc chấp nhận được về mặt đạo đức

senses.definition: suitable or appropriate

examples.x: Now is a good time to buy a house.
Do you really think this is a good use of your time?
Students are not allowed to miss classes without good reason.
She would be good for the job.
Can we change our meeting? Monday isn't good (= convenient) for me.
This is as good a place as any to spend the night.

senses.definition_vi: hành vi đúng đắn hoặc chấp nhận được về mặt đạo đức

senses.definition: used in speaking to show that you approve of or are pleased about something that has been said or done, or to show that you want to move on to a new topic of conversation

examples.x: ‘Dinner's ready.’ ‘Good—I'm starving.’
‘I got the job.’ ‘Oh, good.’
Good, I think we've come to a decision.

senses.definition_vi: hành vi đúng đắn hoặc chấp nhận được về mặt đạo đức

senses.definition: used as a form of praise

examples.x: Good old Jack!
‘I've ordered some drinks.’ ‘Good man!’

senses.definition_vi: hành vi đúng đắn hoặc chấp nhận được về mặt đạo đức

senses.definition: used in exclamations

examples.x: Good heavens!
Good God!

senses.definition_vi: hành vi đúng đắn hoặc chấp nhận được về mặt đạo đức

senses.definition: great in number, amount or degree

examples.x: a good number of people
The kitchen is a good size.
We spent a good while (= quite a long time) looking for the house.
He devoted a good deal of (= a lot of) attention to the problem.
There's a good chance (= it is likely) that I won't be here next year.

senses.definition_vi: hành vi đúng đắn hoặc chấp nhận được về mặt đạo đức

senses.definition: not less than; rather more than

examples.x: We waited for a good hour.
It's a good three miles to the station.

senses.definition_vi: hành vi đúng đắn hoặc chấp nhận được về mặt đạo đức

senses.definition: done to a high level or a great degree; complete

examples.x: We had a good laugh about it afterwards.
You'll feel better after a good sleep.

senses.definition_vi: hành vi đúng đắn hoặc chấp nhận được về mặt đạo đức

senses.definition: funny or clever

examples.x: a good story/joke
That's a good one!

senses.definition_vi: hành vi đúng đắn hoặc chấp nhận được về mặt đạo đức

senses.definition: having enough energy, health, strength, etc. to last for a particular length of time or distance

examples.x: You're good for (= you will live) a few years yet.

senses.definition_vi: hành vi đúng đắn hoặc chấp nhận được về mặt đạo đức

senses.definition: acceptable for something

examples.x: The ticket is good for three months.

senses.definition_vi: hành vi đúng đắn hoặc chấp nhận được về mặt đạo đức

senses.definition: likely to provide something

examples.x: He's always good for a laugh.
Bobby should be good for a few drinks.

senses.definition_vi: hành vi đúng đắn hoặc chấp nhận được về mặt đạo đức

senses.definition: very nearly

examples.x: The matter is as good as settled.
He as good as called me a coward (= suggested that I was a coward without actually using the word ‘coward’).
She’s as good as won.

senses.definition_vi: hành vi đúng đắn hoặc chấp nhận được về mặt đạo đức

senses.definition: used when you are saying that a situation is not going to get any better
senses.definition_vi: hành vi đúng đắn hoặc chấp nhận được về mặt đạo đức

senses.definition: (of a thing) to be prepared and ready for use; (of a person) to be prepared and ready to do something

examples.x: By tomorrow afternoon the document will be good to go.
I’ve spent several months training for this race so now I’m good to go.

senses.definition_vi: hành vi đúng đắn hoặc chấp nhận được về mặt đạo đức

senses.definition: completely

examples.x: I won't go until I'm good and ready.

senses.definition_vi: hành vi đúng đắn hoặc chấp nhận được về mặt đạo đức

senses.definition: several

examples.x: There are still a good few empty seats.

senses.definition_vi: hành vi đúng đắn hoặc chấp nhận được về mặt đạo đức

senses.definition: used to praise somebody for doing something well

examples.x: ‘I passed first time.’ ‘Good for you!’

senses.definition_vi: hành vi đúng đắn hoặc chấp nhận được về mặt đạo đức

senses.definition: a lot of somebody/something

examples.x: There were a good many people there.

senses.definition_vi: hành vi đúng đắn hoặc chấp nhận được về mặt đạo đức

senses.definition: used when you are leaving somebody or when somebody else is leaving

examples.x: Goodbye! It was great to meet you.
She didn't even say goodbye to her mother.
Say goodbye to Mary for me.
We waved them goodbye.
We've already said our goodbyes.
Kiss me goodbye!
Take out our service contract and say goodbye to costly repair bills.

senses.definition_vi: được sử dụng khi bạn rời đi hoặc khi người khác rời đi

senses.definition: to accept that you will lose something or be unable to do something

examples.x: Well, you can kiss goodbye to your chances of promotion.

senses.definition_vi: chấp nhận rằng bạn sẽ mất một cái gì đó hoặc không thể làm một cái gì đó

senses.definition: very beautiful and attractive; giving great pleasure

examples.x: a gorgeous girl/man
a gorgeous view
gorgeous weather (= warm and with a lot of sun)
You look gorgeous!
It was absolutely gorgeous.

senses.definition_vi: rất đẹp và quyến rũ; mang lại niềm vui lớn

senses.definition: with very deep colours; impressive

examples.x: exotic birds with feathers of gorgeous colours

senses.definition_vi: với màu sắc rất sâu; ấn tượng

senses.definition: to take or hold somebody/something with your hand suddenly or roughly

examples.x: She grabbed his arm as he got up to leave.
She grabbed the child's hand and ran.
He grabbed hold of me and wouldn't let go.
Someone grabbed me from behind.
He grabbed Tom by the collar and dragged him outside.
Jim grabbed a cake from the plate.
Don't grab—there's plenty for everyone.

senses.definition_vi: nắm hoặc giữ ai đó/cái gì đó bằng tay một cách đột ngột hoặc thô bạo

senses.definition: to try to take hold of something

examples.x: She grabbed at the branch, missed and fell.
I grabbed at his arm as he ran past.
Kate grabbed for the robber's gun.

senses.definition_vi: cố gắng nắm lấy một cái gì đó

senses.definition: to take advantage of an opportunity to do or have something

examples.x: This was my big chance and I grabbed it with both hands.
He'll grab at any excuse to avoid doing the dishes.
He'll grab at any excuse to avoid hard work.

senses.definition_vi: nắm bắt cơ hội để làm hoặc có điều gì đó.

senses.definition: to have or take something quickly, especially because you are in a hurry

examples.x: Let's grab a sandwich before we go.
I'll grab a bite to eat in town.
Grab a cab and get over here.
I managed to grab a couple of hours' sleep on the plane.
Grab a seat, I won't keep you a moment.

senses.definition_vi: cầm hoặc lấy thứ gì đó một cách nhanh chóng, đặc biệt là vì bạn đang vội.

senses.definition: to take something for yourself, especially in a selfish or greedy way

examples.x: By the time we arrived, someone had grabbed all the good seats.
She's always trying to grab the limelight.

senses.definition_vi: chiếm lấy thứ gì đó cho bản thân, đặc biệt là theo cách ích kỷ hoặc tham lam.

senses.definition: to get somebody’s attention

examples.x: I'll see if I can grab the waitress and get the bill.
Glasgow’s drugs problem has grabbed the headlines tonight (= been published as an important story in the newspapers).
The play grabs the audience’s attention from the very start.

senses.definition_vi: thu hút sự chú ý của ai đó.

senses.definition: to take a picture from a television or video film, or from a computer screen, and store it as an image on a computer

examples.x: You can use this keyboard shortcut to grab part of the screen.

senses.definition_vi: chụp một bức ảnh từ phim truyền hình hoặc video, hoặc từ màn hình máy tính, và lưu nó dưới dạng hình ảnh trên máy tính.

senses.definition: used to ask somebody whether they are interested in something or in doing something

examples.x: How does the idea of a trip to Rome grab you?

senses.definition_vi: được sử dụng để hỏi ai đó liệu họ có hứng thú với điều gì đó hoặc làm điều gì đó hay không.

senses.definition: slowly, over a long period of time

examples.x: to gradually increase/decrease
The weather gradually improved.
Gradually, the children began to understand.
She was gradually becoming conscious of aches and pains caused by the long, tiring flight.

senses.definition_vi: chậm rãi, trong một khoảng thời gian dài.

senses.definition: impressive and large or important

examples.x: It's not a very grand house.
The wedding was a very grand occasion.
The book dares to take on grand themes in the grand manner.

senses.definition_vi: ấn tượng và lớn hoặc quan trọng

senses.definition: used in the names of impressive or very large buildings, etc.

examples.x: the Grand Canyon
We stayed at the Grand Hotel.

senses.definition_vi: được sử dụng trong tên của các tòa nhà, v.v. ấn tượng hoặc rất lớn

senses.definition: needing a lot of effort, money or time to succeed but intended to achieve impressive results

examples.x: a grand plan/strategy/scheme
The gallery had its grand opening on 18 January.
New Yorkers built their city on a grand scale.

senses.definition_vi: cần nhiều nỗ lực, tiền bạc hoặc thời gian để thành công nhưng nhằm đạt được kết quả ấn tượng

senses.definition: used to describe the largest or most important item of its kind

examples.x: The film won the grand prize at the Berlin Film Festival.
Tomorrow is the grand final with just 12 contestants left from the hundreds who entered.

senses.definition_vi: được sử dụng để mô tả vật lớn nhất hoặc quan trọng nhất thuộc loại đó

senses.definition: behaving in a proud way because they are rich or from a high social class

examples.x: They're all Lord or Lady somebody or other, but they're not at all grand.
She put on her grandest air and waltzed into the living room to join the others.

senses.definition_vi: hành xử một cách kiêu hãnh vì họ giàu có hoặc thuộc tầng lớp xã hội cao

senses.definition: very good or great fun; excellent

examples.x: I had a grand day out at the seaside.
Thanks. That'll be grand!
Fred did a grand job of painting the house.

senses.definition_vi: rất hay hoặc vui vẻ; xuất sắc

senses.definition: used in the titles of people of very high social rank

examples.x: the Grand Duchess Elena

senses.definition_vi: được sử dụng trong danh hiệu của những người có thứ hạng xã hội rất cao

senses.definition: a great age

examples.x: She finally learned to drive at the grand old age of 70.

senses.definition_vi: một tuổi rất cao

senses.definition: a man who is respected in a particular profession that he has been involved in for a long time

examples.x: James Lovelock, the grand old man of environmental science

senses.definition_vi: một người đàn ông được kính trọng trong một ngành nghề cụ thể mà ông đã tham gia trong một thời gian dài

senses.definition: a strong hold of somebody/something or control over somebody/something

examples.x: I grabbed him, but he slipped from my grasp.
She felt a firm grasp on her arm.
Don't let the situation escape from your grasp.
As soon as he relaxed his grasp on the rope, it was pulled out of his hands.

senses.definition_vi: nắm chặt ai đó/điều gì đó

senses.definition: a person’s understanding of a subject or of difficult facts

examples.x: He has a good grasp of German grammar.
These complex formulae are beyond the grasp of the average pupil.
As the drugs took hold, her grasp of reality began to slip slowly away.

senses.definition_vi: nắm chặt ai đó/điều gì đó

senses.definition: the ability to get or achieve something

examples.x: Success was within her grasp.
Just when victory seemed within grasp, the referee blew his whistle.

senses.definition_vi: nắm chặt ai đó/điều gì đó

senses.definition: very good or pleasant

examples.x: He's a great bloke.
What a great goal!
We had a great time in Madrid.
You should have come along. It was great fun.
You've done a great job.
I think that's a great idea.
It's a great way to meet new people.
New Zealand is a great place to live.
This is a great opportunity for us.
He missed a great chance to score in the final minutes of the match.

examples.cf: it is great to do something
examples.x: It's great to see you again.
He's great with the kids.
‘Why don't we order a pizza?’ ‘That sounds great.’
‘I'll pick you up at seven.’ ‘That'll be great, thanks.’
Oh great, they left without us.

senses.definition_vi: rất tốt hoặc dễ chịu

senses.definition: much more than average in degree or quantity

examples.x: This is a matter of great importance.
The lack of clean drinking water is of great concern.
The concert had been a great success.
Her death was a great shock to us all.
It gives me great pleasure to welcome you here today.
We will be following his progress with great interest.
one of the greatest challenges facing the world today
These women represent a group at greater risk of developing particular cancers.
Take great care of it.
You've been a great help.
You've been a great help, I must say (= no help at all).
We are all to a great extent the products of our culture.
The problem is treated in great detail in the book.

senses.definition_vi: nhiều hơn nhiều so với mức trung bình về mức độ hoặc số lượng

senses.definition: very large; much bigger than average in size or quantity

examples.x: A great crowd had gathered.
People were arriving in great numbers.
The great majority of (= most) people seem to agree with this view.
He must have fallen from a great height.
She lived to a great age.

senses.definition_vi: rất lớn; lớn hơn nhiều so với mức trung bình về kích thước hoặc số lượng

senses.definition: used to emphasize an adjective of size or quality

examples.x: There was a great big pile of books on the table.
He cut himself a great thick slice of cake.
There's a great big hole in this sleeve.

senses.definition_vi: được sử dụng để nhấn mạnh một tính từ về kích thước hoặc chất lượng

senses.definition: extremely good in ability or quality and therefore admired by many people

examples.x: Gary Kasparov, undoubtedly the greatest chess player of all time
He has been described as the world's greatest violinist.
Sherlock Holmes, the great detective
Great art has the power to change lives.
This represents a great achievement.
He was a truly great man.

senses.definition_vi: cực kỳ tốt về khả năng hoặc chất lượng và do đó được nhiều người ngưỡng mộ

senses.definition: important and impressive

examples.x: The wedding was a great occasion.
This is a great day for the city of Chicago.
The great thing is to get it done quickly.
One great advantage of this metal is that it doesn't rust.

senses.definition_vi: quan trọng và ấn tượng

senses.definition: having high status or a lot of influence

examples.x: the great powers (= important and powerful countries)
We can make this country great again.
Alexander the Great

senses.definition_vi: có địa vị cao hoặc có nhiều ảnh hưởng

senses.definition: in a very good state of physical or mental health

examples.x: She seemed in great spirits (= very cheerful).
I feel great today.
I don’t feel too great.
Everyone's in great form.
You're looking great. Marriage must suit you!

senses.definition_vi: có trạng thái sức khỏe thể chất hoặc tinh thần rất tốt

senses.definition: able to do something well

examples.x: She's great at chess.

senses.definition_vi: có khả năng làm điều gì đó tốt

senses.definition: very suitable or useful for something

examples.x: This gadget's great for opening jars.
Try this cream—it's great for spots.

senses.definition_vi: rất phù hợp hoặc hữu ích cho một cái gì đó

senses.definition: used when you are emphasizing a particular description of somebody/something

examples.x: We are great friends.
I've never been a great reader (= I do not read much).
She's a great talker, isn't she?
I am a great admirer of your work.

senses.definition_vi: được sử dụng khi bạn đang nhấn mạnh một mô tả cụ thể về ai đó/cái gì đó

senses.definition: added to words for family members to show a further stage in relationship

examples.x: my great-aunt (= my father’s or mother’s aunt)
her great-grandson (= the grandson of her son or daughter)
my great-great-grandfather (= the grandfather of my grandfather)

senses.definition_vi: được thêm vào các từ chỉ thành viên gia đình để chỉ một giai đoạn xa hơn trong mối quan hệ

senses.definition: used in the names of animals or plants that are larger than similar kinds

examples.x: the great tit

senses.definition_vi: được sử dụng trong tên của động vật hoặc thực vật lớn hơn các loại tương tự

senses.definition: used with the name of a city to describe an area that includes the centre of the city and a large area all round it

examples.x: Greater London

senses.definition_vi: được sử dụng với tên của một thành phố để mô tả một khu vực bao gồm trung tâm thành phố và một khu vực lớn xung quanh nó

senses.definition: to be doing something quickly and successfully

examples.x: Work is going great guns now.

senses.definition_vi: đang làm điều gì đó một cách nhanh chóng và thành công

senses.definition: to be better or more effective as a group than you would think just by looking at the individual members of the group

examples.x: The team is greater than the sum of its parts.

senses.definition_vi: hoạt động tốt hơn hoặc hiệu quả hơn với tư cách là một nhóm so với bạn nghĩ chỉ bằng cách nhìn vào các thành viên riêng lẻ của nhóm

senses.definition: to do something a lot; to enjoy something

examples.x: He's never been a great one for keeping in touch.
You're a great one for quizzes, aren't you?

senses.definition_vi: làm điều gì đó rất nhiều; thích một cái gì đó

senses.definition: to be not very good, efficient, suitable, etc.
senses.definition_vi: không rất tốt, hiệu quả, phù hợp, v.v.

senses.definition: much; a lot

examples.x: She's feeling a good deal better.
We don't see them a great deal (= often) these days.
They spent a great deal of money.
A good deal of research has been done on the subject.

senses.definition_vi: nhiều; rất nhiều

senses.definition: people who are very successful, admired and respected

examples.x: Universities around the world award honorary degrees to the great and the good.

senses.definition_vi: những người rất thành công, được ngưỡng mộ và kính trọng

senses.definition: of all sizes or types

examples.x: all creatures great and small

senses.definition_vi: có tất cả các kích cỡ hoặc loại

senses.definition: used to refer to where a particular person is imagined to go when they die or a thing when it is no longer working, similar to the place they were connected with on earth

examples.x: Their pet rabbit had gone to the great rabbit hutch in the sky.

senses.definition_vi: được sử dụng để chỉ nơi một người cụ thể được tưởng tượng sẽ đến khi họ chết hoặc một vật khi nó không còn hoạt động, tương tự như nơi họ đã kết nối trên trái đất

senses.definition: used to say that you and another person must both be very clever because you have had the same idea or agree about something
senses.definition_vi: được sử dụng để nói rằng bạn và người khác phải rất thông minh vì cả hai đã có cùng một ý tưởng hoặc đồng ý về điều gì đó

senses.definition: something large and successful often begins in a very small way
senses.definition_vi: một cái gì đó lớn và thành công thường bắt đầu từ một cách rất nhỏ

senses.definition: to put a lot of effort into doing something

examples.x: The couple went to great pains to keep their plans secret.

senses.definition_vi: đặt nhiều nỗ lực vào việc làm điều gì đó

senses.definition: to do something very carefully

examples.x: He always takes great pains with his lectures.

senses.definition_vi: làm điều gì đó rất cẩn thận

senses.definition: very much

examples.x: People's reaction to the film has varied greatly.
a greatly increased risk
Your help would be greatly appreciated.
The reports were greatly exaggerated.

senses.definition_vi: rất nhiều

senses.definition: having the colour of grass or the leaves of most plants and trees

examples.x: green grass/leaves/vegetables
his piercing green eyes
Wait for the light to turn green (= on traffic lights).

senses.definition_vi: màu của cỏ và lá của hầu hết các loài thực vật và cây cối

senses.definition: covered with grass or other plants

examples.x: green fields/pastures/hills
It's just two minutes' walk to the nearest public green space.
After the rains, the land was green with new growth.

senses.definition_vi: màu của cỏ và lá của hầu hết các loài thực vật và cây cối

senses.definition: not yet ready to eat

examples.x: green tomatoes

senses.definition_vi: màu của cỏ và lá của hầu hết các loài thực vật và cây cối

senses.definition: connected with the protection of the environment; supporting the protection of the environment as a political principle

examples.x: green energy
green politics
Try to adopt a greener lifestyle.
the Green Party

senses.definition_vi: màu của cỏ và lá của hầu hết các loài thực vật và cây cối

senses.definition: young and without experience

examples.x: The new trainees are still very green.

senses.definition_vi: màu của cỏ và lá của hầu hết các loài thực vật và cây cối

senses.definition: being a pale colour, as if the person is going to vomit

examples.x: It was a rough crossing and most of the passengers looked distinctly green.

senses.definition_vi: màu của cỏ và lá của hầu hết các loài thực vật và cây cối

senses.definition: said about people who never seem happy with what they have and always think they could be happier in a different place or situation
senses.definition_vi: màu của cỏ và lá của hầu hết các loài thực vật và cây cối

senses.definition: very jealous (= angry or unhappy because you wish you had something that somebody else has )
senses.definition_vi: màu của cỏ và lá của hầu hết các loài thực vật và cây cối

senses.definition: having the colour of smoke or ashes

examples.x: grey eyes/hair
Her hair was turning grey.
His beard was going grey.
wisps of grey smoke
a grey suit

senses.definition_vi: màu của khói hoặc tro

senses.definition: not bright; full of clouds

examples.x: grey skies
I hate these grey days.
The sky looks very grey. I think it's going to rain.

senses.definition_vi: màu của khói hoặc tro

senses.definition: having grey hair

examples.x: He's gone very grey.

senses.definition_vi: màu của khói hoặc tro

senses.definition: pale, because they are ill, tired or sad

examples.x: The next morning she looked very grey and hollow-eyed.
His face was grey with pain.

senses.definition_vi: màu của khói hoặc tro

senses.definition: without interest or variety; making you feel sad

examples.x: Life seems grey and pointless without him.

senses.definition_vi: màu của khói hoặc tro

senses.definition: not interesting or attractive

examples.x: The company was full of faceless grey men who all looked the same.

senses.definition_vi: màu của khói hoặc tro

senses.definition: connected with old people

examples.x: the grey vote
grey power

senses.definition_vi: màu của khói hoặc tro

examples.x: to grind coffee/corn

senses.definition_vi: làm vỡ hoặc ép thứ gì đó thành những mảnh rất nhỏ giữa hai bề mặt cứng hoặc bằng máy đặc biệt

senses.definition: to produce something such as flour by grinding

examples.x: The flour is ground using traditional methods.

senses.definition_vi: sản xuất thứ gì đó như bột bằng cách nghiền

senses.definition: to cut food, especially meat, into very small pieces using a special machine (called a mincer)
senses.definition_vi: cắt thực phẩm, đặc biệt là thịt, thành những miếng rất nhỏ bằng máy đặc biệt (gọi là máy xay thịt)

senses.definition: to make something sharp or smooth by rubbing it against a hard surface

examples.x: a special stone for grinding knives

senses.definition_vi: làm cho thứ gì đó sắc bén hoặc nhẵn bằng cách chà xát nó vào bề mặt cứng

senses.definition: to press or rub something into a surface

examples.x: He ground his cigarette into the ashtray.
The dirt on her hands was ground in.

senses.definition_vi: ép hoặc chà thứ gì đó vào một bề mặt

senses.definition: to rub together, or to make hard objects rub together, often producing an unpleasant noise

examples.x: Parts of the machine were grinding together noisily.
She grinds her teeth when she is asleep.
He ground the gears on the car.

senses.definition_vi: cọ xát vào nhau, hoặc làm cho các vật cứng cọ xát vào nhau, thường tạo ra tiếng động khó chịu

senses.definition: to turn the handle of a machine that grinds something

examples.x: to grind a pepper mill

senses.definition_vi: vặn tay quay của máy nghiền

senses.definition_vi: chậm dần rồi dừng hoàn toàn

senses.definition: to have private reasons for being involved in something or for arguing for a particular cause

examples.x: She had no axe to grind and was only acting out of concern for their safety.
These criticisms are commonly voiced by those who have some political axe to grind.

senses.definition_vi: có lý do riêng để tham gia vào việc gì đó hoặc để tranh luận cho một mục đích cụ thể

examples.x: Keep a tight grip on the rope.
to loosen/release/relax your grip
She tried to get a grip on the icy rock.
The climber slipped and lost her grip.
She struggled from his grip.
Try adjusting your grip on the racket.

senses.definition_vi: nắm chặt thứ gì đó

examples.x: The home team took a firm grip on the game.
We need to tighten the grip we have on the market.
The Prime Minister needs to keep a tight grip on his party.

senses.definition_vi: nắm chặt thứ gì đó

examples.x: I couldn't get a grip on what was going on.
You need to keep a good grip on reality in this job.

senses.definition_vi: nắm chặt thứ gì đó

examples.x: These tyres give the bus better grip in slippery conditions.
This type of sole gives a good grip on snow and ice.

senses.definition_vi: nắm chặt thứ gì đó

senses.definition: a part of something that has a special surface so that it can be held without the hands slipping

examples.x: the grip on a golf club

senses.definition_vi: nắm chặt thứ gì đó

senses.definition: a small thin piece of metal or plastic folded in the middle, used by women for holding their hair in place
senses.definition_vi: nắm chặt thứ gì đó

senses.definition: a person who prepares and moves the cameras, and sometimes the lighting equipment, when a film is being made
senses.definition_vi: nắm chặt thứ gì đó

senses.definition: a large soft bag, used when travelling
senses.definition_vi: nắm chặt thứ gì đó

senses.definition: to begin to understand and deal with something difficult

examples.x: I'm slowly getting to grips with the language.
They have so far failed to come to grips with the ecological problems.

senses.definition_vi: nắm chặt thứ gì đó

examples.x: I have to take a grip on myself, he told himself firmly.
Get a grip! (= make an effort to control your emotions)

senses.definition_vi: nắm chặt thứ gì đó

senses.definition: experiencing something unpleasant that cannot be stopped

examples.x: a country in the grip of recession

senses.definition_vi: nắm chặt thứ gì đó

senses.definition: to become unable to understand or control a situation

examples.x: Sometimes I feel I'm losing my grip.

senses.definition_vi: nắm chặt thứ gì đó

examples.x: to have/make a guess
to take a guess
Go on! Have a guess!
If I might hazard a guess, I'd say she was about thirty.
Who do you think I saw yesterday? I'll give you three guesses.
They might be here by 3—but that's just a rough guess (= not exact).
But this is clearly just a wild guess (= not sensible or accurate) at what his motives could have been.
The article is based on guesses about what might happen in the future.
the market's best guess as to the possible performance of the company
My guess is that we won't hear from him again.

senses.definition_vi: cố gắng đưa ra câu trả lời hoặc đưa ra phán đoán về điều gì đó mà không chắc chắn về tất cả các sự kiện

senses.definition: something that nobody can be certain about

examples.x: What will happen next is anybody's guess.

senses.definition_vi: cố gắng đưa ra câu trả lời hoặc đưa ra phán đoán về điều gì đó mà không chắc chắn về tất cả các sự kiện

senses.definition: a guess that is based on some degree of knowledge, and is therefore likely to be correct

examples.x: Let's make an educated guess.

senses.definition_vi: cố gắng đưa ra câu trả lời hoặc đưa ra phán đoán về điều gì đó mà không chắc chắn về tất cả các sự kiện

senses.definition: used to tell somebody that you do not know any more about a subject than the person that you are talking to does

examples.x: ‘Who's going to win?’ ‘Your guess is as good as mine.’

senses.definition_vi: cố gắng đưa ra câu trả lời hoặc đưa ra phán đoán về điều gì đó mà không chắc chắn về tất cả các sự kiện

senses.definition: to make a mistake

examples.x: Unless I miss my guess, your computer needs a new hard drive.
If you miss your guess, you lose 10 points.

senses.definition_vi: cố gắng đưa ra câu trả lời hoặc đưa ra phán đoán về điều gì đó mà không chắc chắn về tất cả các sự kiện

senses.definition: to continue to have something and not give it back or throw it away

examples.x: He kept all her letters.

senses.definition_vi: tiếp tục có thứ gì đó và không trả lại hoặc vứt bỏ nó

senses.definition: to put or store something in a particular place

examples.x: Keep your passport in a safe place.

senses.definition_vi: đặt hoặc cất giữ thứ gì đó ở một nơi cụ thể

senses.definition: to save something for somebody

examples.x: Please keep a seat for me.
The man in the shop said he'd keep it for me until Friday.
Please keep me a seat.

senses.definition_vi: cất giữ thứ gì đó cho ai đó

I could not keep silent any longer.
The notice said ‘Keep off (= Do not walk on) the grass’.
Keep left along the wall.
The doctors worked miracles to keep him alive.
Winning the contract means they can now keep the factory open.
She kept the children amused for hours.
Keep your PIN safe.
He kept his coat on.
Don't keep us in suspense—what happened next?
She had trouble keeping her balance.
I'm very sorry to keep you waiting.

senses.definition_vi: ở trong một tình trạng hoặc vị trí cụ thể; làm cho ai đó/điều gì đó làm như vậy

examples.x: Keep smiling!

Things just keep getting worse.
Don't keep on interrupting me!

senses.definition_vi: tiếp tục làm điều gì đó; làm điều gì đó lặp đi lặp lại

examples.x: Can you keep a secret?
She kept her past secret from us all.

senses.definition_vi: biết điều gì đó và không nói cho bất kỳ ai

senses.definition: to do what you have promised to do; to go where you have agreed to go

examples.x: She kept her promise to visit them.

He failed to keep his appointment at the clinic.

senses.definition_vi: làm những gì bạn đã hứa; đi đến nơi bạn đã đồng ý đến

senses.definition_vi: ghi lại điều gì đó như một bản ghi nhớ

examples.x: to keep bees/goats/hens

Residents are not allowed to keep pets.

senses.definition_vi: sở hữu và chăm sóc động vật

examples.x: Her father kept a grocer's shop.

senses.definition_vi: sở hữu và quản lý một cửa hàng hoặc nhà hàng

senses.definition: to provide what is necessary for somebody to live; to support somebody by paying for food, etc.

examples.x: He scarcely earns enough to keep himself and his family.

senses.definition_vi: cung cấp những gì cần thiết cho ai đó để sống; hỗ trợ ai đó bằng cách chi trả thức ăn, v.v.

senses.definition_vi: làm ai đó chậm trễ

examples.x: How is your mother keeping?

senses.definition_vi: được sử dụng để hỏi hoặc nói về sức khỏe của ai đó

senses.definition_vi: duy trì tình trạng tốt

senses.definition_vi: bảo vệ ai đó khỏi điều gì đó

senses.definition_vi: nỗ lực sống bình thường khi bạn đang ở trong một tình huống khó khăn hoặc khi bạn đã trải qua nỗi đau và khó khăn lớn

senses.definition: used to encourage somebody to continue doing something

senses.definition_vi: được sử dụng để khuyến khích ai đó tiếp tục làm điều gì đó

senses.definition_vi: đủ cho ai đó cho đến khi họ nhận được thứ họ đang chờ đợi

senses.definition_vi: một bộ công cụ hoặc thiết bị bạn sử dụng cho một mục đích cụ thể

senses.definition_vi: một bộ quần áo và thiết bị bạn sử dụng cho một hoạt động cụ thể

senses.definition: everything

examples.x: I had new clothes, a new hairstyle—the whole caboodle.

senses.definition_vi: tất cả mọi thứ

senses.definition_vi: gõ cửa, v.v. để thu hút sự chú ý
