senses.definition_vi: gõ cửa, v.v. để thu hút sự chú ý

senses.definition: a bad experience that makes somebody/something less confident or successful

examples.x: Her confidence took a further knock when she lost her job.
The company has suffered two huge knocks of late.

senses.definition_vi: gõ cửa, v.v. để thu hút sự chú ý

senses.definition: to have information in your mind as a result of experience or because you have learned or been told it

examples.x: No one knows the answer.
I need to know your name.
The truth about what happened is not yet known.
All I know is that she used to work in a bank (= I have no other information about her).
I know (that) people’s handwriting changes as they get older.
We know from experience that turning a hobby into a business is not easy.
I know for a fact (that) he didn't go to the party.
‘There's no one in.’ ‘How do you know?’
‘You've got a flat tyre.’ ‘I know.’
‘What's the answer?’ ‘I don't know.’
As you know, Emma and I are old friends.
‘Isn’t that his car?’ ‘I wouldn’t know./How should I know?’ (= I don’t know and I am not the person you should ask.)
‘What are you two whispering about?’ ‘You don't want to know’ (= because you would be shocked or wouldn't approve).
It is widely known that CFCs can damage the ozone layer.
I knew where he was hiding.
No one knows for sure who did it.
You know about Amanda's baby, don't you?
I don't know about you, but I'm ready for something to eat.
I know next to nothing (= know almost nothing) about opera.
I know of someone who can help us.
‘Is anyone else coming?’ ‘Not that I know of.’
Does he know to come here (= that he should come here) first?
We know her to be honest.
Strobe lights are known to cause seizures.

senses.definition_vi: có thông tin trong tâm trí do kinh nghiệm hoặc vì bạn đã học hoặc được cho biết

senses.definition: to realize, understand or be aware of something

examples.x: As soon as I walked in the room I knew (that) something was wrong.
She knew she was dying.
‘Martin was lying all the time.’ ‘I should have known.’
I knew perfectly well what she meant.
I know exactly how you feel.
This case is hopeless and he knows it (= although he will not admit it).

senses.definition_vi: nhận ra, hiểu hoặc nhận thức được điều gì đó

senses.definition: to feel certain about something

examples.x: He knew (that) he could trust her.
I know it's here somewhere!
I know things will turn out all right.
I don't know that I can finish it by next week.
I just knew that it was something I wanted to do.
‘You were right—someone's been spreading rumours about you.’ ‘I knew it!’
‘She's the worst player in the team.’ ‘Oh, I don't know (= I am not sure that I agree)—she played well yesterday.’

senses.definition_vi: cảm thấy chắc chắn về điều gì đó

senses.definition: to be familiar with a person, place, thing, etc.

examples.x: I've known David for 20 years.
Do you two know each other (= have you met before)?
She was a secretary when I first knew her.
She's very nice when you get to know her.
Knowing Ben, we could be waiting a long time (= it is typical of him to be late).
This man is known to the police (= as a criminal).
I don’t know anyone in Oxford.
I know Paris well.
Do you know the play (= have you seen or read it before)?
How many of your neighbours do you know by name?
The new rules could mean the end of football as we know it (= in the form that we are familiar with).

senses.definition_vi: quen thuộc với một người, địa điểm, vật, v.v.

senses.definition: to have learned a skill or language and be able to use it

examples.x: Do you know any Japanese?
Do you know how to use spreadsheets?

senses.definition_vi: đã học một kỹ năng hoặc ngôn ngữ và có thể sử dụng nó

senses.definition: to think that somebody/something is a particular type of person or thing or has particular characteristics

examples.x: He has become widely known as an expert in child psychology.
It's known as the most dangerous part of the city.
She is best known for her work on the human brain.
He is internationally known for his work with vaccines.
He's known to be an outstanding physicist.

senses.definition_vi: nghĩ rằng ai đó/thứ gì đó là một loại người hoặc vật cụ thể hoặc có những đặc điểm cụ thể

senses.definition: to give somebody/something a particular name or title

examples.x: Iran was formerly known as Persia.
The H5N1 virus is more commonly known as bird flu.
Peter Wilson, also known as ‘The Tiger’

examples.cf: be known as somebody/something to somebody
examples.x: He was known as Bonzo to his friends.
The country was not yet known by the name of England.

senses.definition_vi: đặt cho ai đó/thứ gì đó một tên hoặc danh hiệu cụ thể

senses.definition: to be able to recognize somebody/something

examples.x: I couldn't see who was speaking, but I knew the voice.
She knows a bargain when she sees one.

senses.definition_vi: có thể nhận ra ai đó/thứ gì đó

senses.definition: to understand the difference between one person or thing and another

examples.x: I hope we have taught our children to know right from wrong.

senses.definition_vi: hiểu sự khác biệt giữa người này hoặc vật này và người khác hoặc vật khác

senses.definition: to have seen, heard or experienced something

examples.x: I’ve never known it (to) snow in July before.
He has been known to spend all morning in the bathroom.

senses.definition_vi: đã từng thấy, nghe hoặc trải nghiệm điều gì đó

senses.definition: to have personal experience of something

examples.x: He has known both poverty and wealth.
She may be successful now, but she has known what it is like to be poor.
She thought she would never know the joy of seeing a child grow up in her care.

senses.definition_vi: có kinh nghiệm cá nhân về điều gì đó

senses.definition: used to say that you think you know, remember, understand, etc. something but you cannot be completely sure, especially because you do not know all the facts

examples.x: As far as we knew, there was no cause for concern.
As far as I can see, you've done nothing wrong.
She lived in Chicago, as far as I can remember.

senses.definition_vi: được dùng để nói rằng bạn nghĩ rằng bạn biết, nhớ, hiểu, v.v. điều gì đó nhưng bạn không thể hoàn toàn chắc chắn, đặc biệt là vì bạn không biết tất cả các sự thật

senses.definition: very quickly or suddenly

examples.x: We were whisked off in a taxi before we knew where we were.

senses.definition_vi: rất nhanh hoặc đột ngột

senses.definition: to have no way of realizing or being aware that you have done something wrong

examples.x: ‘I'm sorry, I called when you were in bed.’ ‘Don't worry—you weren't to know.’

senses.definition_vi: không có cách nào nhận ra hoặc nhận thức được rằng bạn đã làm điều gì đó sai

senses.definition: used to say that it is easier and wiser to stay in a bad situation that you know and can deal with rather than change to a new situation that may be much worse
senses.definition_vi: được dùng để nói rằng dễ dàng và khôn ngoan hơn khi ở trong một tình huống tồi tệ mà bạn biết và có thể đối phó được thay vì thay đổi sang một tình huống mới có thể tồi tệ hơn nhiều

senses.definition: used to emphasize that you do not know something and that it is not important to you

examples.x: She could be dead for all I know.

senses.definition_vi: được dùng để nhấn mạnh rằng bạn không biết điều gì đó và điều đó không quan trọng với bạn

senses.definition: used to emphasize that you do not know something

examples.x: God knows what else they might find.
‘Where are they?’ ‘Goodness knows.’

senses.definition_vi: được dùng để nhấn mạnh rằng bạn không biết điều gì đó

senses.definition: used to emphasize the truth of what you are saying

examples.x: She ought to pass the exam—goodness knows she's been working hard enough.

senses.definition_vi: được dùng để nhấn mạnh sự thật của những gì bạn đang nói

senses.definition: to be confident that you know something, especially when you actually do not

examples.x: He thinks he knows all the answers.

senses.definition_vi: tự tin rằng bạn biết điều gì đó, đặc biệt là khi thực tế là không

senses.definition: to know something perfectly so that you can repeat it at any time without having to think about it

examples.x: He had all the answers off pat.

senses.definition_vi: biết điều gì đó một cách hoàn hảo để bạn có thể lặp lại nó bất cứ lúc nào mà không cần suy nghĩ

senses.definition: to be in poor condition

examples.x: Our car has seen better days!

senses.definition_vi: ở trong tình trạng tồi tệ

senses.definition: used to criticize somebody’s behaviour

examples.x: I don't know how you can say things like that.

senses.definition_vi: được dùng để chỉ trích hành vi của ai đó

senses.definition: used to tell somebody the true facts about a situation, especially when these are not known by other people

examples.x: If the truth be known, I was afraid to tell anyone.

senses.definition_vi: được dùng để cho người khác biết sự thật về một tình huống, đặc biệt là khi những người khác không biết

senses.definition: used to agree with somebody or to show sympathy

examples.x: ‘What a ridiculous situation!’ ‘I know.’

senses.definition_vi: được dùng để đồng ý với ai đó hoặc để thể hiện sự cảm thông

senses.definition: used to introduce a new idea or suggestion

examples.x: I know, let's see what's on at the theatre.

senses.definition_vi: được dùng để giới thiệu một ý tưởng hoặc đề xuất mới

senses.definition: used to criticize somebody by saying that they should realize or understand something

examples.x: You know as well as I do that you're being unreasonable.

senses.definition_vi: được dùng để chỉ trích ai đó bằng cách nói rằng họ nên nhận ra hoặc hiểu điều gì đó

senses.definition: to know somebody/something extremely well

examples.x: She must know the play backwards by now.

senses.definition_vi: biết ai đó/điều gì đó cực kỳ rõ

senses.definition: to know what should be done, etc. better than other people

examples.x: The doctor told you to stay in bed, and she knows best.

senses.definition_vi: biết những gì cần phải làm, v.v. tốt hơn những người khác

senses.definition: to be sensible enough not to do something

examples.x: He knows better than to judge by appearances.

senses.definition_vi: đủ nhạy bén để không làm điều gì đó

senses.definition: to recognize somebody without knowing them well
senses.definition_vi: nhận ra ai đó mà không biết họ rõ

senses.definition: to have information or evidence that the opposite is true

examples.x: He says he doesn't care about what the critics write, but I know different.

senses.definition_vi: có thông tin hoặc bằng chứng cho thấy điều ngược lại là đúng

senses.definition: to be very aware of a fact and unable to deny or ignore it

examples.x: He knew full well what she thought of it.

senses.definition_vi: rất nhận thức được một sự thật và không thể phủ nhận hoặc phớt lờ nó

senses.definition: to be very familiar with somebody/something

examples.x: This is where I grew up. I know this area like the back of my hand.

senses.definition_vi: rất quen thuộc với ai đó/điều gì đó

senses.definition: to have very clear and definite ideas about what you want to do
senses.definition_vi: có ý tưởng rất rõ ràng và dứt khoát về những gì bạn muốn làm

senses.definition: to know a lot about a particular subject or job
senses.definition_vi: biết nhiều về một chủ đề hoặc công việc cụ thể

senses.definition: to know/tell somebody some useful, interesting or surprising information about somebody/something

examples.x: She's been married five times, so she knows a thing or two about men!

senses.definition_vi: biết/cho ai đó biết thông tin hữu ích, thú vị hoặc đáng ngạc nhiên về ai đó/điều gì đó

senses.definition: to know something because of something unpleasant that has happened to you

examples.x: She is a tough competitor, as I know to my cost.

senses.definition_vi: biết điều gì đó vì điều gì đó khó chịu đã xảy ra với bạn

senses.definition: to be familiar with a place, subject, etc.
senses.definition_vi: quen thuộc với một địa điểm, chủ đề, v.v.

senses.definition: to have knowledge about something from your own experience

examples.x: I worked there for 20 years, so I know what I'm talking about.

senses.definition_vi: có kiến thức về điều gì đó từ kinh nghiệm của bạn

senses.definition: to know where you can get an advantage for yourself
senses.definition_vi: biết nơi bạn có thể tự mình đạt được lợi thế

senses.definition: to make sure that people are informed about something, especially by getting somebody else to tell them

examples.x: The President has let it be known that he does not intend to run for election again.

senses.definition_vi: đảm bảo rằng mọi người được thông báo về điều gì đó, đặc biệt là bằng cách nhờ người khác nói cho họ biết

senses.definition: to tell somebody about something

examples.x: I don't know if I can come, but I'll let you know tomorrow.
Let me know how I can help.
Please let me know if there's anything I can do to help.

senses.definition_vi: cho ai đó biết về điều gì đó

senses.definition: used to emphasize what you are saying

examples.x: Lord knows, I tried to teach her.

senses.definition_vi: được dùng để nhấn mạnh những gì bạn đang nói

senses.definition: used to say that you do not know the answer to something

examples.x: ‘Why did she say that?’ ‘Lord knows!’

senses.definition_vi: được dùng để nói rằng bạn không biết câu trả lời cho một điều gì đó

senses.definition: to introduce yourself to somebody

examples.x: I made myself known to the hotel manager.

senses.definition_vi: tự giới thiệu với ai đó

senses.definition: to behave badly, usually because you have not been taught the correct way to behave

examples.x: Don’t blame the children—they don’t know any better.

senses.definition_vi: hành xử tệ, thường là vì bạn chưa được dạy cách cư xử đúng đắn

senses.definition: to be very stupid; to have absolutely no skill
senses.definition_vi: rất ngu ngốc; hoàn toàn không có kỹ năng

senses.definition: to know nothing about a subject

examples.x: I don’t know beans about making movies.

senses.definition_vi: không biết gì về một chủ đề

senses.definition: to know nothing at all about somebody/something

examples.x: I’m afraid I don’t know the first thing about cars.

senses.definition_vi: không biết gì cả về ai đó/điều gì đó

senses.definition: to know nothing at all about something/somebody

examples.x: We’ve lived next to him for years, but we still don’t know the first thing about him.

senses.definition_vi: hoàn toàn không biết gì về điều gì/ai đó

senses.definition: to not know at all who somebody is
senses.definition_vi: hoàn toàn không biết ai đó là ai

senses.definition: to be so surprised by something that you do not know how to react
senses.short_meaning_vi: bất ngờ không biết phản ứng
senses.definition_vi: quá ngạc nhiên về điều gì đó đến nỗi không biết phải phản ứng thế nào

senses.definition: to feel very embarrassed and not know how to react
senses.definition_vi: cảm thấy vô cùng xấu hổ và không biết phải phản ứng thế nào

senses.definition: to be so excited or confused that you cannot behave or think in a sensible way
senses.definition_vi: quá phấn khích hoặc bối rối đến nỗi không thể cư xử hoặc suy nghĩ một cách hợp lý

senses.definition: to have an easy life without realizing how easy it is

examples.x: You people without kids don't know you're born.

senses.definition_vi: có một cuộc sống dễ dàng mà không nhận ra nó dễ dàng như thế nào

senses.definition: to take no interest in something because you do not care about it or it is too much trouble

examples.x: I've tried to ask her advice, but she doesn't want to know (= about my problems).
‘How much was it?’ ‘You don't want to know’ (= it is better if you don't know).

senses.definition_vi: không quan tâm đến điều gì vì bạn không bận tâm về nó hoặc nó quá rắc rối

senses.definition: old enough to behave in a more sensible way than you actually did
senses.definition_vi: đủ lớn để cư xử một cách hợp lý hơn so với những gì bạn đã làm thực tế

senses.definition: to show somebody/know/learn how a particular job should be done
senses.definition_vi: chỉ cho ai đó/biết/học cách một công việc cụ thể nên được thực hiện như thế nào

senses.definition: used to say that it is impossible to say what might happen

examples.x: There's no knowing how he'll react.

senses.definition_vi: được sử dụng để nói rằng không thể nói điều gì có thể xảy ra

senses.definition: used to say that somebody knows nothing about the subject you are talking about

examples.x: What does he know about football, anyway?

senses.definition_vi: được sử dụng để nói rằng ai đó không biết gì về chủ đề bạn đang nói đến

senses.definition: used to express surprise

examples.x: Well, what do you know? Look who's here!

senses.definition_vi: được sử dụng để bày tỏ sự ngạc nhiên

senses.definition: (know) what things are useful, important, etc.

examples.x: She certainly knows what's what.

senses.definition_vi: biết những điều gì là hữu ích, quan trọng, v.v.

senses.definition: used when you are thinking of what to say next

examples.x: Well, you know, it's difficult to explain.

senses.definition_vi: được sử dụng khi bạn đang suy nghĩ về những gì sẽ nói tiếp theo

senses.definition: used to show that what you are referring to is known or understood by the person you are speaking to

examples.x: Guess who I've just seen? Maggie! You know—Jim's wife.
You know that restaurant round the corner? It's closed down.

senses.definition_vi: được sử dụng để chỉ ra rằng những gì bạn đang đề cập được người mà bạn đang nói chuyện biết hoặc hiểu

senses.definition: used to emphasize something that you are saying

examples.x: I'm not stupid, you know.

senses.definition_vi: được sử dụng để nhấn mạnh điều gì đó bạn đang nói

senses.definition: used to introduce an interesting or surprising opinion, piece of news, etc.

examples.x: You know something? I've never really enjoyed Christmas.

senses.definition_vi: được sử dụng để giới thiệu một ý kiến, tin tức thú vị hoặc đáng ngạc nhiên, v.v.

senses.definition: used to refer to somebody/something without mentioning a name
senses.short_meaning_vi: ai đó/điều gì đó ẩn danh
senses.definition_vi: được sử dụng để chỉ ai đó/điều gì đó mà không nêu tên

senses.definition: used to say that you can never be certain about what will happen in the future, especially when you are suggesting that something good might happen
senses.short_meaning_vi: không bao giờ chắc chắn về tương lai
senses.definition_vi: được sử dụng để nói rằng bạn không bao giờ có thể chắc chắn về những gì sẽ xảy ra trong tương lai, đặc biệt là khi bạn gợi ý rằng điều gì đó tốt có thể xảy ra

senses.definition: a piece of paper, etc. that is attached to something and that gives information about it

examples.x: Always read the label carefully.
price/address labels
The washing instructions are on the label.

senses.definition_vi: gắn một nhãn vào một cái gì đó hoặc viết thông tin lên một cái gì đó

senses.definition: a word or phrase that is used to describe somebody/something in a way that seems too general, unfair or not correct

examples.x: I hate the label ‘millennial’.

senses.definition_vi: gắn một nhãn vào một cái gì đó hoặc viết thông tin lên một cái gì đó

senses.definition: the name or trademark of a fashion company

examples.x: today's major fashion labels
She plans to launch her own designer clothes label.
He's really fashion-conscious and will only wear labels (= clothes with a designer label).

senses.definition_vi: gắn một nhãn vào một cái gì đó hoặc viết thông tin lên một cái gì đó

senses.definition: a company that produces and sells music, CDs, etc.

examples.x: an independent record label
It's his first release for a major label.

senses.definition_vi: gắn một nhãn vào một cái gì đó hoặc viết thông tin lên một cái gì đó

senses.definition: the state of not having something or not having enough of something

examples.x: a lack of understanding/knowledge
Passengers complained about the lack of information when flights were cancelled.
Her enthusiasm compensated for her apparent lack of experience.
He was suffering from a complete lack of confidence.
There was no lack of volunteers.

examples.cf: because of a lack of something
examples.x: The project was abandoned because of a total lack of support.
He was released due to lack of evidence.
The trip was cancelled through lack of interest.
The match was quite exciting, despite the lack of goals.
Money and the fear of its lack are present in many of his poems.

senses.definition_vi: không có hoặc không đủ một cái gì đó

senses.definition: used to say that although somebody has not succeeded in something, they have tried very hard

examples.x: They haven't won a game yet, but it isn't for want of trying.
They lost the game, but not for lack of trying.

senses.definition_vi: không có hoặc không đủ một cái gì đó

senses.definition: big in size or quantity

examples.x: a large group/city/area/crowd/family
a large number of people
There were some very large amounts of money involved.
Drought hit large parts of the country.
A large proportion of older people live alone.
The company has grown large enough to employ over 100 people.
The kitchen is relatively large for a modern apartment.
That's too large to fit in my suitcase!
The population is slightly larger than that of Canada.
Each company would try to capture a larger share of the market by intensive advertising.
Seoul is one of the world's largest cities.
Who's the rather large (= fat) lady in the hat?

senses.definition_vi: to về kích thước hoặc số lượng

senses.definition: used to describe one size in a range of sizes of clothes, food, products used in the house, etc.

examples.x: Would you like small, medium or large?
Do you have these jeans in a larger size?

senses.definition_vi: dùng để mô tả một kích cỡ trong một loạt các kích cỡ quần áo, thực phẩm, sản phẩm sử dụng trong nhà, v.v.

senses.definition: wide in range and involving many things

examples.x: a large and complex issue
Some drugs are being used on a much larger scale than previously.
The studies are often large in scope, with budgets to match.
If we look at the larger picture of the situation, the differences seem slight.

senses.definition_vi: có phạm vi rộng và liên quan đến nhiều thứ

senses.definition: as a whole; in general

examples.x: the opinion of the public at large

senses.definition_vi: nói chung; nói chung

senses.definition: not captured; free

examples.x: Her killer is still at large.

senses.definition_vi: không bị bắt giữ; tự do

senses.definition: used when you are saying something that is generally, but not completely, true

examples.x: By and large, I enjoyed my time at school.

senses.definition_vi: dùng khi nói một điều gì đó đúng nói chung, nhưng không hoàn toàn đúng

senses.definition: to enjoy yourself, especially by dancing and drinking alcohol

senses.definition_vi: đi khỏi một người hoặc một địa điểm

senses.definition: on the side of your body that is towards the west when you are facing north

examples.x: Fewer people write with their left hand than with their right.
your left knee/leg/foot/arm
the left side of the field
The university is on the left bank of the river.
Take a left turn at the intersection.
a left back
a left hook (= a short hard hit with your closed left hand)

senses.definition_vi: phía hoặc hướng bên trái

senses.definition: to be very awkward in your movements, especially when you are dancing or playing a sport
senses.definition_vi: phía hoặc hướng bên trái

senses.definition: time when you are not working or studying; free time

examples.x: These days we have more money and more leisure to enjoy it.
Make the most of your leisure time!

senses.definition_vi: thời gian khi bạn không làm việc hoặc học tập; thời gian tự do

senses.definition: activities that you enjoy in your free time

examples.x: These days we have increased opportunities for leisure.
leisure activities/pursuits
public parks and leisure facilities
the leisure industry (= the business of providing leisure activities)

senses.definition_vi: các hoạt động bạn thích trong thời gian rảnh

senses.definition: with no particular activities; free

examples.x: Spend the afternoon at leisure in the town centre.

senses.definition_vi: không có hoạt động cụ thể; tự do

senses.definition: without hurrying

examples.x: Let's have lunch so we can talk at leisure.

senses.definition_vi: không vội vàng

senses.definition: when you have the time to do something without hurrying

examples.x: I suggest you take the forms away and read them at your leisure.

senses.definition_vi: khi bạn có thời gian để làm điều gì đó mà không vội vàng

senses.definition: a man/woman who does not have to work
senses.definition_vi: một người đàn ông/phụ nữ không phải làm việc

senses.definition: very long, and often too long, in time or size

examples.x: lengthy delays
I had to go through the lengthy process of obtaining a visa.
a lengthy explanation

senses.definition_vi: rất dài, và thường là quá dài, về thời gian hoặc kích thước.

senses.definition: to a smaller degree; not so much

examples.x: less expensive/likely/intelligent
less often/enthusiastically
I read much less now than I used to.
The receptionist was less than (= not at all) helpful.
She wasn't any the less happy for (= she was perfectly happy) being on her own.
That this is a positive stereotype makes it no less a stereotype, and therefore unacceptable.

senses.short_meaning_vi: ít hơn (danh từ không đếm được)
senses.definition_vi: được sử dụng với các danh từ không đếm được để có nghĩa là 'một lượng nhỏ hơn'.

senses.definition: continuing to become smaller in amount

examples.x: She found the job less and less attractive.

senses.short_meaning_vi: ít hơn (danh từ không đếm được)
senses.definition_vi: được sử dụng với các danh từ không đếm được để có nghĩa là 'một lượng nhỏ hơn'.

senses.definition: almost

examples.x: I've more or less finished the book.

senses.short_meaning_vi: ít hơn (danh từ không đếm được)
senses.definition_vi: được sử dụng với các danh từ không đếm được để có nghĩa là 'một lượng nhỏ hơn'.

senses.definition: approximately

examples.x: She could earn $200 a night, more or less.

senses.short_meaning_vi: ít hơn (danh từ không đếm được)
senses.definition_vi: được sử dụng với các danh từ không đếm được để có nghĩa là 'một lượng nhỏ hơn'.

senses.definition: and certainly not

examples.x: No explanation was offered, still less an apology.
He’s too shy to ask a stranger the time, much less speak to a room full of people.

senses.short_meaning_vi: ít hơn (danh từ không đếm được)
senses.definition_vi: được sử dụng với các danh từ không đếm được để có nghĩa là 'một lượng nhỏ hơn'.

senses.definition: not as great in size, amount or importance as something/somebody else

examples.x: people of lesser importance
They were all involved to a greater or lesser degree (= some were more involved than others).
The London Stock Exchange has been losing business to New York and, to a lesser extent, Amsterdam.
He was encouraged to plead guilty to the lesser offence.
He doesn’t even acknowledge us lesser mortals (= people who are not as important or powerful).
A lesser woman would have given up.

senses.definition_vi: không lớn bằng, không nhiều bằng hoặc không quan trọng bằng người/vật khác.

senses.definition: used in the names of some types of animals, birds and plants that are smaller than similar kinds

examples.x: a lesser black-backed gull

senses.definition_vi: được sử dụng trong tên của một số loại động vật, chim và thực vật nhỏ hơn các loại tương tự.

senses.definition: the less unpleasant of two unpleasant choices
senses.definition_vi: lựa chọn ít khó chịu hơn trong hai lựa chọn khó chịu.

senses.definition: used for making suggestions or as a polite way of telling people what you want them to do

examples.x: ‘Shall we check it again?’ ‘Yes, let's.’
Let's go to the beach.
Right, let's begin.
Let us review these points in more detail.
Let's not tell her what we did.
Don't let's tell her what we did.
Now let's not be silly about this.

senses.definition_vi: dùng để đưa ra gợi ý hoặc một cách lịch sự để nói cho mọi người biết bạn muốn họ làm gì

senses.definition: used for offering help to somebody

examples.x: Let me help you with that.
Here, let me do it.
Let us get those boxes down for you.
'Please, let me,' she said, opening the door.

senses.definition_vi: dùng để đề nghị giúp đỡ ai đó

senses.definition: used for making requests or giving instructions

examples.x: Let me have your report by Friday.
Let me know (= tell me) how I can help.
Please let us know your decision as soon as possible.

senses.definition_vi: dùng để đưa ra yêu cầu hoặc chỉ dẫn

senses.definition: to allow somebody to do something or something to happen without trying to stop it

examples.x: Let them splash around in the pool for a while.
Don't let her upset you.
Let your body relax.
I'll let others decide whether the play was a success or not.
Will you let me finish?
He'd eat chocolate all day long if I let him.

senses.definition_vi: cho phép ai đó làm điều gì đó hoặc điều gì đó xảy ra mà không cố gắng ngăn chặn nó

senses.definition: to give somebody permission to do something

examples.x: They won't let him leave the country.
In some countries they let you drive at 15.
They refused to let us cross the border.
I wanted to go but my parents wouldn't let me.

senses.definition_vi: cho phép ai đó làm điều gì đó

senses.definition: to allow somebody/something to go somewhere

examples.x: to let somebody into the house
This lets more water into the soil.
I'll give you a key so that you can let yourself in.
The hall will be able to let in more spectators.
Please let me past.
The cat wants to be let out.

senses.definition_vi: cho phép ai đó/thứ gì đó đi đâu đó

senses.definition: used to show that you are not afraid or worried about somebody doing something

examples.x: If he thinks he can cheat me, just let him try!

senses.definition_vi: dùng để cho thấy bạn không sợ hãi hoặc lo lắng về việc ai đó làm điều gì đó

senses.definition: used to express a strong wish for something to happen

examples.x: Let her come home safely!

senses.definition_vi: dùng để bày tỏ một mong muốn mạnh mẽ cho điều gì đó xảy ra

senses.definition: used to introduce what you are going to say or do

examples.x: Let me give you an example.
Let me just finish this and then I'll come.

senses.definition_vi: dùng để giới thiệu những gì bạn sắp nói hoặc làm

senses.definition: used to say that you are supposing something to be true when you calculate something

examples.x: Let line AB be equal to line CD.

senses.definition_vi: dùng để nói rằng bạn đang giả định điều gì đó là đúng khi bạn tính toán một cái gì đó

senses.definition: to allow somebody to use a house, room, etc. in return for regular payments

examples.x: I let the spare room.
They decided to let out the smaller offices at low rents.

senses.definition_vi: cho phép ai đó sử dụng một ngôi nhà, căn phòng, v.v. để đổi lấy các khoản thanh toán thường xuyên

senses.definition: to stop trying to change the behaviour or state of somebody/something

examples.x: I know I'm being grumpy, but I'm really tired so just let me be.

senses.definition_vi: ngừng cố gắng thay đổi hành vi hoặc trạng thái của ai đó/thứ gì đó

senses.definition: to mention something in a conversation, by accident or as if by accident

examples.x: She let fall a further heavy hint.

senses.definition_vi: đề cập đến điều gì đó trong cuộc trò chuyện, do vô tình hoặc như thể do vô tình

senses.definition: to allow somebody to be free

examples.x: Will they let the hostages go?
He's finally been let go.

senses.definition_vi: cho phép ai đó được tự do

senses.definition: to make somebody have to leave their job

examples.x: They're having to let 100 employees go because of falling profits.

senses.definition_vi: khiến ai đó phải rời bỏ công việc của họ

senses.definition: to stop holding somebody/something

examples.x: Don't let the rope go.
Don't let go of the rope.
Let go! You're hurting me!

senses.definition_vi: ngừng giữ ai đó/thứ gì đó

senses.definition: to give up an idea or an attitude, or control of something

examples.x: It's time to let the past go.
It's time to let go of the past.

senses.definition_vi: từ bỏ một ý tưởng hoặc thái độ, hoặc quyền kiểm soát một cái gì đó

senses.definition: to stop taking care of a house, garden, etc.

examples.x: I'm afraid I've let the garden go this year.
He'd really let the house go since she'd died.

senses.definition_vi: ngừng chăm sóc một ngôi nhà, khu vườn, v.v.

senses.definition: to attack somebody physically or with words
senses.definition_vi: tấn công ai đó về thể chất hoặc bằng lời nói

senses.definition: to say or do no more about something

examples.x: I don't entirely agree, but I'll let it go at that.
I thought she was hinting at something, but I let it go.

senses.definition_vi: nói hoặc làm thêm về điều gì đó

senses.definition: used when you are thinking or trying to remember something

examples.x: Now let me see—where did he say he lived?

senses.definition_vi: dùng khi bạn đang suy nghĩ hoặc cố gắng nhớ lại điều gì đó

senses.definition: used when commenting on a situation to suggest that you could say something more or worse but prefer not to

examples.x: Let's just say he wasn't very happy about the decision (= he was very unhappy or angry about it).

senses.definition_vi: dùng khi nhận xét về một tình huống để gợi ý rằng bạn có thể nói thêm hoặc tệ hơn nhưng thà không làm vậy

senses.definition: used when making a suggestion or giving an example

examples.x: I can let you have it for, well let's say £100.

senses.definition_vi: dùng khi đưa ra một gợi ý hoặc một ví dụ

senses.definition: to behave in a relaxed way without worrying about what people think of your behaviour

examples.x: Come on, enjoy yourself—let yourself go!

senses.definition_vi: hành xử một cách thoải mái mà không lo lắng về những gì người khác nghĩ về hành vi của bạn

senses.definition: to stop being careful about how you look and dress, etc.

examples.x: He has let himself go since he lost his job.

senses.definition_vi: ngừng cẩn thận về cách bạn nhìn và ăn mặc, v.v.

senses.definition: available for rent

examples.x: The website advertises flats to let in the local area.

senses.definition_vi: có sẵn để cho thuê

senses.definition: a written, typed or printed message that is put in an envelope or attached to an email and sent to somebody

examples.x: to write/send (somebody) a letter
to receive/get a letter
to post a letter
to mail a letter
a thank-you/resignation/rejection letter
In a letter to members, the Chairman explained the changes.
I wrote a letter to the editor of our local paper.
You may need a letter from your doctor.
a letter of recommendation/complaint/apology
You will be notified by letter.

senses.definition_vi: một tin nhắn viết, đánh máy hoặc in được bỏ vào phong bì hoặc đính kèm vào email và gửi cho ai đó

senses.definition: a written or printed sign representing a sound used in speech

examples.x: ‘B’ is the second letter of the alphabet.
How many letters are in the Greek alphabet?
the letter A/B/C
I'm thinking of a word that begins with the letter M.
She typed the word ‘HISTORY’ in capital letters.
The slogan is printed in bold letters across the top.

senses.definition_vi: một dấu hiệu viết hoặc in đại diện cho một âm thanh được sử dụng trong lời nói

senses.definition: a sign in the shape of a letter that is sewn onto clothes to show that a person plays in a school or college sports team
senses.definition_vi: một dấu hiệu có hình dạng chữ cái được khâu trên quần áo để cho thấy một người chơi trong đội thể thao của trường học hoặc cao đẳng

senses.definition: the exact words of a law or rule rather than its general meaning

examples.x: They insist on sticking to the letter of the law.
We might be guilty of slightly bending the letter of the law.
In spite of the difficulties it would cause her family, the judge stuck to the letter of the law and jailed her.

senses.definition_vi: những lời chính xác của một luật hoặc quy tắc thay vì ý nghĩa chung của nó

senses.definition: doing/following exactly what somebody/something says, paying attention to every detail

examples.x: I followed your instructions to the letter.

senses.definition_vi: làm/tuân theo chính xác những gì ai đó/thứ gì đó nói, chú ý đến mọi chi tiết

senses.definition: a statement made by somebody knowing that it is not true

examples.x: to tell a lie
The whole story is nothing but a pack of lies.
That's an outright lie!
a barefaced/bald-faced/blatant lie (= a lie that is deliberate and shocking)
How dare you spread such vicious lies about other people?
He said he would not respond to the lies about his war record.
an elaborate lie about being attacked by two masked men

senses.definition_vi: nói hoặc viết điều gì đó mà bạn biết là không đúng sự thật.

senses.definition: to show that something is not true

examples.x: These new figures give the lie to the belief that unemployment is going down.

senses.definition_vi: nói hoặc viết điều gì đó mà bạn biết là không đúng sự thật.

senses.definition: used to say that something you have just said is not true or correct

examples.x: We first met in 2006, no, I tell a lie, it was 2007.

senses.definition_vi: nói hoặc viết điều gì đó mà bạn biết là không đúng sự thật.

senses.definition: to keep something important about yourself a secret from other people, so that they do not know what you really think, what you are really like, etc.

examples.x: He lived a lie for thirty years, ‘married’ to two women.

senses.definition_vi: nói hoặc viết điều gì đó mà bạn biết là không đúng sự thật.

senses.definition: a story, an excuse, etc. that is full of lies
senses.definition_vi: nói hoặc viết điều gì đó mà bạn biết là không đúng sự thật.

senses.definition: the ability to breathe, grow, produce young, etc. that people, animals and plants have before they die and that objects do not have

examples.x: This could mean the difference between life and death.
The body was cold and showed no signs of life.
I wish we could bring dinosaurs back to life.
In spring the countryside bursts into life.

senses.definition_vi: khả năng thở, phát triển, sinh sản, v.v. mà con người, động vật và thực vật có trước khi chết và vật thể không có.

senses.definition: the state of being alive as a human; an individual person’s existence

examples.x: The floods caused a massive loss of life (= many people were killed).
All risk to human life should be avoided.
He risked his life to save his daughter from the fire.
The operation saved her life.
My grandfather lost his life (= was killed) in the war.
The bombing claimed the lives of (= killed) thousands of people.
Hundreds of lives were threatened when the building collapsed.
Attempts have been made on his life (= people have tried to kill him).

senses.definition_vi: trạng thái tồn tại của con người; sự tồn tại của một cá nhân.

senses.definition: living things

examples.x: plant/animal/insect life
Plastic is a threat to marine life.
Nuclear war could mean the end of life on earth.
Is there intelligent life on other planets?
There was no sign of life in the abandoned village.

senses.definition_vi: sinh vật sống.

senses.definition: the period between somebody’s birth and their death; a part of this period

examples.x: He's lived here all his life.
I've lived in England for most of my life.
somebody's whole/entire life
We have known each other our whole lives.
He will spend the rest of his life (= until he dies) in prison.
to have a long/short life
to devote/dedicate your life to something
She's had some interesting experiences in her life.
I've never in my entire life been so embarrassed.
in early/later life
Brenda took up tennis late in life.
A baby's weight will normally double in the first five months of life.
Throughout her life she was dogged by loneliness.
She had three marriages during her 89-year life.
There's no such thing as a job for life any longer.
She stayed there until the end of her life.
He was sentenced to life imprisonment.

senses.definition_vi: khoảng thời gian giữa lúc sinh và lúc chết của ai đó; một phần của khoảng thời gian này.

senses.definition: a period of somebody’s life when they are in a particular situation or job

examples.x: She has been an accountant all her working life.
He spent his entire adult life in France.
They were very happy throughout their married life.
During his life in Britain he has never worked.
He met a lot of interesting people during his life as a student.

senses.definition_vi: một giai đoạn trong cuộc đời của ai đó khi họ ở trong một tình huống hoặc công việc cụ thể.

senses.definition: the period of time when something exists or functions

examples.x: In Italy the average life of a government is eleven months.
There are a few things you can do to extend the life of your carpet.
These machines have a limited life (= they do not function well for very long).
These smaller, lighter phones tend to have a shorter battery life.
The International Stock Exchange started life as a coffee shop.
The building will now have a new life as a museum.

senses.definition_vi: khoảng thời gian mà một thứ gì đó tồn tại hoặc hoạt động.

senses.definition: the experience and activities that are typical of all people’s existences

examples.x: the worries of everyday life
Commuting is a part of daily life for many people.
He is young and has little experience of life.
Jill wants to travel and see life for herself.
We have no time just to enjoy life.
Life can be hard.
We bought a dishwasher to make life easier.
Life isn't like in the movies, you know.
It's important to have a purpose in life.
In real life (= when she met him) he wasn't how she had imagined him at all.
Can you imagine life without music?
You can share life events like getting married or becoming a parent.
He just needs a little more life experience.

senses.definition_vi: những trải nghiệm và hoạt động điển hình cho sự tồn tại của tất cả mọi người.

senses.definition: the activities and experiences that are typical of a particular way of living

examples.x: We just want a normal family life.
Technology is part of modern life.
She enjoyed political life.
His fame was so sudden that he was unprepared for public life.
country/city/island life
How do you find life in Japan?
He eventually got used to life in prison.

senses.definition_vi: những hoạt động và trải nghiệm điển hình cho một lối sống cụ thể.

senses.definition: a person’s experiences during their life; the activities that form a particular part of a person’s life

examples.x: to have/live/lead a… life
He has had a good life.
She lived a quiet life in the countryside.
Many of these children have led very sheltered lives (= they have not had many different experiences).
a hard/an easy life
Her daily life involved meeting lots of people.
My day-to-day life is not very exciting.
Meeting Penny changed my life.
to affect/improve somebody's life
They emigrated to start a new life in Canada.
He doesn't like to talk about his private life.
She has a full social life.
They lead a life of luxury.
I don't want people like that in my life.

senses.definition_vi: những trải nghiệm của một người trong cuộc đời họ; những hoạt động tạo nên một phần cụ thể trong cuộc đời của một người.

senses.definition: the quality of being active and exciting

examples.x: This is a great holiday resort that is full of life.
We need to inject some new life into this project.

senses.definition_vi: chất lượng của việc năng động và thú vị.

senses.definition: the punishment of being sent to prison for life or a very long period of time; life imprisonment

examples.x: The judge gave him life.
She is doing life for murder.

senses.definition_vi: hình phạt bị tống giam suốt đời hoặc trong một thời gian rất dài; tù chung thân.

senses.definition: a living model or a real object or scene that people draw or paint

examples.x: She had lessons in drawing from life.
a life class (= one in which art students draw a naked man or woman)

senses.definition_vi: một mô hình sống hoặc một vật thể hoặc cảnh thực mà mọi người vẽ hoặc tô màu.

senses.definition: a story of somebody’s life

examples.x: She wrote a life of Mozart.

senses.definition_vi: một câu chuyện về cuộc đời của ai đó.

senses.definition: one of a set number of chances before a player is out of a game

examples.x: He's lost two lives, so he's only got one left.

senses.definition_vi: một trong số những lượt chơi cho phép trước khi người chơi bị loại khỏi trò chơi.

senses.definition: at the age you are (especially when you are not young)

examples.x: Eyesight doesn't get any better at my time of life.

senses.definition_vi: ở độ tuổi của bạn (đặc biệt là khi bạn không còn trẻ).

senses.definition: be the most important person or thing to somebody

examples.x: My children are my life.
Writing is his life.

senses.definition_vi: là người hoặc vật quan trọng nhất đối với ai đó.

senses.definition: to improve something by introducing new ideas and making people more interested in it

examples.x: The results of their research have breathed new life into the debate.

senses.definition_vi: cải thiện điều gì đó bằng cách đưa ra những ý tưởng mới và làm cho mọi người quan tâm hơn đến nó.

senses.definition: an essential part of a person’s existence

examples.x: Playing the violin has been the breath of life to her for over 20 years.

senses.definition_vi: một phần thiết yếu trong sự tồn tại của một người.

senses.definition: to make somebody/something more interesting or exciting

examples.x: The new teacher really brought French to life for us.
Flowers can bring a dull room back to life.

senses.definition_vi: làm cho ai đó/điều gì đó trở nên thú vị hoặc hấp dẫn hơn.

senses.definition: to become more interesting, exciting or full of activity

senses.definition_vi: được sử dụng để thể hiện sự ngạc nhiên khi nhìn thấy ai đó/điều gì đó

senses.definition: looking or behaving in a way that is more interesting or exciting than other people, and so is likely to attract attention

senses.definition_vi: hành động hoặc quá trình giới hạn hoặc kiểm soát ai đó/điều gì đó

senses.definition_vi: được sử dụng với danh từ không đếm được để có nghĩa là ‘một lượng nhỏ’, ‘một ít’

senses.definition_vi: tiền để mua những thứ bạn cần trong cuộc sống

senses.definition_vi: tiền để mua những thứ bạn cần trong cuộc sống

senses.definition_vi: trong một thời gian dài
