senses.definition_vi: xảy ra trước một điều gì đó hoặc đứng trước một điều gì đó/ai đó theo thứ tự

senses.definition: to go in front of somebody

examples.x: She preceded him out of the room.

senses.definition_vi: đi trước ai đó

senses.definition: to do or say something to introduce something else

examples.x: She preceded her speech with a vote of thanks to the committee.

senses.definition_vi: làm hoặc nói điều gì đó để giới thiệu một điều khác

senses.definition: rare and worth a lot of money

examples.x: a precious vase
The crown was set with precious jewels—diamonds, rubies and emeralds.
precious metals

senses.definition_vi: hiếm và đáng giá nhiều tiền

senses.definition: valuable or important and not to be wasted

examples.x: Clean water is a precious commodity in that part of the world.
You're wasting precious time!

senses.definition_vi: có giá trị hoặc quan trọng và không nên lãng phí

senses.definition: loved or valued very much

examples.x: precious memories/possessions
You are infinitely precious to me.

senses.definition_vi: được yêu mến hoặc coi trọng rất nhiều

senses.definition: used to show you are angry that another person thinks something is very important

examples.x: I didn't touch your precious car!

senses.definition_vi: được sử dụng để thể hiện sự tức giận của bạn rằng người khác cho rằng điều gì đó rất quan trọng

senses.definition: very formal, exaggerated and not natural in what you say and do
senses.definition_vi: rất trang trọng, cường điệu và không tự nhiên trong lời nói và hành động của bạn

senses.definition: mostly; mainly

examples.x: She works in a predominantly male environment.

senses.definition_vi: hầu hết; chủ yếu

senses.definition: to like one thing or person better than another; to choose one thing rather than something else because you like it better

examples.x: ‘Coffee or tea?’ ‘I'd prefer tea, thanks.’
I would prefer it if you didn't tell anyone.
A local firm is to be preferred.
A short-term fixed rate is the preferred option.
I much prefer jazz to rock music.
I prefer quality to quantity.
Many people prefer streaming over other forms of consuming media.
Relevant experience is preferred over formal education.
I prefer my coffee black.
I much prefer to travel by train.
The donor prefers to remain anonymous.
I prefer not to think about it.
She won't discuss her plans in detail, preferring instead to wait until after the election.
Would you prefer me to stay?
I prefer playing in defence.
I would prefer that you did not mention my name.

senses.definition_vi: thích một thứ hoặc một người hơn thứ khác; chọn một thứ thay vì thứ khác vì bạn thích nó hơn

senses.definition: to accuse somebody formally of a crime so that there can be a trial in court

examples.x: Police have brought a charge of dangerous driving against the man.
Many victims of crime are reluctant to press charges against their attackers.
She laid charges against the firm for not complying with the regulations.

senses.definition_vi: buộc tội ai đó một cách chính thức về một tội danh để có thể đưa ra xét xử tại tòa án

senses.definition: a greater interest in or desire for somebody/something than somebody/something else

examples.x: It's a matter of personal preference.
I can't say that I have any particular preference.
Many people expressed a strong preference for the original plan.
Let's make a list of possible speakers, in order of preference.

senses.definition_vi: sự quan tâm hoặc mong muốn lớn hơn đối với ai đó/điều gì đó hơn là đối với ai đó/điều gì đó khác

senses.definition: a thing that is liked better or best

examples.x: a study of consumer preferences

senses.definition_vi: một thứ được thích hơn hoặc thích nhất

senses.definition: to treat somebody/something in a way that gives them an advantage over other people or things

examples.x: Preference will be given to graduates of this university.

senses.definition_vi: đối xử với ai đó/điều gì đó theo cách mang lại cho họ lợi thế hơn những người hoặc vật khác

senses.definition: rather than somebody/something

examples.x: She was chosen in preference to her sister.
They bought French planes in preference to British ones.

senses.definition_vi: thay vì ai đó/điều gì đó

senses.definition: to make something or somebody ready to be used or to do something

examples.x: to prepare a report
A hotel room is being prepared for them.
The college prepares students for a career in business.
The training has prepared me to deal with any medical issue.
We all set about preparing for the party.

senses.definition_vi: làm cho ai đó hoặc điều gì đó sẵn sàng để được sử dụng hoặc để làm một việc gì đó

senses.definition: to make yourself ready to do something or for something that you expect to happen

examples.x: I had no time to prepare.
The whole class is working hard preparing for the exams.
The police are preparing themselves for trouble at the demonstration.
I had been preparing myself for this moment.
Her condition is not improving as we hoped. You must prepare yourselves for the worst.
As I waited, I closed my eyes to mentally prepare myself.
I was preparing to leave.
The troops prepared themselves to go into battle.

senses.definition_vi: tự chuẩn bị để làm một việc gì đó hoặc cho một điều gì đó mà bạn mong đợi sẽ xảy ra

senses.definition: to make food ready to be eaten

examples.x: He was in the kitchen preparing lunch.
to prepare meals/food/dinner

senses.definition_vi: làm cho thực phẩm sẵn sàng để ăn

senses.definition: to make a medicine or chemical substance, for example by mixing other substances together

examples.x: remedies prepared from herbal extracts

senses.definition_vi: chuẩn bị một loại thuốc hoặc chất hóa học, ví dụ bằng cách trộn các chất khác lại với nhau

senses.definition: to make it possible or easier for something to be achieved

examples.x: The committee will prepare the ground for next month's meeting.
Early experiments with rockets prepared the ground for space travel.

senses.definition_vi: làm cho có thể hoặc dễ dàng hơn để đạt được một điều gì đó

senses.definition: ready and able to deal with something

examples.x: We'll be better prepared next time.
When they set out they were well prepared.
I was not prepared for all the problems it caused.
In his new job he must be prepared for anything.
He came prepared with a list of questions.

senses.definition_vi: sẵn sàng và có khả năng xử lý một điều gì đó

senses.definition: willing to do something

examples.x: We are not prepared to accept these conditions.
How much are you prepared to pay?

senses.definition_vi: sẵn lòng làm một việc gì đó

senses.definition: done, made, written, etc. in advance

examples.x: The police officer read out a prepared statement.
I usually buy packs of prepared vegetables to save time.
She's clearly reading from prepared notes.

senses.definition_vi: được thực hiện, làm, viết, v.v. trước

senses.definition: the fact of being in a particular place

examples.x: He hardly seemed to notice my presence.
Her presence during the crisis had a calming effect.
Your presence is requested at the meeting.
They married in the presence of their family members.

senses.definition_vi: việc có mặt ở một địa điểm cụ thể

senses.definition: the fact of being in a particular place or thing

examples.x: The test can identify the presence of abnormalities in the unborn child.
One of the first things I note when I walk into a client's home is the presence or absence of pictures around the room.
The company now has a strong presence in Germany.

senses.definition_vi: việc có mặt ở một địa điểm hoặc vật thể cụ thể

senses.definition: a group of people, especially soldiers, who have been sent to a place to deal with a particular situation

examples.x: The government is maintaining a heavy police presence in the area.
The United States has a substantial military presence in the country.

senses.definition_vi: một nhóm người, đặc biệt là binh lính, đã được cử đến một địa điểm để giải quyết một tình huống cụ thể

senses.definition: a person or spirit that you cannot see but that you feel is near

examples.x: She felt a presence behind her.

senses.definition_vi: một người hoặc linh hồn mà bạn không thể nhìn thấy nhưng bạn cảm thấy họ ở gần

senses.definition: the quality of making a strong impression on other people by the way you talk or behave; a person who has this quality

examples.x: a man of great presence
She has a strong voice but absolutely no stage presence.
She has a great screen presence.
He remained a dominant presence in the art world.

senses.definition_vi: phẩm chất tạo ấn tượng mạnh mẽ với người khác bằng cách nói hoặc cư xử của bạn; một người có phẩm chất này

senses.definition: with somebody in the same place

examples.x: The document was signed in the presence of two witnesses.
She asked them not to discuss the matter in her presence.
He should never have made those remarks in your presence.

senses.definition_vi: ở cùng một nơi với ai đó

senses.definition: when something exists in a particular place

examples.x: Litmus paper turns red in the presence of an acid.

senses.definition_vi: khi một cái gì đó tồn tại ở một nơi cụ thể

senses.definition: to do something to make people very aware of the fact that you are there; to have a strong influence on a group of people or a situation

examples.x: She’s only been here a couple of weeks but she is already making her presence felt.
He certainly made his presence felt in the boardroom.

senses.definition_vi: làm điều gì đó để khiến mọi người nhận thức rõ về sự có mặt của bạn; có ảnh hưởng mạnh mẽ đến một nhóm người hoặc một tình huống

senses.definition: existing or happening now

examples.x: I am not satisfied with the present situation.
The present study has two main aims.
the present owner of the house
a list of all club members, past and present
We do not have any more information at the present time.
A few brief comments are sufficient for present purposes.
You can’t use it in its present condition.

senses.definition_vi: cho thấy hoặc đề nghị một cái gì đó để người khác xem xét hoặc cân nhắc

senses.definition: being in a particular place

examples.x: I wasn’t present when the doctor examined him.
The mistake was obvious to all those present.
There were 200 people present at the meeting.
Most fathers wish to be present at the birth of their child.
Simply to be physically present was all that was required.

senses.definition_vi: cho thấy hoặc đề nghị một cái gì đó để người khác xem xét hoặc cân nhắc

senses.definition: existing in a particular place or thing

examples.x: The threat of force was always present.
the ever present risk of pollution
Levels of pollution present in the atmosphere are increasing.
Analysis showed that traces of arsenic were present in the body.

senses.definition_vi: cho thấy hoặc đề nghị một cái gì đó để người khác xem xét hoặc cân nhắc

senses.definition: used to say that all the things or people who should be there are now there
senses.definition_vi: cho thấy hoặc đề nghị một cái gì đó để người khác xem xét hoặc cân nhắc

senses.definition: used after being rude or critical about somebody to say that the people you are talking to are not included in the criticism

examples.x: The people in this office are so narrow-minded, present company excepted, of course.

senses.definition_vi: cho thấy hoặc đề nghị một cái gì đó để người khác xem xét hoặc cân nhắc

senses.definition: at the time you are speaking or writing; now

examples.x: The crime is presently being investigated by the police.
These are the courses presently available.

senses.definition_vi: tại thời điểm bạn đang nói hoặc viết; bây giờ

senses.definition: used to show that something happened after a short time

examples.x: Presently, the door opened again and three men stepped out.

senses.definition_vi: được sử dụng để chỉ ra rằng một cái gì đó đã xảy ra sau một thời gian ngắn

senses.definition: used to show that something will happen soon

examples.x: She'll be here presently.

senses.definition_vi: được sử dụng để chỉ ra rằng một cái gì đó sẽ xảy ra sớm

senses.definition: to suppose that something is true, although you do not have actual proof

examples.x: They are very expensive, I presume?
‘Is he still abroad?’ ‘I presume so.’
I presumed (that) he understood the rules.
Little is known of the youngest son; it is presumed that he died young.
I presumed him to be her husband.

senses.definition_vi: cho rằng điều gì đó là đúng, mặc dù bạn không có bằng chứng thực tế

senses.definition: to accept that something is true until it is shown not to be true, especially in court

examples.x: Twelve passengers are missing, presumed dead.
In English law, a person is presumed innocent until proved guilty.
We must presume innocence until we have proof of guilt.
We must presume them to be innocent until we have proof of guilt.

senses.definition_vi: chấp nhận điều gì đó là đúng cho đến khi nó được chứng minh là sai, đặc biệt là trong tòa án

senses.definition: to accept something as true or existing and to act on that basis

examples.x: The course seems to presume some previous knowledge of the subject.

senses.definition_vi: chấp nhận điều gì đó là đúng hoặc tồn tại và hành động dựa trên cơ sở đó

senses.definition: to behave in a way that shows a lack of respect by doing something that you have no right to do

examples.x: I wouldn't presume to tell you how to run your own business.

senses.definition_vi: cư xử thiếu tôn trọng bằng cách làm điều gì đó mà bạn không có quyền làm

senses.definition: to behave in a particular way, in order to make other people believe something that is not true

examples.x: I'm tired of having to pretend all the time.
Of course I was wrong; it would be hypocritical to pretend otherwise.
He pretended to his family that everything was fine.
We pretended (that) nothing had happened.
She pretended (that) she was his niece.
I pretended to be asleep.
He pretended not to notice.
She didn't love him, though she pretended to.
She pretended an interest she did not feel.

senses.definition_vi: cư xử theo một cách nhất định, để khiến người khác tin vào điều không đúng

senses.definition: to imagine that something is true as part of a game

examples.x: They didn't have any real money so they had to pretend.
Let’s pretend (that) we’re astronauts.

senses.definition_vi: tưởng tượng rằng điều gì đó là đúng như một phần của trò chơi

senses.definition: to claim to be, do or have something, especially when this is not true

examples.x: I can't pretend to any great musical talent.
I don’t pretend (that) I know much about the subject, but…
The book doesn't pretend to be a great work of literature.

senses.definition_vi: khẳng định là, làm hoặc có cái gì đó, đặc biệt là khi điều đó không đúng

senses.definition: attractive without being very beautiful

examples.x: a pretty face
a very pretty child
You look so pretty in that dress!
She's very attractive, though not conventionally pretty.

senses.definition_vi: ở một mức độ nào đó; khá

senses.definition: attractive and pleasant to look at or to listen to without being large, beautiful or impressive

examples.x: pretty clothes
a pretty garden
Lydia—what a pretty name!
That's a pretty flower—what's it called?
The canal looked prettiest at night.
He was hired to make the company pretty and then sell it off.

senses.definition_vi: ở một mức độ nào đó; khá

senses.definition: very pretty

examples.x: She’s as pretty as a picture.

senses.definition_vi: rất

senses.definition: to reach a sad or difficult state

examples.x: I never thought things would come to this pretty pass.
Things have come to a pretty pass when we can’t afford to pay the heating bills!

senses.definition_vi: ở một mức độ nào đó; khá

senses.definition: used to emphasize that you have particular skills or qualities

examples.x: ‘I didn't know you could play the piano.’ ‘I'm not just a pretty face, you know!’

senses.definition_vi: ở một mức độ nào đó; khá

senses.definition: not pleasant to look at

examples.x: You should have seen him in his swimming trunks—not a pretty sight!

senses.definition_vi: ở một mức độ nào đó; khá

senses.definition: a lot of money

examples.x: I bet that cost you a pretty penny.

senses.definition_vi: ở một mức độ nào đó; khá

senses.definition: happening or existing before the event or object that you are talking about

examples.x: No previous experience is necessary for this job.
The car has had only one previous owner.
She is his daughter from a previous marriage.
I was unable to attend because of a previous engagement.
The judge will take into consideration any previous convictions.
We dealt with this in a previous chapter.
We had met on two previous occasions.
Most previous studies have focused on the elderly.
Today's teens are more health conscious than previous generations.

senses.definition_vi: xảy ra hoặc tồn tại trước sự kiện hoặc đối tượng mà bạn đang nói đến

senses.definition: immediately before the time you are talking about

examples.x: the previous year/month/week/night
I couldn't believe it when I heard the news. I'd only seen him the previous day.
He went jogging on Friday, despite the doctor’s warnings the previous day.

senses.definition_vi: ngay trước thời điểm bạn đang nói đến

senses.definition: at a time before the time that you are talking about

examples.x: The building had previously been used as a hotel.
As previously reported, the couple separated in May.
The book contains a number of photographs not previously published.
I had visited them three days previously.
a previously unknown species

senses.definition_vi: vào một thời điểm trước thời điểm bạn đang nói đến

senses.definition: mainly

examples.x: a course designed primarily for specialists
The problem is not primarily a financial one.
The report is primarily concerned with aircraft safety.
The person primarily responsible is the project manager.

senses.definition_vi: chủ yếu

senses.definition: main; most important; basic

examples.x: My prime concern is to protect my property.
Winning is not the prime objective in this sport.
The care of the environment is of prime importance.
He's the police's prime suspect in this case.

senses.definition_vi: chính; quan trọng nhất; cơ bản

senses.definition: of the best quality; excellent

examples.x: prime (cuts of) beef
The store has a prime position in the mall.

senses.definition_vi: có chất lượng tốt nhất; xuất sắc

senses.definition: a prime example of something is one that is typical of it

examples.x: The building is a prime example of 1960s architecture.

senses.definition_vi: một ví dụ điển hình về một cái gì đó là một ví dụ điển hình của nó

senses.definition: most likely to be chosen for something; most suitable

examples.x: The house is isolated and a prime target for burglars.
He's a prime candidate for promotion.

senses.definition_vi: có khả năng cao nhất để được chọn cho một cái gì đó; phù hợp nhất

senses.definition: happening or existing before something else or before a particular time

examples.x: Although not essential, some prior knowledge of statistics is desirable.
This information must not be disclosed without prior written consent.
Visits are by prior arrangement.
Please give us prior notice if you need an evening meal.
She will be unable to attend because of a prior engagement.

senses.definition_vi: xảy ra hoặc tồn tại trước một cái gì đó khác hoặc trước một thời điểm cụ thể

senses.definition: already existing and therefore more important

examples.x: They have a prior claim to the property.

senses.definition_vi: đã tồn tại và do đó quan trọng hơn

senses.definition: before something

examples.x: during the week prior to the meeting

senses.definition_vi: trước một cái gì đó

senses.definition: used to say that something is likely to happen or to be true

examples.x: You're probably right.
I think that's probably true.
It'll probably be OK.
It was the best known and probably the most popular of her songs.
‘Is he going to be there?’ ‘Probably.’
‘I bet he's responsible for this mess.’ ‘Very probably.’
‘Do we need the car?’ ‘Probably not.’
As you probably know, I'm going to be changing jobs soon.
You probably think I'm crazy for trusting him.
The two cases are most probably connected.

senses.definition_vi: được dùng để nói rằng một điều gì đó có khả năng xảy ra hoặc đúng sự thật

senses.definition: a thing that is difficult to deal with or to understand

examples.x: big/serious/major problems
She has a lot of health problems.
financial/social/technical problems
Let me know if you have any problems.
The government must address the problem of child poverty.
We cannot tackle this problem effectively on our own.
We are dealing with a serious problem here.
Money isn't going to solve the problem.
to fix a problem
If he chooses Mary it's bound to cause problems.
to pose/create a problem
The problem first arose in 2018.
There is a problem with this argument.
the problem of youth homelessness
Most students face the problem of funding themselves while they are studying.
Unemployment is a very real problem for graduates now.
It’s a nice table! The only problem is (that) it’s too big for our room.
Part of the problem is the shape of the room.
Stop worrying about their marriage—it isn't your problem.
There's no history of heart problems (= disease connected with the heart) in our family.
the magazine’s problem page (= containing letters about readers’ problems and advice about how to solve them)

senses.definition_vi: một điều khó giải quyết hoặc khó hiểu

senses.definition: a question that can be answered by using logical thought or mathematics

examples.x: mathematical problems
to find the answer to the problem
The teacher set us 50 problems to do.
I have five problems to do for homework.

senses.definition_vi: một câu hỏi có thể được trả lời bằng cách sử dụng suy luận logic hoặc toán học

senses.definition: to disagree with or object to something/somebody

examples.x: I have no problem with you working at home tomorrow.
We are going to do this my way. Do you have a problem with that? (= showing that you are impatient with the person that you are speaking to)
Do you have a problem with her?

senses.definition_vi: không đồng ý hoặc phản đối điều gì đó/ai đó

senses.definition: used to show that you do not care about somebody else’s difficulties

examples.x: If they can't afford to go, that's not my problem.

senses.definition_vi: được dùng để cho thấy bạn không quan tâm đến khó khăn của người khác

senses.definition: used to show that you are happy to help somebody or that something will be easy to do

examples.x: ‘Can I pay by credit card?’ ‘Yes, no problem.’

senses.definition_vi: được dùng để cho thấy bạn sẵn lòng giúp đỡ ai đó hoặc điều gì đó sẽ dễ dàng thực hiện

senses.definition: used after somebody has thanked you or said they are sorry for something

examples.x: ‘Thanks for the ride.’ ‘No problem.’

senses.definition_vi: được dùng sau khi ai đó đã cảm ơn bạn hoặc xin lỗi bạn về điều gì đó

senses.definition: used to show that you think a person should deal with their own difficulties

examples.x: ‘My parents will be furious!’ ‘That’s your problem.’

senses.definition_vi: được dùng để cho thấy bạn nghĩ rằng một người nên tự giải quyết khó khăn của mình

senses.definition: used to show that you think somebody is being unreasonable

examples.x: What's your problem?—I only asked if you could help me for ten minutes.

senses.definition_vi: được dùng để cho thấy bạn nghĩ ai đó đang không hợp lý

senses.definition: difficult to deal with or to understand; full of problems; not certain to be successful

examples.x: The situation is more problematic than we first thought.
Which are the most problematic countries in the world for journalists?

senses.definition_vi: khó giải quyết hoặc khó hiểu; đầy rẫy vấn đề; không chắc chắn sẽ thành công

senses.definition: very great; felt or experienced very strongly

examples.x: profound changes in the earth’s climate
My father's death had a profound effect on us all.
The news came as a profound shock.
The report has profound implications for schools.
Her sense of disappointment was profound.

senses.definition_vi: rất lớn; được cảm nhận hoặc trải nghiệm rất mạnh mẽ

senses.definition: showing great knowledge or understanding

examples.x: profound insights
a profound book

senses.definition_vi: thể hiện kiến thức hoặc sự hiểu biết sâu sắc

senses.definition: needing a lot of study or thought

examples.x: profound questions about life and death
She always claimed there was nothing profound about her artwork.

senses.definition_vi: cần nhiều nghiên cứu hoặc suy nghĩ

senses.definition: very serious; complete

examples.x: profound disability

senses.definition_vi: rất nghiêm túc; hoàn toàn

senses.definition: a statement that tells somebody that you will definitely do or not do something

examples.x: to make/keep/fulfil/break a promise
You haven't gone back on your promise, have you?
He simply broke every single promise he ever made me.
The minister was under attack for a series of broken promises.
She kept her promise to visit her aunt regularly.
He fulfilled a campaign promise to end the war.
He had now to deliver on his promises to the Canadian electorate.
These are empty promises from a party not in a position to honour them.
It is unlikely that these laws will be changed, despite promises by the Prime Minister.
The government failed to keep its promise of lower taxes.
They were lured by government promises of either money or other benefits.
Do I have your promise that you won't tell anyone about this?

senses.definition_vi: nói với ai đó rằng bạn chắc chắn sẽ làm hoặc không làm điều gì đó, hoặc rằng điều gì đó chắc chắn sẽ xảy ra

senses.definition: a sign that somebody/something will be successful

examples.x: Her work shows great promise.
Their research holds considerable promise.
He failed to fulfil his early promise.
Their future was full of promise.
Stem cell research offers real promise for the treatment of currently incurable diseases.

senses.definition_vi: nói với ai đó rằng bạn chắc chắn sẽ làm hoặc không làm điều gì đó, hoặc rằng điều gì đó chắc chắn sẽ xảy ra

senses.definition: a sign, or a reason for hope that something may happen, especially something good

examples.x: The day dawned bright and clear, with the promise of warm, sunny weather.
The dog approached, attracted by the promise of food.
Organic food seems to hold out the promise of healthy living.

senses.definition_vi: nói với ai đó rằng bạn chắc chắn sẽ làm hoặc không làm điều gì đó, hoặc rằng điều gì đó chắc chắn sẽ xảy ra

senses.definition: the act of performing a task quickly and carelessly, especially of washing or cleaning something quickly
senses.definition_vi: nói với ai đó rằng bạn chắc chắn sẽ làm hoặc không làm điều gì đó, hoặc rằng điều gì đó chắc chắn sẽ xảy ra

senses.definition: showing signs of being good or successful

examples.x: He was voted the most promising new actor for his part in the movie.
The weather doesn't look very promising.
The research produced promising results.

senses.definition_vi: cho thấy dấu hiệu của việc tốt hoặc thành công

senses.definition: right, appropriate or correct; according to the rules

examples.x: We should have had a proper discussion before voting.
Please follow the proper procedures for dealing with complaints.
Manufacturers provide these directions to indicate the proper use of their products.
It is vital that they're given the proper training.
The Government is failing to deliver proper care and treatment to people with dementia.
Nothing is in its proper place.
He is never referred to by his proper name in the play.

senses.definition_vi: đúng, phù hợp hoặc chính xác; theo quy tắc

senses.definition: that you consider to be real and of a good enough standard

examples.x: I haven't had a proper meal in days.
Eat some proper food, not just toast and jam!
When are you going to get a proper job?

senses.definition_vi: mà bạn coi là thật và có đủ tiêu chuẩn tốt

senses.definition: socially and morally acceptable

examples.x: It is right and proper that parents take responsibility for their children's attendance at school.
The development was planned without proper regard to the interests of local people.
He is always perfectly proper in his behaviour.

senses.definition_vi: chấp nhận được về mặt xã hội và đạo đức

senses.definition: according to the most exact meaning of the word

examples.x: The celebrations proper always begin on the last stroke of midnight.

senses.definition_vi: theo ý nghĩa chính xác nhất của từ

senses.definition: complete

examples.x: We're in a proper mess now.

senses.definition_vi: đầy đủ

senses.definition: belonging to a particular type of thing; natural in a particular situation or place

examples.x: They should be treated with the dignity proper to all individuals created by God.

senses.definition_vi: thuộc về một loại sự vật cụ thể; tự nhiên trong một tình huống hoặc địa điểm cụ thể

senses.definition: completely; to the greatest extent possible

examples.x: That's messed things up good and proper.

senses.definition_vi: hoàn toàn; đến mức độ lớn nhất có thể

senses.definition: in a way that is correct and/or appropriate

examples.x: How much money do we need to do the job properly?
The television isn't working properly.
The baby was put on a ventilator to help her lungs function properly.
Make sure the letter is properly addressed.
Businesses should ensure that staff are properly trained in how to use new systems.
Paine believed that 'Liberty, properly understood, consists in the power of doing whatever does not injure another.'

senses.definition_vi: theo cách đúng và/hoặc phù hợp

senses.definition: in a way that is socially or morally acceptable

examples.x: You acted perfectly properly in approaching me first.
When will these kids learn to behave properly?

senses.definition_vi: theo cách chấp nhận được về mặt xã hội hoặc đạo đức

senses.definition: really; in fact

examples.x: He had usurped powers that properly belonged to parliament.
The subject is not, properly speaking (= really), a science.

senses.definition_vi: thực sự; trên thực tế

senses.definition: feeling pleased and satisfied about something that you own or have done, or are connected with

examples.x: proud parents
the proud owner of a new car
The girls have made me extremely proud.
Your achievements are something to be proud of.
Barry was proud of the fact that he had never missed a day's work in his life.

examples.cf: proud of somebody/something/yourself for doing something
examples.x: He was proud of himself for not giving up.
I feel very proud to be a part of the team.
I'm proud to say you're my son.
We are proud to present this award to you.
She was proud that her daughter had so much talent.

senses.definition_vi: cảm thấy hài lòng và mãn nguyện về điều gì đó bạn sở hữu hoặc đã làm, hoặc có liên quan đến

senses.definition: causing somebody to feel proud

examples.x: This is the proudest moment of my life.
It was a proud day in the nation’s history
The car had been his proudest possession.

senses.definition_vi: khiến ai đó cảm thấy tự hào

senses.definition: feeling that you are better and more important than other people

examples.x: She comes across as proud and arrogant.
He was too proud now to be seen with his former friends.

senses.definition_vi: cảm thấy mình tốt hơn và quan trọng hơn những người khác

senses.definition: having respect for yourself and not wanting to lose the respect of others

examples.x: They were a proud and independent people.
Don't be too proud to ask for help.
What has become of this once proud nation?

senses.definition_vi: có sự tôn trọng bản thân và không muốn mất đi sự tôn trọng của người khác

senses.definition: beautiful, tall and impressive

examples.x: The sunflowers stretched tall and proud to the sun.

senses.definition_vi: đẹp, cao lớn và ấn tượng

senses.definition: very proud/pleased

examples.x: Now he's passed his driving test, he's as proud as Punch.

senses.definition_vi: rất tự hào/hài lòng

senses.definition: an act of trying to make something move by taking hold of it and using force to bring it towards you

examples.x: I gave the door a sharp pull and it opened.
One last pull on the rope should do it.

senses.definition_vi: nắm lấy vật gì đó và dùng lực để di chuyển nó hoặc cố gắng di chuyển nó về phía bạn

senses.definition: a strong physical force that makes something move in a particular direction

examples.x: the earth’s gravitational pull
The tides depend on the pull of the moon.

senses.definition_vi: nắm lấy vật gì đó và dùng lực để di chuyển nó hoặc cố gắng di chuyển nó về phía bạn

senses.definition: the fact of something attracting you or having a strong effect on you

examples.x: The magnetic pull of the city was hard to resist.
He felt the pull of paternal love.

senses.definition_vi: nắm lấy vật gì đó và dùng lực để di chuyển nó hoặc cố gắng di chuyển nó về phía bạn

senses.definition: power and influence over other people

examples.x: people who have a lot of pull with the media

senses.definition_vi: nắm lấy vật gì đó và dùng lực để di chuyển nó hoặc cố gắng di chuyển nó về phía bạn

senses.definition: an act of taking a deep breath of smoke from a cigarette, etc. or a deep drink of something

examples.x: She took a long pull on her cigarette.
a pull at his flask

senses.definition_vi: nắm lấy vật gì đó và dùng lực để di chuyển nó hoặc cố gắng di chuyển nó về phía bạn

senses.definition: a difficult walk up a steep hill

examples.x: It's a long pull up to the summit.

senses.definition_vi: nắm lấy vật gì đó và dùng lực để di chuyển nó hoặc cố gắng di chuyển nó về phía bạn

senses.definition: an injury to a muscle caused by using too much force
senses.definition_vi: nắm lấy vật gì đó và dùng lực để di chuyển nó hoặc cố gắng di chuyển nó về phía bạn

senses.definition: something such as a handle or rope that you use to pull something

examples.x: a bell/door pull

senses.definition_vi: nắm lấy vật gì đó và dùng lực để di chuyển nó hoặc cố gắng di chuyển nó về phía bạn

senses.definition: trying to find a sexual partner
senses.definition_vi: nắm lấy vật gì đó và dùng lực để di chuyển nó hoặc cố gắng di chuyển nó về phía bạn

senses.definition: not mixed with anything else; with nothing added

examples.x: pure gold
ties made of pure silk
These shirts are 100% pure cotton.
The patient was given pure oxygen to breathe.
Classical dance in its purest form requires symmetry and balance.
One movie is classified as pure art, the other as entertainment.
The metal needs to be very pure.

senses.definition_vi: không pha trộn với bất cứ thứ gì khác; không thêm gì vào

senses.definition: clean and not containing any harmful substances

examples.x: a bottle of pure water
The air was sweet and pure.
Much of the population still does not have access to pure drinking water.

senses.definition_vi: sạch sẽ và không chứa bất kỳ chất độc hại nào

senses.definition: complete and total

examples.x: They met by pure chance.
She laughed with pure joy.
That woman is pure evil.
These reports are pure speculation (= there is no evidence that they are true).
It was a pure accident. I'm not blaming anybody.
It was pure coincidence that all the absences occurred at the same time.

senses.definition_vi: hoàn chỉnh và trọn vẹn

senses.definition: very clear; perfect

examples.x: beaches of pure white sand
a pure voice

senses.definition_vi: rất trong; hoàn hảo

senses.definition: without evil thoughts or actions, especially sexual ones; morally good

examples.x: to lead a pure life
His motives were pure.
to be pure in body and mind

senses.definition_vi: không có suy nghĩ hoặc hành động xấu xa, đặc biệt là tình dục; đạo đức tốt

senses.definition: about increasing knowledge of the subject rather than using knowledge in practical ways

examples.x: pure mathematics
technology as opposed to pure science subjects

senses.definition_vi: về việc tăng cường kiến thức về chủ đề thay vì sử dụng kiến thức vào các ứng dụng thực tế

senses.definition: not mixed with any other type of animal or plant

examples.x: These cattle are one of the purest breeds in Britain.

senses.definition_vi: không pha trộn với bất kỳ loại động vật hoặc thực vật nào khác

senses.definition: used after the noun that it refers to in order to emphasize that there is nothing but the thing you have just mentioned involved in something

examples.x: It's laziness, pure and simple.
The man wants revenge, pure and simple.

senses.definition_vi: được sử dụng sau danh từ mà nó đề cập để nhấn mạnh rằng không có gì ngoài thứ bạn vừa đề cập liên quan đến điều gì đó

senses.definition: only; completely

examples.x: I saw the letter purely by chance.
The charity is run on a purely voluntary basis.
She took the job purely and simply for the money.
The fireplace in the bedroom is purely decorative.

senses.definition_vi: chỉ; hoàn toàn

senses.definition: having the colour of blue and red mixed together

examples.x: a purple flower/dress
His face was purple with rage.
The effort was making her face turn purple.
It produces lovely dark purple berries around this time of year.

senses.definition_vi: màu của xanh lam và đỏ trộn lẫn với nhau

senses.definition: writing or a piece of writing that is too grand in style
senses.definition_vi: màu của xanh lam và đỏ trộn lẫn với nhau

senses.definition: the intention, aim or function of something; the thing that something is supposed to achieve

examples.x: Our campaign's main purpose is to raise money.
The plan achieved its primary purpose, if nothing else.
The purpose of the book is to provide a complete guide to the university.
Giving too much advance notice would defeat the purpose of the inspection.

examples.cf: for the purpose of doing something
examples.x: A meeting was called for the purpose of appointing a new treasurer.
I moved to London for the sole purpose of working with her.
I have included this data for the purpose of comparison.

examples.cf: with the purpose of doing something
examples.x: This project was launched with the purpose of increasing the number of visitors to the region.
I could find no practical purpose for this app.
The space station serves several purposes.
The experiments serve no useful purpose (= are not useful).

senses.definition_vi: ý định, mục tiêu hoặc chức năng của một cái gì đó; điều mà một cái gì đó được cho là để đạt được

senses.definition: what is needed in a particular situation

examples.x: These gifts count as income for tax purposes.
The building was originally used for commercial purposes.
For the purposes of this study, the three groups have been combined.

senses.definition_vi: những gì cần thiết trong một tình huống cụ thể

senses.definition: meaning that is important and valuable to you

examples.x: Volunteer work gives her life a sense of purpose.
He believes he has finally found a purpose in life.

senses.definition_vi: ý nghĩa quan trọng và có giá trị đối với bạn

senses.definition: the ability to plan something and work successfully to achieve it

examples.x: He has enormous confidence and strength of purpose.

senses.definition_vi: khả năng lập kế hoạch và làm việc thành công để đạt được nó

senses.definition: (of an institution, a system, a thing, etc.) suitable for the function or purpose that it was designed for

examples.x: The minister argued that the education system wasn’t fit for purpose.
The new executive flats are fully equipped and fit for purpose.
I returned the goods as they weren’t fit for purpose.

senses.definition_vi: (của một tổ chức, một hệ thống, một vật, v.v.) phù hợp với chức năng hoặc mục đích mà nó được thiết kế

senses.definition: used when you are stating what the reality of a situation is

examples.x: There's still another ten minutes of the game to go, but for practical purposes it's already over.

senses.definition_vi: được sử dụng khi bạn đang nêu thực tế của một tình huống

senses.definition: not by accident; deliberately

examples.x: I did it on purpose, knowing it would annoy her.
He slammed the door on purpose.

senses.definition_vi: không phải do tai nạn; cố ý

senses.definition: in the effects that something has, if not in reality; almost completely

examples.x: By 1981 the docks had, to all intents and purposes, closed.
The two items are, for all intents and purposes, identical.

senses.definition_vi: trong các hiệu ứng mà một cái gì đó có, nếu không phải trong thực tế; gần như hoàn toàn

senses.definition: with little/no useful effect or result

examples.x: The government had spent a lot on education but to little or no purpose.

senses.definition_vi: với ít/không có hiệu quả hoặc kết quả hữu ích

senses.definition: an act of pushing something/somebody

examples.x: She gave him a gentle push.
The car won't start. Can you give it a push?
At the push of a button (= very easily) he could get a whole list of names.

senses.definition_vi: sử dụng tay, cánh tay hoặc cơ thể để làm cho ai đó/cái gì đó di chuyển về phía trước hoặc ra xa bạn; di chuyển một bộ phận cơ thể vào một vị trí cụ thể

senses.definition: a large and determined military attack

examples.x: a final push against the enemy
The firm has begun a major push into the European market.

senses.definition_vi: sử dụng tay, cánh tay hoặc cơ thể để làm cho ai đó/cái gì đó di chuyển về phía trước hoặc ra xa bạn; di chuyển một bộ phận cơ thể vào một vị trí cụ thể

senses.definition: a determined effort to achieve something

examples.x: The push for reform started in 2007.

senses.definition_vi: sử dụng tay, cánh tay hoặc cơ thể để làm cho ai đó/cái gì đó di chuyển về phía trước hoặc ra xa bạn; di chuyển một bộ phận cơ thể vào một vị trí cụ thể

senses.definition: an act of encouraging somebody to do something

examples.x: He wants to open his own business, but needs a push in the right direction to get him started.

senses.definition_vi: sử dụng tay, cánh tay hoặc cơ thể để làm cho ai đó/cái gì đó di chuyển về phía trước hoặc ra xa bạn; di chuyển một bộ phận cơ thể vào một vị trí cụ thể

senses.definition: used to say that something is possible, but only with difficulty

examples.x: We can provide accommodation for six people at a push.

senses.definition_vi: sử dụng tay, cánh tay hoặc cơ thể để làm cho ai đó/cái gì đó di chuyển về phía trước hoặc ra xa bạn; di chuyển một bộ phận cơ thể vào một vị trí cụ thể

senses.definition: to dismiss somebody/to be dismissed from your job

examples.x: They gave him the push after only six weeks.

senses.definition_vi: sử dụng tay, cánh tay hoặc cơ thể để làm cho ai đó/cái gì đó di chuyển về phía trước hoặc ra xa bạn; di chuyển một bộ phận cơ thể vào một vị trí cụ thể

senses.definition: to end a romantic relationship with somebody; to be told that a romantic relationship with somebody is over

examples.x: He was devastated when his girlfriend gave him the push.

senses.definition_vi: sử dụng tay, cánh tay hoặc cơ thể để làm cho ai đó/cái gì đó di chuyển về phía trước hoặc ra xa bạn; di chuyển một bộ phận cơ thể vào một vị trí cụ thể

senses.definition: when there is no other choice; when everything else has failed
senses.definition_vi: sử dụng tay, cánh tay hoặc cơ thể để làm cho ai đó/cái gì đó di chuyển về phía trước hoặc ra xa bạn; di chuyển một bộ phận cơ thể vào một vị trí cụ thể

senses.definition: to move something into a particular place or position

examples.x: Put the cases down there, please.
Did you put sugar in my coffee?
Put your hand up if you need more paper.

senses.definition_vi: di chuyển một cái gì đó vào một địa điểm hoặc vị trí cụ thể

senses.definition: to move something into a particular place or position using force

examples.x: He put his fist through a glass door.

senses.definition_vi: di chuyển một cái gì đó vào một địa điểm hoặc vị trí cụ thể bằng lực

senses.definition: to cause somebody/something to go to a particular place

examples.x: Her family put her into a nursing home.
It was the year the Americans put a man on the moon.

senses.definition_vi: khiến ai đó/cái gì đó đến một địa điểm cụ thể

senses.definition: to attach or fix something to something else

examples.x: We had to put new locks on all the doors.

senses.definition_vi: gắn hoặc cố định một cái gì đó vào một cái gì đó khác

senses.definition: to write something or make a mark on something

examples.x: Put your name here.
Friday at 11? I'll put it in my diary.
I couldn't read what she had put.

senses.definition_vi: viết một cái gì đó hoặc tạo một dấu trên một cái gì đó

senses.definition: to bring somebody/something into the state or condition mentioned

examples.x: I was put in charge of the office.
The incident put her in a bad mood.
Put yourself in my position. What would you have done?
I tried to put the matter into perspective.
Don't go putting yourself at risk.
I am determined to put things right.
It was time to put their suggestion into practice.
This new injury will put him out of action for several weeks.
He put Ray on guard with a gun.

senses.definition_vi: đưa ai đó/cái gì đó vào trạng thái hoặc tình trạng được đề cập

senses.definition: to make somebody/something feel something or be affected by something

examples.x: Her new job has put a great strain on her.
They put pressure on her to resign.
It's time you put a stop to this childish behaviour.

senses.definition_vi: làm cho ai đó/cái gì đó cảm thấy điều gì đó hoặc bị ảnh hưởng bởi điều gì đó

senses.definition: to express or state something in a particular way

examples.x: She put it very tactfully.
Put simply, we accept their offer or go bankrupt.
Simply put, the film is a masterpiece.
I was, to put it mildly, annoyed (= I was extremely angry).
Putting it bluntly, the project was a disaster.
He was too trusting—or, to put it another way, he had no head for business.
The meat was—how shall I put it?—a little overdone.
As T.S. Eliot puts it…
She had never tried to put this feeling into words.
Can you help me put this letter into good English, please?
I thought you put your points very well.

senses.definition_vi: biểu đạt hoặc nêu một cái gì đó theo một cách cụ thể

senses.definition: to give or attach a particular level of importance, trust, value, etc. to something

examples.x: Our company puts the emphasis on quality.
He put a limit on the amount we could spend.

senses.definition_vi: đặt một mức độ quan trọng, tin cậy, giá trị, v.v. cụ thể cho một cái gì đó

senses.definition: to consider somebody/something to belong to the class or level mentioned

examples.x: I'd put her in the top rank of modern novelists.

senses.definition_vi: coi ai đó/cái gì đó thuộc về lớp hoặc cấp độ được đề cập

senses.definition: to throw the shot
senses.definition_vi: ném tạ

senses.definition: used to say that you think somebody is capable of doing something wrong, illegal, etc.
senses.definition_vi: được sử dụng để nói rằng bạn nghĩ ai đó có khả năng làm điều gì đó sai trái, bất hợp pháp, v.v.

senses.definition: to have many sexual partners
senses.definition_vi: có nhiều bạn tình

senses.definition: to suggest something to somebody to see if they can argue against it

examples.x: I put it to you that you are the only person who had a motive for the crime.

senses.definition_vi: đề xuất một cái gì đó cho ai đó để xem liệu họ có thể phản bác lại nó không

senses.definition: to persuade somebody to believe something that is not true

examples.x: Don't try to put one over on me!

senses.definition_vi: thuyết phục ai đó tin vào điều gì đó không đúng sự thật

senses.definition: to force somebody to experience something difficult or unpleasant

examples.x: They really put me through it (= asked me difficult questions) at the interview.

senses.definition_vi: buộc ai đó trải qua điều gì đó khó khăn hoặc khó chịu

senses.definition: used when comparing or contrasting somebody/something with a group of other people or things to mean ‘combined’ or ‘in total’

examples.x: Your department spent more last year than all the others put together.

senses.definition_vi: được sử dụng khi so sánh hoặc đối chiếu ai đó/cái gì đó với một nhóm người hoặc vật khác để có nghĩa là 'kết hợp' hoặc 'tổng cộng'

senses.definition: used to tell somebody to stop just talking about something and actually do it, show it, etc.
senses.definition_vi: được sử dụng để yêu cầu ai đó ngừng chỉ nói về điều gì đó và thực sự làm, thể hiện, v.v.

senses.definition: yes
senses.definition_vi: có

senses.definition: used when you are commenting on what somebody has just said

examples.x: ‘We're off to France soon.’ ‘Oh yeah? When's that?’
‘I'm going to be rich one day.’ ‘Oh yeah?’ (= I don't believe you.)

senses.definition_vi: được sử dụng khi bạn đang nhận xét về điều ai đó vừa nói

senses.definition: used to say that you do not believe what somebody has just said, disagree with it, or are not interested in it

examples.x: ‘You'll be fine.’ ‘Yeah, right.’

senses.definition_vi: được sử dụng để nói rằng bạn không tin điều ai đó vừa nói, không đồng ý với nó, hoặc không quan tâm đến nó

senses.definition: the period from 1 January to 31 December, that is 365 or 366 days, divided into 12 months

examples.x: Elections take place every year.
I lost my job earlier this year.
next/last year
She died the following year.
Three million tourists visit Yellowstone every year.
She was born in the year 1865.
The crowd was much smaller than in previous years.
In the past few years, she has become one of our top-selling authors.
The museum is open all year round (= during the whole year).

senses.definition_vi: khoảng thời gian từ ngày 1 tháng 1 đến ngày 31 tháng 12, tức là 365 hoặc 366 ngày, chia thành 12 tháng

senses.definition: a period of twelve months, measured from any particular time

examples.x: It's exactly a year since I started working here.
She gave up teaching three years ago.
They got married two years later.
The autobiography could only be published 100 years after his death.
I hope to retire in two years' time.
Where do you think you will be five years from now?
Seeds can live in the soil for many years.
in the first year of their marriage
Production has declined in recent years.
His early years were spent in San Francisco.
We have high hopes for the coming year (= the next twelve months).
the pre-war/war/post-war years (= the period before/during/after the war)
I have happy memories of my years in Poland (= the time I spent there).

senses.definition_vi: một khoảng thời gian mười hai tháng, tính từ bất kỳ thời điểm nào

senses.definition: age; time of life

examples.x: He was 14 years old when it happened.
She looks young for her years.
They were both only 20 years of age.
a twenty-year-old man
He died in his sixtieth year.
She's getting on in years (= is no longer young).

senses.definition_vi: tuổi; thời gian trong đời

senses.definition: a period of twelve months connected with a particular activity

examples.x: the tax/fiscal year
the school year

senses.definition_vi: một khoảng thời gian mười hai tháng liên quan đến một hoạt động cụ thể

senses.definition: a level that you stay in for one year; a student at a particular level

examples.x: We started German in year seven.
She was in my year at school.
The project is the work of a group of year-seven pupils.
The first years do French.

senses.definition_vi: một cấp độ mà bạn ở trong một năm; một học sinh ở một cấp độ cụ thể

senses.definition: a long time

examples.x: It's years since we last met.
They haven't seen each other for years and years.
That's the best movie I've seen in years.
It's the first time we've met in years.
We've had a lot of fun over the years.

senses.definition_vi: một thời gian dài

senses.definition: at some time in the future

examples.x: There are certain to be more job losses further down the road.
Will this movie still be funny a few years down the road?

senses.definition_vi: vào một thời điểm nào đó trong tương lai

senses.definition: the last years of somebody’s life
senses.definition_vi: những năm cuối đời của ai đó

senses.definition: a very long time

examples.x: We've known each other for donkey's years.
I met him once, but that was donkey’s years ago.
This technology has been around for donkey's.

senses.definition_vi: một thời gian rất dài

senses.definition: a person or thing that people decide is the best in a particular field in a particular year

examples.x: He was chosen as TV personality of the year.

senses.definition_vi: một người hoặc vật mà mọi người quyết định là tốt nhất trong một lĩnh vực cụ thể trong một năm

senses.definition: used to emphasize that you will/would never do something

examples.x: I'd never have thought of that in a million years.

senses.definition_vi: được sử dụng để nhấn mạnh rằng bạn sẽ/sẽ không bao giờ làm điều gì đó

senses.definition: used in polite expressions to describe somebody as ‘very old’

examples.x: He was a man of advanced years.
Even at my advanced age I still know how to enjoy myself!

senses.definition_vi: được sử dụng trong các cách diễn đạt lịch sự để mô tả ai đó là ‘rất già’

senses.definition: to make somebody feel or look older

examples.x: The illness put years on him.
His wife's death has put years on him.

senses.definition_vi: làm cho ai đó cảm thấy hoặc trông già hơn

senses.definition: the desire for new sexual experience that is thought to be felt after seven years of marriage
senses.definition_vi: mong muốn có kinh nghiệm tình dục mới được cho là cảm thấy sau bảy năm kết hôn

senses.definition: since a very long time ago

examples.x: I've been going there every summer since the year dot.

senses.definition_vi: từ rất lâu trước đây

senses.definition: to make somebody feel or look younger

examples.x: That haircut takes years off her.
Careful make-up and styling can take years off you.

senses.definition_vi: làm cho ai đó cảm thấy hoặc trông trẻ hơn

senses.definition: the time when a new century/year starts

examples.x: It was built at the turn of the century.
The team are unbeaten since the turn of the year.

senses.definition_vi: thời điểm bắt đầu một thế kỷ/năm mới

senses.definition: every year for many years

examples.x: People return year after year.

senses.definition_vi: hàng năm trong nhiều năm

senses.definition: as the years pass; each year

examples.x: Year by year their affection for each other grew stronger.

senses.definition_vi: mỗi năm, trôi qua; mỗi năm

senses.definition: every year
senses.definition_vi: hàng năm

senses.definition: any particular year after the birth of Christ
senses.definition_vi: bất kỳ năm nào sau năm sinh của Chúa Kitô

senses.definition: each year, compared with the last year

examples.x: Spending has increased year on year.
a year-on-year increase in spending

senses.definition_vi: mỗi năm, so với năm trước

senses.definition: to shout loudly, for example because you are angry, excited, frightened or in pain

examples.x: He yelled at the other driver.

examples.cf: yell at somebody to do something
examples.x: She yelled at the child to get down from the wall.
They yelled with excitement.
She yelled out in pain.
‘Be careful!’ he yelled.
The crowd yelled encouragement at the players.
He yelled out her name.
He yelled for help.

senses.definition_vi: hét lên lớn, ví dụ vì bạn đang tức giận, phấn khích, sợ hãi hoặc đau đớn

senses.definition: having the colour of lemons or butter

examples.x: pale yellow flowers
a bright yellow waterproof jacket
Her teeth were rather yellow.
She wore a pale yellow dress.
The leaves turn yellow in November.

senses.definition_vi: màu của chanh hoặc bơ

senses.definition: a very offensive word used to describe the light brown skin of people from some East Asian countries
senses.definition_vi: màu của chanh hoặc bơ

senses.definition: easily frightened
senses.definition_vi: màu của chanh hoặc bơ

senses.definition: used to answer a question and say that something is correct or true

examples.x: ‘Is this your car?’ ‘Yes, it is.’
‘Are you coming? Yes or no?’

senses.definition_vi: được sử dụng để trả lời một câu hỏi và nói rằng điều gì đó là đúng hoặc sự thật

senses.definition: used to show that you agree with what has been said

examples.x: ‘I enjoyed her latest novel.’ ‘Yes, me too.’
‘It's an excellent hotel.’ ‘Yes, but (= I don't completely agree) it's too expensive.’
In reply to his question, most of them answered yes.

senses.definition_vi: được sử dụng để cho thấy bạn đồng ý với những gì đã được nói

senses.definition: used to disagree with something negative that somebody has just said

examples.x: ‘I've never met her before.’ ‘Yes, you have.’

senses.definition_vi: được sử dụng để không đồng ý với một điều tiêu cực mà ai đó vừa nói

senses.definition: used to agree to a request or to give permission

examples.x: ‘Dad, can I borrow the car?’ ‘Yes, but be careful.’
We're hoping that they will say yes to our proposals.

senses.definition_vi: được dùng để đồng ý với một yêu cầu hoặc để cho phép

senses.definition: used to accept an offer or invitation

examples.x: ‘Would you like a drink?’ ‘Yes, please/thanks.’

senses.definition_vi: được dùng để chấp nhận một lời đề nghị hoặc lời mời

senses.definition: used for asking somebody what they want

examples.x: Yes? How can I help you?

senses.definition_vi: được dùng để hỏi ai đó muốn gì

senses.definition: used for replying politely when somebody calls you

examples.x: ‘Waiter!’ ‘Yes, sir?’

senses.definition_vi: được dùng để trả lời lịch sự khi ai đó gọi bạn

senses.definition: used to show that you have just remembered something

examples.x: Where did I put the keys? Oh yes—in my pocket!

senses.definition_vi: được dùng để cho thấy bạn vừa nhớ ra điều gì đó

senses.definition: used to encourage somebody to continue speaking

examples.x: ‘I’m going to Paris this weekend.’ ‘Yes…’

senses.definition_vi: được dùng để khuyến khích ai đó tiếp tục nói

senses.definition: used to show that you do not believe what somebody has said

examples.x: ‘Sorry I'm late—the bus didn't come.’ ‘Oh yes?’

senses.definition_vi: được dùng để cho thấy bạn không tin điều ai đó vừa nói

senses.definition: used to emphasize what you have just said

examples.x: Mrs Smith has just won £2 million—yes!—£2 million!

senses.definition_vi: được dùng để nhấn mạnh điều bạn vừa nói

senses.definition: used to show that you are excited or extremely pleased about something that you have done or something that has happened

examples.x: ‘They've scored another goal.’ ‘Yes!!’

senses.definition_vi: được dùng để cho thấy bạn rất vui hoặc cực kỳ hài lòng về điều gì đó bạn đã làm hoặc điều gì đó đã xảy ra

senses.definition: used to show that you are impatient or annoyed about something

examples.x: ‘Hurry up—it's late.’ ‘Yes, yes—I'm coming.’

senses.definition_vi: được dùng để cho thấy bạn thiếu kiên nhẫn hoặc khó chịu về điều gì đó

senses.definition: used when you cannot give a clear answer to a question

examples.x: ‘Are you enjoying it?’ ‘Yes and no.’

senses.definition_vi: được dùng khi bạn không thể đưa ra câu trả lời rõ ràng cho một câu hỏi

senses.definition: on the day before today

examples.x: A company spokeswoman said yesterday that no final decision had been made yet.
yesterday morning/afternoon/evening

To think I was lying on a beach only the day before yesterday.
I can remember our wedding as if it were yesterday.
They arrived yesterday.
Where were you yesterday morning?
Figures released yesterday show 4,944 people were awaiting surgery.

senses.definition_vi: ngày trước hôm nay

senses.definition: used to say that you are not stupid enough to believe what somebody is telling you

examples.x: Oh yeah? I wasn't born yesterday, you know.

senses.definition_vi: ngày trước hôm nay

examples.x: Five, four, three, two, one, zero… We have lift-off.

senses.definition: a temperature, pressure, etc. that is equal to zero on a scale

examples.x: It was ten degrees below zero last night (= −10°C).
The thermometer had fallen to zero.

senses.definition_vi: nhiệt độ, áp suất, v.v. bằng không trên một thang đo

senses.definition: the lowest possible amount or level; nothing at all

examples.x: I rated my chances as zero.
zero inflation

senses.definition_vi: số lượng hoặc mức thấp nhất có thể; không có gì cả
